points.text: Same as the top-level zdr entry: no public zero-retention offering, switch or application path, and at contract level §7.2 expressly licenses AI21 to host / store / reproduce / de-identify request content (Customer Data includes Input) and Output for purposes that include to "develop, and improve the Services", while the deletion clause §17.4 says only that AI21 "may delete Customer Data following a reasonable retrieval period". The evidence pointing the other way is still the blog post and the "traceless mode" page in the Trust Center metadata, which is not a commitment.

points.text: In a self-managed deployment the data never enters AI21's environment, so the no-training commitment in §7.2 holds by itself and holds more strongly

points.text: An AI21-managed private deployment is still within the Services covered by the ToS, so §7.2 applies. The website separately has a Post-Training product line that expressly trains custom models on customer data (the model belongs to the customer), which is a training scenario agreed separately and recorded apart from this tier's default conclusion.
points.text_zh: AI21 托管私有部署仍属 ToS 的 Services 范围，适用 §7.2。官网另有 Post-Training 产品线明确用客户数据训练定制模型（模型归客户），属另行约定的训练场景，与本档默认结论分开记。

This tier has no policy document of its own; the /deployment/ page carries only marketing wording about deployment shapes and data residency options and cannot serve as an anchor source.

training.quote: Alibaba Cloud will not use your Member Content to develop or improve the models on Model Studio, unless you separately provide your consent.

points.text: Contract level: International Product ToS v3.8.0 §4.48.1(e), final sentence: "Alibaba Cloud will not use your Member Content to develop or improve the models on Model Studio, unless you separately provide your consent." — Member Content includes Input and Output (§4.48.1(b)), so pay-as-you-go API inputs and outputs are not used to develop or improve models on Model Studio unless the customer separately consents. Three layers of support: (1) Membership Agreement §4.1 "We will not access or use your Member Content except as necessary to maintain or provide the Services…"
points.text_zh: 合同级(contract):国际站 Product ToS v3.8.0 §4.48.1(e) 末句「Alibaba Cloud will not use your Member Content to develop or improve the models on Model Studio, unless you separately provide your consent.」——Member Content 含 Input 与 Output(§4.48.1(b)),即按量 API 的输入输出不用于开发或改进百炼上的模型,除非客户另行单独同意。佐证三层:①会员协议 §4.1「We will not access or use your Member Content except as necessary to maintain or provide the Services…」

points.text: (2) The international Model Studio privacy notice and product introduction page: "will never use your data for model training" (enterprise_privacy_faq / developer_data)
points.text_zh: ②国际站 Model Studio 隐私说明与产品介绍页「will never use your data for model training」(enterprise_privacy_faq / developer_data)

points.text: (3) The Training data summary, "Customer data policy" section: "does not use customer business data to develop or improve models without explicit consent". **Tier boundary (hard)**: the Chinese-language product page of the international site limits the no-training commitment by name to "the pay-as-you-go API and the Token Plan team edition", and the "Important" box on the same page states that the data-use terms differ for the Token Plan individual edition and Coding Plan (input and generated content while using Coding Plan will be used for service improvement and model optimization); those two tiers are outside this provider's scope. **Customer-side exception**: once inference logs are enabled, Log backflow can recycle logs into the customer's own training dataset (telemetry/backflow anchors) — that is the customer's own action, not the vendor training on the data. **Third-party model exception**: when a third-party model on Model Studio is used (DeepSeek/Kimi/GLM and others), data processing is provided directly by that vendor under that vendor's terms (§4.48.2), so this "no training" commitment covers only Alibaba Cloud's own model path
points.text_zh: ③Training data summary「Customer data policy」段「does not use customer business data to develop or improve models without explicit consent」。**档位边界(硬)**:国际站中文产品页把不训练承诺点名限定为「按量付费 API 和 Token Plan 团队版」,同页「重要」框写明 Token Plan 个人版与 Coding Plan 的数据使用条款不同(使用 Coding Plan 期间输入与生成内容将用于服务改进与模型优化),那两档不在本 provider 范围。**客户侧例外**:开启推理日志后可用 Log backflow 把日志回流入自己的训练数据集(telemetry/backflow 锚点),这是客户主动行为,不是厂商拿数据训练。**三方模型例外**:走 Model Studio 三方模型(DeepSeek/Kimi/GLM 等)时,数据处理由厂商直接提供并适用厂商条款(§4.48.2),本条的「不训练」承诺只覆盖阿里云自有模型链路

zdr.quote: In compliance with relevant laws and regulations, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio stores data generated from model and application calls.
searched: WebSearch(EN): Alibaba Cloud Model Studio "zero data retention" / "no retention" / "we do not store" prompts
WebSearch(ZH): 阿里云百炼 国际站 零数据保留 / 不存储 API 输入输出

points.text: After exhausting the international-site channels there is **no** zero-retention (ZDR) commitment, switch or application process: ZDR appears nowhere in Product ToS §4.48
points.text_zh: 国际站渠道穷尽后**没有**任何零保留(ZDR)承诺、开关或申请流程:Product ToS §4.48 全文无 ZDR

points.text: The DPA has no "no retention" clause (it has the opposite: deletion or return on termination, plus retention where required by law)
points.text_zh: DPA 无「不保留」条款(反而有终止时删除/返还 + 法律要求可保留)

points.text: The Membership Agreement only commits to not accessing or using Member Content except as necessary, and to deletion on termination
points.text_zh: 会员协议只承诺「非必要不访问/使用」与终止时删除

points.text: The privacy notice says the opposite in plain terms: Model Studio "stores data generated from model and application calls"
points.text_zh: 隐私说明反而明说会存储调用产生的数据

points.text: model-telemetry offers logging switches (audit logs on by default, inference logs off by default), not "discarded once processed"
points.text_zh: model-telemetry 提供的是日志开关(审计日志默认开、推理日志默认关),不是「处理完即弃」

points.text: The related-agreements list and the Security and Compliance directory (4 sub-pages) were checked page by page with no ZDR found
points.text_zh: 相关协议清单与 Security and Compliance 目录(4 个子页)逐页核查无 ZDR

points.text: The commitment on the Chinese-language product page of the international site goes no further than "not used for training". A distinction to keep: inference logs off by default plus delivery to the customer's own SLS only means the customer can keep content-bearing logs from being retained on Alibaba Cloud's side, which is not zero data retention (the request still has to be processed, and audit logs and monitoring metrics stay on the platform by default). Recorded as mark=no (express denial): the privacy notice states that call-generated data is stored, i.e. no zero retention is offered at terms level — this is not "undisclosed". The searched scope is kept in full
points.text_zh: 国际站中文产品页的承诺也只到「不用于训练」。注意区分:推理日志默认关闭 + 客户自有 SLS 只是「客户可不让阿里云侧留存含内容的日志」,不等于零数据保留(请求仍需处理,审计日志与监控指标默认留在平台侧)。结论记 mark=no(明确否定类):隐私说明明示会存储调用产生的数据,即条款层不提供零保留,不是「未披露」;searched 范围仍列全

retention.quote: at Your choice, delete or return all Data in Alibaba Cloud’s possession or control following the termination of the Agreement

points.text: Recorded by object, not merged: (1) **Input and output content**: the international Model Studio privacy notice states plainly that Model Studio "stores data generated from model and application calls", but no uniform retention period in days is published anywhere on the site
points.text_zh: 分对象记,不要合并:(1) **输入输出正文**:国际站 Model Studio 隐私说明明说「stores data generated from model and application calls」,但全站未公布统一保留天数

points.text: DPA §4(g) commits, following termination of the Agreement, to "at Your choice, delete or return all Data in Alibaba Cloud's possession or control", and DPA Appendix 1 (used to fill in Annex I of the EU SCCs) records the retention period as "Data will be processed and transferred for the duration of the Agreement" (period type = duration of the agreement, not a fixed number of days)
points.text_zh: DPA §4(g) 承诺协议终止时按客户选择删除或返还 Data,DPA Appendix 1(用于填 EU SCC 的 Annex I)载明保留期为「Data will be processed and transferred for the duration of the Agreement」(期限类型=协议存续期,不是固定天数)

points.text: The termination clause of the Membership Agreement instead says "we will delete such Member Content at our sole discretion unless retention is required under applicable law" — deletion after termination is **discretionary**, and data may be kept where the law requires it. (2) **Audit logs (metadata, no Prompt/Response)**: on by default, stored on the platform
points.text_zh: 会员协议终止条款则写「we will delete such Member Content at our sole discretion unless retention is required under applicable law」——即终止后删除是**裁量性**的,且法律要求可保留。(2) **审计日志(元数据,不含 Prompt/Response)**:默认开启、平台侧存储

points.text: The query window is "Last 7 days by default; supports querying logs for up to 30 days" (this is a **query window, not a deletion deadline**; no deletion after 30 days can be inferred from it). (3) **Inference logs (full Prompt/Response, truncated at 128KB)**: off by default, must be enabled manually and delivered to the customer's own SLS Logstore, and can be recycled into training datasets. (4) **Task data and result URLs of the asynchronous media APIs**: expressly "available for 24 hours and is then automatically deleted" (the only object with an explicit period). (5) **Account-level personal data**: under §F of the international-site privacy policy, kept as long as there is an ongoing legitimate business need, until the account is closed. (6) Product ToS §4.48.1(g)(iv) points the other way: data provided to or stored by Alibaba Cloud may be removed or rendered inaccessible from time to time, and customers must keep their own redundancy. Confidence medium: at contract level there is only "delete or return on termination" and "the duration of the Agreement", no default retention period, and the DPA applies only where data protection legislation requires it
points.text_zh: 查询窗口默认 7 天、最长 30 天(这是**查询窗口,不是删除期限**,不能反推 30 天后删除)。(3) **推理日志(含完整 Prompt/Response,128KB 截断)**:默认关闭、需手动开启并投递到客户自有 SLS Logstore,可回流入训练数据集。(4) **异步媒体 API 的任务数据与结果 URL**:明确「available for 24 hours and is then automatically deleted」(唯一给出明确期限的对象)。(5) **账号类个人数据**:国际站隐私政策 §F 按持续正当业务需要,账号注销为止。(6) Product ToS §4.48.1(g)(iv) 反向提示:阿里云侧数据可能被移除或不可访问,客户须自备冗余。置信度 medium:合同层只有「终止时删除/返还」与「协议存续期」,没有默认保留期限,且 DPA 仅在数据保护法要求时适用

processing_region.quote: Regions determine the **access point and data storage location**.

points.text: developer_data (high): the Regions documentation — "Regions determine the access point and data storage location", "Request data is stored in that region.", "Your static data always remains in the selected region." — the storage location and access point are set by the selected region
points.text_zh: developer_data(高):地域文档「Regions determine the access point and data storage location」「Request data is stored in that region.」「Your static data always remains in the selected region.」——数据存放地与接入点由所选 region 决定

points.text: Where inference runs is set by the service deployment scope (Global or a geographic-boundary scope, one or the other; Singapore has only International, China (Beijing) has only mainland China). Contractual support: Product ToS §4.48.1(g)(viii) "Member Content … will be transferred to, stored, and processed in the country where Alibaba Cloud, its affiliates, or its sub-contractors maintain facilities for Model Studio Service", plus the customer's designation
points.text_zh: 推理执行地由 service deployment scope 决定(Global 与地理边界 scope 二选一,Singapore 只有 International、China (Beijing) 只有中国大陆)。合同佐证:Product ToS §4.48.1(g)(viii)「Member Content … will be transferred to, stored, and processed in the country where Alibaba Cloud, its affiliates, or its sub-contractors maintain facilities for Model Studio Service」+ 客户指定

points.text: DPA §6.1「You decide where to store Data (Selected Region)」

Trust Center FAQ 4.2: "only stores and processes each customer's content in the Alibaba Cloud Region(s) that is chosen by the customer". **Boundary**: with the Global scope selected, inference nodes may cross geographic boundaries (stated in the docs), so "data does not leave the selected region" holds for storage and static data but not for inference execution
points.text_zh: Trust Center FAQ 4.2「only stores and processes each customer's content in the Alibaba Cloud Region(s) that is chosen by the customer」。**边界**:选 Global scope 时推理节点可跨地理边界(文档明示),故「数据不离开所选 region」只对存储与静态数据成立,对推理执行不成立

points.text: The China site (Beijing region, dashscope.aliyuncs.com) and the Hong Kong region both sit in the alibabacloud.com region list, but the China site has a different account system and contracting entity and must be kept separate from alibaba-cn
points.text_zh: 中国站(Beijing region, dashscope.aliyuncs.com)与香港 region 同在 alibabacloud.com 的 region 列表内,但中国站账号体系与协议主体不同,须与 alibaba-cn 分开

role.quote: You (the controller or processor) appoint Alibaba Cloud as Your processor to process the Data, for the duration of the Agreement, solely for the purpose of providing the Alibaba Cloud Services to You

points.text: contract (high): DPA §3 "You (the controller or processor) appoint Alibaba Cloud as Your processor to process the Data, for the duration of the Agreement, solely for the purpose of providing the Alibaba Cloud Services to You", plus Appendix 1 for the data importer: "Role (controller/processor): Processor"
points.text_zh: contract(高):DPA §3「You (the controller or processor) appoint Alibaba Cloud as Your processor to process the Data, for the duration of the Agreement, solely for the purpose of providing the Alibaba Cloud Services to You」+ Appendix 1 数据进口方「Role (controller/processor):Processor」

points.text: Product ToS §4.48.1(b)「Any processing of Member Content … is for your purposes and on your behalf」

The DPA is incorporated into the Membership Agreement as an annex (annex list: "Data Processing Addendum to Alibaba Cloud Membership Agreement Applicable to all users"). **Two exceptions that must be stated plainly**: (1) under §1 the DPA applies only where Data Protection Legislation requires it, and only to "personal data contained in or generated in relation to Your Member Content" processed as a processor — personal data collected for Alibaba Cloud's own purposes, such as account registration, is still controller data (the international-site privacy policy carries the dual-role wording "In cases where we act as a processor…")
points.text_zh: DPA 附件形式并入会员协议(会员协议附件清单「Data Processing Addendum to Alibaba Cloud Membership Agreement Applicable to all users」)。**两个必须写清的例外**:①DPA 按 §1 仅在数据保护法要求时适用,且只覆盖「以 processor 身份处理的 Member Content 个人信息」——账号注册等以阿里云自身目的收集的个人数据仍是 controller(国际站隐私政策有「In cases where we act as a processor…」的双角色表述)

points.text: (2) When a third-party model API on Model Studio is used, Product ToS §4.48.2(c) states plainly that "Alibaba Cloud does not perform the role of data processor or controller with respect to any personal data processed by such Third-party Model Service"; the Marketplace Supplemental says the same, and the third-party model terms add that the Marketplace platform side "have no access to …; will not process …" End User Data — in that path Alibaba Cloud is not the processor of that chain, and the role is taken up by the vendor's EULA / vendor DPA (the vendor being Processor or sub-Processor). **Entity**: the default contracting entity on the international site is Alibaba Cloud (Singapore) Private Limited (with separate entities for the EEA/UK, the United States and Malaysia), not the same entity as Tongyi Yunqi (Hangzhou) on the China site
points.text_zh: ②走 Model Studio 三方模型 API 时,Product ToS §4.48.2(c) 明确「Alibaba Cloud does not perform the role of data processor or controller with respect to any personal data processed by such Third-party Model Service」,Marketplace Supplemental 同义,三方模型条款进一步写明 Marketplace 平台方对 End User Data「have no access to …; will not process …」——此时阿里云不是该链路的 processor,角色由厂商 EULA/厂商 DPA 承接(厂商为 Processor/sub-Processor)。**主体**:国际站默认签约主体 Alibaba Cloud (Singapore) Private Limited(EEA/UK/美国/马来西亚另有主体),与中国站通义云启(杭州)不是同一实体

training.quote: 我们不会在未获您授权的情况下使用您的对话数据训练我们的模型。

points.text: 分三层：①**合同层（国际站）**——Product Terms 4.48.1(viii)『the Member Content you provide to Alibaba Cloud will be transferred to, stored, and processed in the country where Alibaba Cloud, its affiliates, or its sub-contractors maintain facilities for Model Studio Service』，处理地即阿里云及其关联方/分包商设施所在国，不承诺驻留。②**产品文档层（国际站）**——地域决定接入点与数据存储位置，请求数据存储在所选地域，『Your static data always remains in the selected region』
points.text_zh: 分三层：①**合同层（国际站）**——Product Terms 4.48.1(viii)『the Member Content you provide to Alibaba Cloud will be transferred to, stored, and processed in the country where Alibaba Cloud, its affiliates, or its sub-contractors maintain facilities for Model Studio Service』，处理地即阿里云及其关联方/分包商设施所在国，不承诺驻留。②**产品文档层（国际站）**——地域决定接入点与数据存储位置，请求数据存储在所选地域，『Your static data always remains in the selected region』

points.text: 但同页明确『Service deployment scope: Determines the inference execution location… Otherwise, select the Global scope for a larger inference resource pool』——即**存储地与推理执行地不是同一个变量**，选 Global scope 时推理可跨地域执行，这是本轮新增的关键限定（上一轮只记了「请求数据存储在所选地域」）。③**本档具体化**——Coding Plan 控制台订阅页固定 ap-southeast-1（国际站产品简介页链接 modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/ap-southeast-1/subscription/coding-plan），专属 base URL 为 coding-intl.dashscope.aliyuncs.com（工作区域端点 {WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com），故判存储在新加坡。国内站协议 6.2.8 另有「在您选定的服务及模型服务所在国家或地区处理客户业务数据」的同旨表述（国内站协议，适用性同 training 的 caveat）。置信度 medium 的原因：结论由「产品文档接入点 + 地域机制 + 合同层表述」合成，且推理执行地本身可变。

points.text: Based on article 8956058 (dated June 9, 2026): qualified Claude API (Claude Platform) and Claude Code for Enterprise customers can have a ZDR arrangement after Anthropic approval, under which "Anthropic does not store their inputs or outputs except where needed to comply with law or combat misuse or harm"; User Safety classification results are still retained

points.text: ZDR requests are approved organization by organization ("ZDR is enabled per organization; each new organization requires ZDR to be enabled separately by your account team"), and Claude Platform users can confirm it under Settings > Privacy Controls > Data retention period. The same article states expressly that these arrangements "are distinct from Anthropic's default approach to data retention" (= the 30-day rule in 7996866). For the feature-level scope (which endpoints are eligible, and that stateful features such as Batch, Files and code execution are not), see api-and-data-retention — that page was marked contradiction this round because its retention statement conflicts with 7996866, so it is no longer used as a basis for this dimension (the anchor is kept and fetched daily).
points.text_zh: ZDR 请求按 organization 逐一审批,Claude Platform 用户可在 Settings > Privacy Controls > Data retention period 确认。该文并把 ZDR 安排与「Anthropic’s default approach to data retention」(=7996866 的 30 天口径)明确区分。功能级适用范围(哪些 endpoint 合格、Batch/Files/Code execution 等有状态功能不适用)见 api-and-data-retention——该页本轮因 retention 口径与 7996866 冲突已标 contradiction,故不再作为本维度的依据(锚点保留、每天抓)。

training.quote: 使用该内容训练模型和改进相关服务的权利

points.text: Conclusion for the consumer tier: there is an explicit training license for content that is "publicly published, disseminated or shared", while ordinary conversation input is covered only by service-improvement wording. Basis: Baichuan User Agreement (2025-09-28) §4.5: "your act of publicly publishing, disseminating or sharing content in any form — images, text, audio, digital works, livestreams, video and so on — through this product represents that you have the right to grant, and agree to grant, the Company a worldwide, free … (4) right to use that content to train models and improve the related services…" — the licensed object is publicly published content, and the license is obtained through conduct ("the act represents the grant") rather than per-instance consent
points.text_zh: 消费档结论：对「公开发布、传播、分享」的内容有明确的训练授权，对普通对话输入只有服务改进口径。依据：《百川用户协议》(2025-09-28) §四.5「您使用本产品将图片、文字、音频、数字作品、直播或视频等各种形式的内容…公开发布、传播、分享的行为代表了您有权许可且同意许可本公司在全世界范围内，免费…（4）使用该内容训练模型和改进相关服务的权利…」——授权对象是公开发布的内容，且以「行为代表许可」的方式取得，非逐次同意

points.text: §6.1 separately grants a worldwide, free, sublicensable license covering "all data, information or content generated in the course of your use of this product", worded as "use in any form". On the conversation-input side: main-site privacy policy §1.1.2 "your text conversation information will also be used to improve Baichuan's response speed and quality", and §1.4 uses anonymized information for academic research or statistical analysis in order to "continuously improve the algorithmic models". Evidence to the contrary: User Agreement §5.5 only prohibits users from using Baichuan data to train "other" AI products
points.text_zh: §六.1 另授予覆盖「您在使用本产品过程中产生的所有数据、信息或内容」的全球免费可转许可，措辞「任何形式地使用」。对话输入侧：主站隐私政策 §1.1.2「您的文本对话信息还会被用来提高百川的响应速度和质量」，§1.4 匿名化后用于学术研究/统计分析以「不断改进算法模型」。反向证据：用户协议 §五.5 只禁止用户用百川数据训练「其他」AI 产品

points.text: There is no "not used for training" commitment and no description of an opt-out switch. Uncertainty: whether "improving response speed and quality" amounts to training has not been clarified by the vendor.
points.text_zh: 无「不用于训练」承诺、无退出开关说明。不确定性：「提高响应速度和质量」是否等同训练，厂商未澄清。

zdr.quote: 为履行网络信息安全义务，我们会在法律规定的时间内保留您的问答历史及对话主题。

points.text: The consumer tier has no ZDR wording and no application path; what the terms do state is retention (see below), hence mark=no rather than undisclosed
points.text_zh: 消费档无 ZDR 术语、也无申请入口；条款明示的是留存（见下条），故记 mark=no 而非「未披露」

points.text: The retention of Q&A history in main-site privacy policy §1.1.3 and the service-improvement use in §1.1.2 are incompatible with "zero retention". The main site has no sitemap.xml (404), so exhaustive enumeration through a site map is not possible and the searched list is limited to the documents actually fetched this round.
points.text_zh: 主站隐私政策 §1.1.3 的问答历史留存与 §1.1.2 的服务改进使用与「零保留」相斥。主站无 sitemap.xml（404），无法用站点地图做穷尽枚举，故 searched 列表以本轮实际抓取到的文档为限。

retention.quote: 为履行网络信息安全义务，我们会在法律规定的时间内保留您的问答历史及对话主题。

points.text: Consumer-tier retention has to be split by object: (1) Q&A history (input text conversation information and conversation topics) — main-site privacy policy §1.1.3: "in order to perform network information security obligations, we will retain your Q&A history and conversation topics for the period prescribed by law", which is a **floor**-type statement (retained as long as the law requires) and cannot be read backwards as "deleted when the period ends"
points.text_zh: 消费档 retention 要分对象：(1) 问答历史（输入文本对话信息与对话主题）——主站隐私政策 §1.1.3「为履行网络信息安全义务，我们会在法律规定的时间内保留您的问答历史及对话主题」，这是**下限**型口径（法律要求留多久就留多久），不能反推「到期即删除」

points.text: The same sentence also says "you can find and manage the Q&A history that has not yet been deleted", showing that history is retained by default and managed by the user. (2) Personal information overall — §5: "unless laws and regulations require otherwise, we will store your personal information only for the shortest time necessary to achieve the purpose you authorized". (3) Deleted or anonymized once a deletion request is acted on, with delayed deletion from backups (§4.2)
points.text_zh: 同一句还写「您可以查找并管理尚未删除的问答历史」，说明历史默认留存、由用户自行管理。(2) 个人信息总体——§5「除非法律法规另有要求，我们对您的个人信息的存储时间将限于实现您授权使用的目的所必需的最短时间」。(3) 删除请求响应后删除或匿名化，备份延迟删除（§4.2）

points.text: Deleted or anonymized promptly after account cancellation (§4.4)
points.text_zh: 注销后及时删除或匿名化（§4.4）

points.text: Deleted or anonymized if operations cease (§5). No quantified number of days anywhere. Note that the platform-tier policy has no Q&A history retention sentence; the two are not interchangeable.
points.text_zh: 停止运营时删除或匿名化（§5）。无任何量化天数。注意平台档政策没有问答历史留存句，两份不可互换。

processing_region.quote: 在本政策下所收集及处理的个人信息不存在出境的情况。

points.text: Main-site privacy policy §5: "we store personal information collected and generated in operations within China inside China. The personal information collected and processed under this policy is not transferred outside the territory." — one sentence more than the platform tier ("not transferred outside the territory"). Supporting: User Agreement §12.4 limits use to mainland China. The subject is still "personal information"; where the compute sits is not disclosed.
points.text_zh: 主站隐私政策 §5「我们会将在中国境内运营所收集和产生的个人信息存储在中国境内。在本政策下所收集及处理的个人信息不存在出境的情况。」——比平台档多一句「不存在出境的情况」。辅助：用户协议 §十二.4 使用地限中国大陆。对象仍是「个人信息」，未披露算力所在地。

role.quote: 在本政策下所收集及处理的个人信息不存在出境的情况。

points.text: On the consumer tier Baichuan provides the service directly to individual users and collects their personal information for its own purposes (§1.1.1 account, §1.1.2 human-machine conversation, §1.2.1 logs), which makes it an independent controller. The User Agreement §5.1 description of itself as "a neutral network service provider" only disclaims liability for third-party content behind search links and is not a PIPL role self-designation. No DPA and no entrusted-processing scenario. Confidence low: this tier has no role clause of any kind, the classification is inferred from the processing structure, and this row is not the provider's main tier.
points.text_zh: 消费档由百川直接向个人用户提供服务并收集其个人信息用于自身目的（§1.1.1 账户、§1.1.2 人机交互对话、§1.2.1 日志），属独立控制者。用户协议 §五.1 自称「作为中立的网络服务提供者」仅针对搜索链接的第三方内容免责，不是 PIPL 角色自认。无 DPA、无受托场景。置信度 low：本档无任何角色自认条款，纯属按处理结构推定，且本行不是本 provider 的主档。

points.text: The "Model APIs" entry in the Security Practices states in the same paragraph that a ZDR posture applies to all Customer Content. For the third-party model tier there is also SML §6/§9.B: customer content (prompts and request-level logs included) is not forwarded to Model Lab.
points.text_zh: Security Practices「Model APIs」条目同段即声明对 all Customer Content 持 ZDR。第三方模型档另有 SML §6/§9.B：不向 Model Lab 转发客户内容（含 prompt 与请求级日志）。

zdr.quote: Baseten's Model APIs product adheres to a Zero Data Retention posture for all Customer Content. Baseten will not store, retain, or otherwise make a persistent copy of model inputs or outputs during a customer's use of the Model APIs.

points.text: This product is named in the Security Practices as operating under a ZDR posture, and ZDR is the default configuration (no application required).
points.text_zh: 该产品被 Security Practices 点名为 ZDR 姿态，且 ZDR 是默认配置（无需申请）。

retention.quote: Baseten's Model APIs product adheres to a Zero Data Retention posture for all Customer Content. Baseten will not store, retain, or otherwise make a persistent copy of model inputs or outputs during a customer's use of the Model APIs.

points.text: Security Practices「Model APIs」：Baseten will not store, retain, or otherwise make a persistent copy of model inputs or outputs during a customer's use of the Model APIs

The same section defines ZDR as (a) not logging, recording or saving Customer Content, and (b) not saving Customer Content to persistent storage (hard disk, SSD, cloud storage, database) after real-time processing. The async exception is the same as at top level (72 hours).
points.text_zh: 同节把 ZDR 定义为 (a) 不 log/record/store 客户内容、(b) 不在实时处理之后把客户内容保存到持久存储（硬盘、SSD、云存储、数据库）。异步档例外同顶层（72 小时）。

processing_region.quote: **Global** is the default when neither a deployment region nor a compliance policy limits placement. Baseten can place replicas in any region where the requested compute is available.

points.text: The public documentation does not say which region Model APIs (platform-hosted models) run in: the available-regions table on the regional deployments page covers only customer-deployed models (GPU instances) and states expressly that region selection applies to model deployments
points.text_zh: 公开文档未说明 Model APIs（平台托管模型）运行在哪个区域：regional deployments 页的可用区域表只针对客户自部署模型（GPU 实例），且明说区域选择适用于 model deployments

points.text: There is no corresponding region-selection documentation for Model APIs. Inferring from the default Global rule would overreach, so this is recorded as undisclosed rather than as a commitment.
points.text_zh: Model APIs 没有对应的区域选择说明。按默认 Global 规则推断会越界，故记未披露而非承诺。

role.quote: The Parties acknowledge and agree that with regard to the Processing of Customer Personal Data: (a) Baseten acts as a Processor; (b) Customer acts as a Controller, or as a Processor on behalf of its own controllers; and (c) Baseten will engage Sub-Processors pursuant to Section 7.

points.text: Same as the top level. On the third-party model tier, Model Lab is not a sub-processor of the customer and Baseten does not forward customer content (SML §6).
points.text_zh: 同顶层。第三方模型档下 Model Lab 不是客户 sub-processor，Baseten 不转发客户内容（SML §6）。

training.quote: Baseten will not use Customer Content, including Customer Models, Model Outputs, or inference logs, to train, fine-tune, or otherwise develop machine learning or artificial intelligence models.

points.text: Same as the top level. The definition of Customer Model expressly includes associated weights, checkpoints, adapters and configurations, so weights are within the scope of §6.3 as well.
points.text_zh: 同顶层。Customer Model 定义明确包含 associated weights、checkpoints、adapters、configurations，故权重也在 §6.3 覆盖范围内。

zdr.quote: Baseten's Dedicated Inference product adheres to a Zero Data Retention posture for Customer Model inputs and outputs.

points.text: This product is named as operating under a ZDR posture
points.text_zh: 该产品被点名持 ZDR 姿态

points.text: ZDR is the default configuration.
points.text_zh: ZDR 是默认配置。

retention.quote: Baseten's Dedicated Inference product adheres to a Zero Data Retention posture for Customer Model inputs and outputs.

points.text: Security Practices "Dedicated Inference": a Zero Data Retention posture for Customer Model inputs and outputs, with no persistent copy made
points.text_zh: Security Practices「Dedicated Inference」：对 Customer Model 输入输出持 ZDR、不做持久副本

points.text: "Dedicated Inference (non-input/output data)": for thirty (30) days after the end of the subscription term the customer may retrieve remaining Customer Content (such as Customer Models), which is deleted once that period ends
points.text_zh: 「Dedicated Inference (non-input/output data)」：订阅期结束后 30 天内可取回剩余 Customer Content（如 Customer Models），期满即删除

points.text: "Customer Model Weights": weights are loaded dynamically into GPU memory and are not persisted to storage by default; where weight caching is enabled, cached weights can be permanently deleted on request
points.text_zh: 「Customer Model Weights」：权重动态载入 GPU 内存、默认不持久化，开启 weight caching 后可要求永久删除

points.text: The KV cache lives only in GPU memory and is not written to disk (docs/observability/security).
points.text_zh: KV cache 只在 GPU 内存、不落盘（docs/observability/security）。

processing_region.quote:
| Region slug | Location |
| --- | --- |
| `us` | United States |
| `eu` | European Union |

points.text: This is the only product whose region can be chosen: a regional deployment supports `us` / `eu`, and with no selection it is Global (any region with available compute)
points.text_zh: 本档是唯一可自选区域的产品：regional deployment 支持 `us`/`eu`，不选则 Global（可在任何有算力的区域）

points.text: An organization compliance policy can restrict placement further and cannot be overridden
points.text_zh: 组织合规策略可进一步限制且不可被覆盖

points.text: There are also regional environments configured on Baseten's side that confine the models and Chains of an entire environment to a specified region.
points.text_zh: 另有 Baseten 侧配置的 regional environments 把整个 environment 的模型与 Chain 限制在指定区域。

role.quote: The Parties acknowledge and agree that with regard to the Processing of Customer Personal Data: (a) Baseten acts as a Processor; (b) Customer acts as a Controller, or as a Processor on behalf of its own controllers; and (c) Baseten will engage Sub-Processors pursuant to Section 7.

points.text: Same as the top level. Baseten only provides the infrastructure layer that runs the customer's inference workloads (Security Practices "Infrastructure-Only Processing").
points.text_zh: 同顶层。Baseten 只提供基础设施层运行客户推理负载（Security Practices「Infrastructure-Only Processing」）。

training.quote: Baseten does not use Customer Content for model training, fine-tuning, or improvement of any algorithms.

points.text: The same contractual provisions as at top level (Terms §6.3 / DPA §9 / Security Practices "Infrastructure-Only Processing") apply to this tier.
points.text_zh: 同顶层合同（Terms §6.3 / DPA §9 / Security Practices「Infrastructure-Only Processing」）对本档同样适用。

zdr.summary: 是，但由部署形态决定而非承诺
zdr.summary_en: Yes, but by deployment, not a commitment
zdr.quote: **Payload retention**: Baseten doesn’t store synchronous inference inputs or outputs.

points.text: On this tier "no retention" is guaranteed by the architecture (payloads never leave the customer's environment), not by a commitment alone
points.text_zh: 本档的「不保留」由架构保证（payload 不出客户环境）而非仅靠承诺

points.text: The ZDR posture in the Security Practices, being "across all inference products", covers this tier too.
points.text_zh: Security Practices 的 ZDR 姿态对 all inference products 同样覆盖本档。

retention.quote: **Payload retention**: Baseten doesn’t store synchronous inference inputs or outputs.

points.text: docs/hosting-options/self-hosted「Payload retention」：Baseten doesn't store synchronous inference inputs or outputs

Async inputs queue inside the customer's own infrastructure until the request is executed (the queue ceiling is the 72-hour parameter in the async documentation). Note that some platform data still passes through Baseten on this tier: model code and container images travel through the control plane, metrics and billing data are sent back, and logs and metrics stay in the customer's cluster but are queried remotely by Baseten — the page gives no retention period for that platform data, so duration_kind is recorded as unspecified.
points.text_zh: 异步输入在客户自己的基础设施内排队直到请求执行（排队上限见 async 文档的 72 小时参数）。注意本档部分平台数据仍会经过 Baseten：model code 与 container image 经 control plane，metrics 与 billing 数据回传，logs 与 metrics 留在客户集群但 Baseten 远程查询——该页未给出这些平台数据的保留期限，故 duration_kind 记 unspecified。

processing_region.quote: Inference payloads never leave your environment.

points.text: Inference payloads never leave your environment

The workload plane runs in the customer's VPC, deployed in a single provider region (AWS/GCP/OCI, with several workload planes possible across regions and clouds). Security Practices "Deployment Options" says the same: "No Customer Content leaves the customer's environment." The processing location is therefore chosen by the customer and not designated by Baseten.
points.text_zh: workload plane 在客户 VPC、按单一 provider region 部署（AWS/GCP/OCI，可跨区域跨云部署多个 workload plane）。Security Practices「Deployment Options」同旨：No Customer Content leaves the customer's environment。即处理地由客户选择，Baseten 不指定。

role.quote: The Parties acknowledge and agree that with regard to the Processing of Customer Personal Data: (a) Baseten acts as a Processor; (b) Customer acts as a Controller, or as a Processor on behalf of its own controllers; and (c) Baseten will engage Sub-Processors pursuant to Section 7.

points.text: Same as the top level: the DPA role for personal data remains Processor. On this tier Baseten touches inference payloads even less (the workload plane sits on the customer's side), but the control plane still processes some platform data, so the role determination is unchanged.
points.text_zh: 同顶层：DPA 对个人数据的角色仍为 Processor。本档中 Baseten 对推理 payload 实际接触更少（workload plane 在客户侧），但控制面仍处理部分平台数据，故角色判定不变。

training.quote: Baseten does not use Customer Content for model training, fine-tuning, or improvement of any algorithms.

points.text: "Training" on this tier means the customer training or fine-tuning their own model
points.text_zh: 本档「训练」是客户对自己模型做训练/微调

points.text: On Baseten's side, Terms §6.3 / DPA §9 still bar the use of Customer Content to train Baseten's own models. docs/loops/train-on-your-data and docs/training/your-own-data are how-to guides (classified not_policy) and cannot support or rebut this dimension.
points.text_zh: Baseten 侧仍受 Terms §6.3 / DPA §9 约束不得用 Customer Content 训练自己的模型。docs/loops/train-on-your-data 与 docs/training/your-own-data 是使用教程（判 not_policy），不能用来支撑或反驳本维度。

zdr.quote: For thirty (30) days after the end of a customer's subscription term, Baseten will provide the customer access to the Services to allow retrieval of Customer Content.

points.text: The ZDR posture is worded as "across all inference products", whereas training data and checkpoints are storage-type data (kept until 30 days after the end of the subscription term) and fall outside zero retention of inference inputs and outputs. Request-level ZDR therefore does not apply to this tier; only the 30-day post-term retrieval window and the deletion commitment do.
points.text_zh: ZDR 姿态的表述是「across all inference products」，而训练数据与 checkpoint 属存储型数据（保留到订阅期结束后 30 天），不在推理输入输出的零保留范围内。即本档不适用请求级 ZDR，只有终止后 30 天取回期与删除承诺。
points.quote: Baseten adheres to a Zero Data Retention ("**ZDR**") posture across all inference products. Unless a customer, acting through an authorized representative, requests otherwise in writing, ZDR is the default configuration for the customer's use of the inference products; Baseten does not log Customer Content contained in inference inputs or outputs for human review; and Baseten will not retain Customer Content contained in inference inputs or outputs at rest without the customer's prior written consent.

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 30 天
retention.quote: For thirty (30) days after the end of a customer's subscription term, Baseten will provide the customer access to the Services to allow retrieval of Customer Content.

points.text: Security Practices "DATA RETENTION FOR OTHER PRODUCTS / Training": "For thirty (30) days after the end of a customer's subscription term, Baseten will provide the customer access to the Services to allow retrieval of Customer Content. After such thirty (30) day period, Baseten will promptly delete all remaining Customer Content in its possession." — the object is Customer Content (training data and checkpoints included)
points.text_zh: Security Practices「DATA RETENTION FOR OTHER PRODUCTS / Training」：For thirty (30) days after the end of a customer's subscription term, Baseten will provide the customer access to the Services to allow retrieval of Customer Content. After such thirty (30) day period, Baseten will promptly delete all remaining Customer Content in its possession. —— 对象是 Customer Content（含训练数据与 checkpoint）

points.text: Residual backup copies are separately covered by a "limited period" (not quantified).
points.text_zh: 备份残余另有「有限期间」（未量化）。

processing_region.quote: **Global** is the default when neither a deployment region nor a compliance policy limits placement. Baseten can place replicas in any region where the requested compute is available.

points.text: docs/deployment/regional-deployments states expressly that regional selection applies only to model deployments — "Chains and training jobs can't select a region" — so training jobs have no region selection and no default region is disclosed; recorded as undisclosed (and not to be read in reverse as a commitment to any region).
points.text_zh: docs/deployment/regional-deployments 明说 regional selection 只适用于 model deployments，「Chains and training jobs can't select a region」——训练作业没有区域选择能力，也未披露默认区域，故记未披露（不得反向解读为承诺在某一区域）。

role.quote: The Parties acknowledge and agree that with regard to the Processing of Customer Personal Data: (a) Baseten acts as a Processor; (b) Customer acts as a Controller, or as a Processor on behalf of its own controllers; and (c) Baseten will engage Sub-Processors pursuant to Section 7.

points.text: Same as the top level.
points.text_zh: 同顶层。

training.quote: Enterprise and Team customers under an MSA or DPA are excluded from model training and data sharing.

retention.quote: Personal information and user content associated with an account are retained while the account remains active.

processing_region.quote: StackBlitz, Inc. is headquartered in the United States, and personal information may be transferred to, processed, and stored in countries outside of your jurisdiction, including the United States.

training.quote: Unless you opt out and subject to the regional and consent rules below, we may use Bolt Model Development Content that is eligible under “Prospective Application” below to train, fine-tune, evaluate, benchmark, and improve artificial-intelligence models developed by or for StackBlitz.

points.text: 默认可将 prompts、outputs、代码、项目文件、错误/fix traces、tool invocations 与 edit histories 用于训练/微调/评测并制作许可数据集；可免费退出，最长 15 天实施且不追溯已训练模型或已交付数据集。EEA/UK/CH 账户默认排除。Bolt Forge 启用时另受其内容使用条件约束。
points.text_zh: 默认可将 prompts、outputs、代码、项目文件、错误/fix traces、tool invocations 与 edit histories 用于训练/微调/评测并制作许可数据集；可免费退出，最长 15 天实施且不追溯已训练模型或已交付数据集。EEA/UK/CH 账户默认排除。Bolt Forge 启用时另受其内容使用条件约束。

retention.summary: 按对象分列留至服务终止
retention.quote: Personal information and user content associated with an account are retained while the account remains active.

points.text: 账户及项目内容在账户活跃期间保留；主动关户后不超过 30 天删除或匿名化，但备份、法律与安全例外未量化。向量索引与 prompt/cache 未单列期限。
points.text_zh: 账户及项目内容在账户活跃期间保留；主动关户后不超过 30 天删除或匿名化，但备份、法律与安全例外未量化。向量索引与 prompt/cache 未单列期限。

retention.quote: Personal information and user content associated with an account are retained while the account remains active.

processing_region.quote: StackBlitz, Inc. is headquartered in the United States, and personal information may be transferred to, processed, and stored in countries outside of your jurisdiction, including the United States.

training.quote: the foregoing does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models

points.text: Same as top-level training. The enterprise tier also has the purpose limitation in DPA §3.2.2 (no retaining, using, disclosing or otherwise processing Customer Personal Data for any purpose other than as necessary to provide the Services to Customer, as required by law, or on the customer's written instructions) and the use limitation in Inference Terms §3(c)
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training。企业档另有 DPA §3.2.2 的目的限制(只可为提供 Services、法律要求或客户书面指示处理),以及 Inference Terms §3(c) 的用途限定

points.text: But the enterprise contract text has no counterpart of the express ToS sentence "does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models", so the conclusion is somewhat weaker.
points.text_zh: 但企业档合同文本里没有 ToS 那句明文「不授予训练/微调权利」,结论强度略低。

points.text: Neither the DPA nor the Inference Terms contains a ZDR or zero-retention clause, and neither gives an application process or a switch
points.text_zh: DPA 与 Inference Terms 全文都没有 ZDR / 零保留条款,也没有申请流程或开关

points.text: DPA §3.2.2 ("will not retain, use, disclose, or otherwise Process such Customer Personal Data for any purpose other than as necessary to provide Services") is a purpose limitation, not a statement on this dimension: it says nothing about whether zero retention is offered, so it is no longer bound to this entry.
points.text_zh: DPA §3.2.2（「不得为提供服务以外的目的保留、使用、披露或处理」）是目的限制条款，不构成对 zdr 维度的表述：它没有说是否提供零保留，故不再绑在本条。

points.text: The Trust Center document list contains no ZDR addendum. ZDR on the enterprise tier rests only on blog wording such as "can enforce zero-data-retention policies per customer requirements" (official_blog level, and in an on-prem-leaning context), which is not a contractual commitment.
points.text_zh: Trust Center 的文档列表里没有 ZDR 附件。企业档的 ZDR 只能靠「按客户要求可实施」这类博客表述(官方_blog 层级,且语境偏 on-prem),不构成合同承诺。

retention.quote: The personal data are retained so long as the parties continue to maintain a business relationship in connection with the Agreement.

points.text: The enterprise tier is governed by the DPA: Annex I, "The personal data are retained so long as the parties continue to maintain a business relationship in connection with the Agreement."
points.text_zh: 企业档以 DPA 为准:Annex I「The personal data are retained so long as the parties continue to maintain a business relationship in connection with the Agreement.」

points.text: §3.2.2 allows retention and use only as necessary to provide the Services, as required by law, or on the customer's instructions
points.text_zh: §3.2.2 只允许为提供服务、法律要求或客户指示而保留/使用

points.text: §3.2.9: on expiry or termination of the Agreement, data is returned or destroyed at the customer's choice (except where required by law)
points.text_zh: §3.2.9 协议到期或终止时按客户选择返还或销毁(法律要求除外)

points.text: §3.2.7(i) supports deletion at the customer's request. This differs from the "We do not retain inputs and outputs" wording of Privacy Policy §6 on the self-serve tier, so the two rows are recorded side by side.
points.text_zh: §3.2.7(i) 支持按客户请求删除。与个人档隐私政策 §6「不保留输入输出」口径不同,两行并列。

processing_region.quote: List of subprocessors shall be provided in the following webpage on the Cerebras Trust Center

points.text: DPA §7 provides only for SCCs covering EEA/Switzerland/UK transfers to third countries (Modules 1/2/3 plus the UK Addendum, governed in Ireland), Annex I names the Irish DPC as supervisory authority, and the subprocessor list points to the Trust Center — none of which commits to a specific processing location or a selectable region. Recorded alongside Privacy Policy §9 (the United States and other countries) and the press release (100% United States).
points.text_zh: DPA §7 只约定 EEA/瑞士/英国→第三国的 SCC(Module 1/2/3 + UK Addendum,管辖地爱尔兰),Annex I 主管机关写 Irish DPC,子处理者清单指向 Trust Center——都没有承诺具体处理地或可选区域。与隐私政策 §9(美国 + 其他国家)、新闻稿(美国 100%)并列记录。

role.quote: Cerebras acts as a Processor, or if applicable, Sub-processor to Customer

points.text: The enterprise row of top-level role: DPA §2.1 plus the importer role in Annex I = Processor / Sub-processor
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role 的企业档一行:DPA §2.1 + Annex I 的 importer 角色 = Processor / Sub-processor

points.text: Inference Terms §5(a) routes the handling of personal information to the DPA.
points.text_zh: Inference Terms §5(a) 把个人信息处理引向 DPA。

training.quote: the foregoing does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models

points.text: The self-serve tier accepts the Website ToS, where "does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models" applies directly
points.text_zh: 自服务档接受的是 Website ToS,「does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models」直接适用

points.text: Usage Data (which excludes User Content and Outputs) may still be used for product improvement.
points.text_zh: Usage Data(不含 User Content)仍可用于产品改进。

zdr.quote: We do not retain inputs and outputs associated with our training, inference and chatbot Services.

points.text: Same as top-level zdr: nothing is retained at the content layer by default, but there is no ZDR programme that can be enabled
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr:内容层默认不保留,但没有可开通的 ZDR 方案

points.text: Logs and usage metadata are still retained and used.
points.text_zh: 日志与用量元数据仍会保留/使用。

retention.quote: We do not retain inputs and outputs associated with our training, inference and chatbot Services.

points.text: Points (1)(2)(3) of top-level retention: inputs and outputs are not retained, logs are deleted when they are no longer necessary to provide services, and the cache TTL is 5 minutes to 1 hour. The DPA does not apply to this tier.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 retention 的 (1)(2)(3):输入输出不保留、日志不再需要时删除、缓存 TTL 5 分钟~1 小时。DPA 不适用本档。

processing_region.quote: your data may be stored and processed in the United States and other countries outside the United States

points.text: Same as top-level processing_region. The self-serve tier has no DPA SCC mechanism, and the only statement of processing location is §9, "your data may be stored and processed in the United States and other countries outside the United States".
points.text_zh: 同顶层 processing_region。个人档没有 DPA 的 SCC 机制,处理地只有 §9 的「美国 + 其他国家」表述。

role.quote: Cerebras will process your personal data as an independent controller in accordance with its Privacy Policy.

points.text: Inference Terms preamble: when the Services are used in a personal capacity the DPA does not apply, and "Cerebras will process your personal data as an independent controller in accordance with its Privacy Policy"
points.text_zh: Inference Terms 前言:个人身份使用时 DPA 不适用,Cerebras 以 independent controller 身份依隐私政策处理

points.text: Privacy Policy §10(a) is to the same effect. Note that this anchor comes from the Inference Terms while self-serve sign-up may accept the Website ToS — the two texts do not overlap in how they state the role for the self-serve tier, which is the biggest uncertainty on this tier.
