training.quote: GitLab does not train generative AI models.

points.text: Conclusion: there is an express commitment not to use data for training (not_permitted). Both hops are covered at the contract/documentation layer: (1) GitLab itself — the data_usage page §Model training reads "GitLab does not train generative AI models."
points.text_zh: 结论：有明确承诺，不用于训练（not_permitted）。合同/文档层两跳都覆盖：①GitLab 自己 —— data_usage 页 §Model training 原句「GitLab does not train generative AI models.」

points.text: (2) the upstream model subprocessor hop — the same section: "All GitLab AI model sub-processors are restricted from using model input and output to train models. These sub-processors are under data protection agreements with GitLab that prohibit the use of customer content for their own purposes, except to perform their independent legal obligations." Scope: the opening sentence of that page covers all AI-native GitLab Duo features
points.text_zh: ②上游模型子处理商那一跳 —— 同节「All GitLab AI model sub-processors are restricted from using model input and output to train models. These sub-processors are under data protection agreements with GitLab that prohibit the use of customer content for their own purposes, except to perform their independent legal obligations.」适用范围：该页首句覆盖 GitLab Duo 全部 AI-native 功能

points.text: The same section of the Privacy Statement states expressly "This data may be collected in both the SaaS and Self-managed products where AI-features are enabled", so it applies to SaaS and to self-managed (including Dedicated) wherever GitLab-managed models are used
points.text_zh: Privacy Statement 同节明文「This data may be collected in both the SaaS and Self-managed products where AI-features are enabled」，故 SaaS / self-managed（含 Dedicated）用 GitLab 管理模型的场景都适用

points.text: Self-managed with bring-your-own models (Customer Models) falls outside GitLab's commitment. The conflicting side (no side taken; recorded alongside): (a) the AI section of the Privacy Statement uses conditional wording, "However, we will not use your AI-inputs to train any language models without your instruction or prior consent", and the same paragraph also says GitLab will "collect AI prompts and output to debug and troubleshoot the services" and collects "de-identified prompts ... for the purposes of identifying and developing product improvements" — i.e. "not trained on by default" rather than "never trained on", and the debugging collection of prompts and output is a separate purpose
points.text_zh: self-managed 自带模型（Customer Models）不在 GitLab 承诺范围内。冲突面（不选边，并列保留）：(a) Privacy Statement AI 节用的是条件式表述「However, we will not use your AI-inputs to train any language models without your instruction or prior consent」，同段还写明 GitLab 会「collect AI prompts and output to debug and troubleshoot the services」并收集「de-identified prompts ... for the purposes of identifying and developing product improvements」——即「默认不训练」而非「绝对不训练」，且 prompt/output 的调试收集是独立用途

points.text: (b) the AI Transparency Center's wording carries a time qualifier, "GitLab does not currently train its own models. No inputs to or outputs from GitLab Duo features are currently used to train any GitLab models." (official blog layer, the lowest authority)
points.text_zh: (b) AI Transparency Center 的措辞带时间保留「GitLab does not currently train its own models. No inputs to or outputs from GitLab Duo features are currently used to train any GitLab models.」（官方博客层，权威性最低）

points.text: (c) Subscription Agreement §8.4 reserves over Customer Content "a limited license to GitLab necessary for GitLab's provision of the Software and its development and improvement" — whether "development and improvement" includes model training is not defined in the public terms. Uncertainty: GitLab does not disclose the retention period for de-identified prompts or the safeguards against re-identification
points.text_zh: (c) Subscription Agreement §8.4 对 Customer Content 保留「a limited license to GitLab necessary for GitLab's provision of the Software and its development and improvement」——「development and improvement」是否包含模型训练，公开条款未定义。不确定性：GitLab 未披露 de-identified prompts 的保存期与再识别防护

points.text: Nor does it state the no-training commitment separately for beta/experimental features (the Testing Agreement contains no training clause at all — neither a commitment nor an authorization to the contrary).
points.text_zh: 也未把「不训练」承诺按 beta/experimental 功能单列（《Testing Agreement》通篇不含训练条款，既无承诺也无相反授权）。

zdr.quote: When you turn on prompt caching, the model vendor temporarily stores prompt data in memory.

points.text: 链上只有一跳有明确零保留承诺：GitLab 对 Fireworks AI 那一跳。端到端不成立，卡在这条例外上。
points.text_zh: 链上只有一跳有明确零保留承诺：GitLab 对 Fireworks AI 那一跳。端到端不成立，卡在这条例外上。
points.quote: GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI.

points.text: Conclusion: not zero retention across the whole chain (partial). The public material contains one express ZDR statement only, covering a single hop: "For GitLab Duo requests, GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI. Fireworks AI discards model input and output data immediately after the output is provided and does not store input and output data for abuse monitoring." The exceptions that immediately follow it: (1) "The exception to this policy is when prompt caching is turned on for GitLab Duo Code Suggestions and GitLab Duo Agentic Chat. For OpenAI models, you cannot turn off prompt caching."
points.text_zh: 结论：不是全链零保留（partial）。公开材料只有一条 ZDR 明文，且只覆盖一个跳：「For GitLab Duo requests, GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI. Fireworks AI discards model input and output data immediately after the output is provided and does not store input and output data for abuse monitoring.」该句紧接的例外：①「The exception to this policy is when prompt caching is turned on for GitLab Duo Code Suggestions and GitLab Duo Agentic Chat. For OpenAI models, you cannot turn off prompt caching.」

points.text: (2) "Certain Anthropic and OpenAI models, including when hosted on Amazon Bedrock and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, are subject to limited vendor-side data retention." — these models expressly do have vendor-side retention, so that hop is not zero retention. On the GitLab side there are two further retentions decoupled from ZDR: "On GitLab.com, GitLab retains chat and workflow history for anti-abuse purposes." and "Logging information related to AI features is separate from any zero data retention policy with GitLab AI model sub-processors." Under the multi-hop rule "a clear no on any hop makes the whole chain a no": the Fireworks tier can be called zero retention, while the Anthropic/OpenAI tier (including when hosted on Bedrock or the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform) is not
points.text_zh: ②「Certain Anthropic and OpenAI models, including when hosted on Amazon Bedrock and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, are subject to limited vendor-side data retention.」——这些模型在 vendor 侧明确有保留，即该跳不是零保留。GitLab 侧另有两条与 ZDR 脱钩的保留：「On GitLab.com, GitLab retains chat and workflow history for anti-abuse purposes.」与「Logging information related to AI features is separate from any zero data retention policy with GitLab AI model sub-processors.」按多跳规则「任一跳明确为否，则全链为否」：Fireworks 档可称零保留，Anthropic/OpenAI（含 Bedrock / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 托管）档不是零保留

points.text: And the public material offers no unified ZDR switch or application path (on the contrary, retaining inputs and outputs is what requires the customer's written consent through a support ticket). Uncertainty: GitLab does not disclose how to tell, per model or per feature, whether the current configuration falls within ZDR coverage, and provides no verifiable ZDR attestation document.
points.text_zh: 且公开材料没有统一的 ZDR 开关或申请入口（保留输入输出反而是「客户经 support ticket 书面同意」才发生）。不确定性：GitLab 未披露如何按模型/功能判断当前配置是否处于 ZDR 覆盖范围，也未提供可核验的 ZDR 声明文件。

retention.quote: GitLab does not otherwise retain input and output data unless customers provide consent through a

points.text: Conclusion: there is no uniform period
points.text_zh: 结论：没有统一期限

points.text: All that can be given is the one upper-bound commitment that GitLab does not retain inputs and outputs by default; every other object is unquantified (duration_kind=unspecified). By object: (1) [input and output content · GitLab side · default] "GitLab does not otherwise retain input and output data unless customers provide consent through a GitLab Support ticket" — not retained by default, and retention requires customer consent through a support ticket
points.text_zh: 能给的只有「GitLab 侧默认不保留输入输出」这一条上限型承诺，其余对象均未量化（duration_kind=unspecified）。分对象：①【输入输出正文 · GitLab 侧 · 默认】「GitLab does not otherwise retain input and output data unless customers provide consent through a [GitLab Support ticket](...)」——默认不保留，保留需客户经 support ticket 同意

points.text: (2) [chat / workflow history] "GitLab Duo Chat and GitLab Duo Agent Platform retain chat and workflow history to help you return quickly to previously discussed topics. You can delete chats in the GitLab Duo Chat interface." (3) [GitLab.com anti-abuse exception] "On GitLab.com, GitLab retains chat and workflow history for anti-abuse purposes." — no period given, and only on GitLab.com
points.text_zh: ②【chat / workflow history】「GitLab Duo Chat and GitLab Duo Agent Platform retain chat and workflow history to help you return quickly to previously discussed topics. You can delete chats in the GitLab Duo Chat interface.」③【GitLab.com 反滥用例外】「On GitLab.com, GitLab retains chat and workflow history for anti-abuse purposes.」——未给期限，且仅 GitLab.com

points.text: (4) [trace data] "When you enable expanded logging for GitLab Duo Agent Platform, GitLab retains trace data. Logging information related to AI features is separate from any zero data retention policy with GitLab AI model sub-processors." — no period given, and expressly decoupled from the subprocessors' ZDR policy
points.text_zh: ④【trace data】「When you enable expanded logging for GitLab Duo Agent Platform, GitLab retains trace data. Logging information related to AI features is separate from any zero data retention policy with GitLab AI model sub-processors.」——未给期限，且明文与子处理商 ZDR 政策脱钩

points.text: (5) [once usage data collection is turned on] "Full prompt and response text from interactions with GitLab Duo." and similar is recorded, for "service improvement and debugging, and not for training AI models" only, with no period given
points.text_zh: ⑤【usage data collection 打开后】「Full prompt and response text from interactions with GitLab Duo.」等被记录，用途限「service improvement and debugging, and not for training AI models」，未给期限

points.text: (6) [KV / prompt cache] "When you turn on prompt caching, the model vendor temporarily stores prompt data in memory. The cached data is never logged to any persistent storage." — on by default and can be turned off, except for OpenAI models, where it cannot
points.text_zh: ⑥【KV/提示缓存】「When you turn on prompt caching, the model vendor temporarily stores prompt data in memory. The cached data is never logged to any persistent storage.」——默认开启、可关，OpenAI 模型不可关

points.text: (7) [the model subprocessor hop] Fireworks AI discards the data immediately after the output is provided
points.text_zh: ⑦【模型子处理商那一跳】Fireworks AI 输出返回后立即丢弃

points.text: "Certain Anthropic and OpenAI models, including when hosted on Amazon Bedrock and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, are subject to limited vendor-side data retention." — GitLab does not quantify how long that "limited" is; it only points to a footnote on the model_selection page
points.text_zh: 「Certain Anthropic and OpenAI models, including when hosted on Amazon Bedrock and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, are subject to limited vendor-side data retention.」——GitLab 未量化该「limited」是多久，只指向 model_selection 页脚注

points.text: (8) [personal information generally] Privacy Statement §Data Retention, "GitLab will only retain your Personal Data for as long as your account is active or as needed to perform our contractual obligations, provide you the Services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, preserve legal rights, or enforce our agreements." — unquantified. Period type: not one clause here gives a retention period in days or months, so it is recorded as unspecified
points.text_zh: ⑧【通用个人信息】Privacy Statement §Data Retention「GitLab will only retain your Personal Data for as long as your account is active or as needed to perform our contractual obligations, provide you the Services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, preserve legal rights, or enforce our agreements.」——未量化。期限类型：本家没有任何一条给出具体天数/月数的保留期，故记 unspecified

points.text: (1) is of the upper-bound type (zero by default) but carries the four exceptions (2)(3)(4)(5), so it cannot be read in reverse as "no input or output is retained at all". The self-managed + self-hosted model tier has an independent fact of its own: only billing metadata is sent to GitLab, and "Prompts, code inputs, and model responses do not leave your network."
points.text_zh: ①是上限型（默认 0）但带②③④⑤四条例外，不能反推「所有输入输出都不留」。self-managed + 自托管模型档另有一条独立事实：只向 GitLab 发送计费元数据，「Prompts, code inputs, and model responses do not leave your network.」

processing_region.quote: This service is not a data residency solution.

points.text: Conclusion: primarily the United States, deployed across multiple regions, with data residency expressly not promised (us_primary_no_residency_guarantee). (1) Routing: "Because GitLab.com is single-homed in `us-east1`, requests to the AI Gateway are routed to `us-east4` in almost all cases."
points.text_zh: 结论：以美国为主、多区域部署但明确不承诺数据驻留（us_primary_no_residency_guarantee）。①路由：「Because GitLab.com is single-homed in `us-east1`, requests to the AI Gateway are routed to `us-east4` in almost all cases.」

points.text: (2) AI Gateway deployment regions: North America (`us-east4`), Europe (`europe-west2`/`europe-west3`/`europe-west9`) and Asia Pacific (`asia-northeast1`/`asia-northeast3`)
points.text_zh: ②AI Gateway 部署区域：North America（`us-east4`）、Europe（`europe-west2`/`europe-west3`/`europe-west9`）、Asia Pacific（`asia-northeast1`/`asia-northeast3`）

points.text: (3) No residency: "The multi-region AI Gateway deployment does not enforce strict data sovereignty. Requests are not guaranteed to go to or remain in a particular region. This service is not a data residency solution." and "You cannot directly trace your AI requests to specific regions."
points.text_zh: ③不驻留：「The multi-region AI Gateway deployment does not enforce strict data sovereignty. Requests are not guaranteed to go to or remain in a particular region. This service is not a data residency solution.」且「You cannot directly trace your AI requests to specific regions.」

points.text: (4) The model hop: "The exact location of the LLM models used by the AI Gateway is determined by third-party model providers. The models are not guaranteed to reside in the same geographical regions as the AI Gateway deployments. Data might flow to other regions where the model provider operates."
points.text_zh: ④模型那一跳：「The exact location of the LLM models used by the AI Gateway is determined by third-party model providers. The models are not guaranteed to reside in the same geographical regions as the AI Gateway deployments. Data might flow to other regions where the model provider operates.」

points.text: (5) Privacy Statement layer: "Our Services are hosted in the United States and information we collect will be stored and processed on our servers in the United States." (6) Subprocessor location table: Anthropic, PBC = United States
points.text_zh: ⑤Privacy Statement 层：「Our Services are hosted in the United States and information we collect will be stored and processed on our servers in the United States.」⑥子处理商位置表：Anthropic, PBC = United States

points.text: OpenAI, LLC = United States
Google LLC = United States

Fireworks.ai, Inc. = United States and European Union. The opposing side, recorded alongside (not a covering clause, but it has to be on the same page): the hosting location of a GitLab Dedicated instance is chosen by the customer — the Subscription Agreement appendix, "Customer may choose its primary and secondary Hosting Locations for its GitLab Dedicated servers"
points.text_zh: Fireworks.ai, Inc. = United States and European Union。并列的相反面向（不算覆盖条款，但必须同页记录）：GitLab Dedicated 的实例托管地是客户可选的——Subscription Agreement 附录「Customer may choose its primary and secondary Hosting Locations for its GitLab Dedicated servers」

points.text: For self-managed/Dedicated using GitLab-managed models, the AI Gateway region is decided by GitLab ("GitLab manages region selection. You cannot choose the deployment region of the AI Gateway."), so the choice of Dedicated hosting location does not imply the Duo inference location. Self-managed with self-hosted models is a different matter: requests never leave the customer's network
points.text_zh: self-managed/Dedicated 用 GitLab 管理模型时 AI Gateway 区域由 GitLab 决定（「GitLab manages region selection. You cannot choose the deployment region of the AI Gateway.」），所以 Dedicated 的托管地选择不推出 Duo 推理地。self-managed + 自托管模型档是另一回事：请求不出客户网络

points.text: The Gov tier can only run self-hosted, with the AI Gateway installed in AWS GovCloud (US-West). Uncertainty: GitLab does not disclose the actual processing location of an individual request and the customer cannot trace it; only GitLab Support can look it up in the logs (Cloudflare headers plus the instance UUID).
points.text_zh: Gov 档只能走 self-hosted，AI Gateway 装在 AWS GovCloud (US-West)。不确定性：GitLab 不披露单次请求的实际处理地，客户也无法自行追踪，只能靠 GitLab Support 查日志（Cloudflare 头 + 实例 UUID）。

role.quote: Customer’s obligations as a Controller under the DPA will apply.

points.text: Conclusion: on the enterprise/paid tiers GitLab positions itself as processor (the customer is controller)
points.text_zh: 结论：企业/付费档 GitLab 自认 processor（客户为 controller）

points.text: On the free/self-serve tiers GitLab appears as controller (processor_for_enterprise_customer_controller_for_self_serve). Contract layer: (1) GitLab Duo AI Terms §2.3, "To the extent Customer's use of AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models involves the processing of Personal Data, Customer's obligations as a Controller under the DPA will apply. Any sub-processors used to provide AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models will be listed at https://about.gitlab.com/privacy/subprocessors/ and all notifications of updates to that list will be done in accordance with Section 14 of the DPA." — it places the DPA's controller obligations on the customer, which puts GitLab in the processor position
points.text_zh: 免费/自助档 GitLab 以 controller 身份出现（processor_for_enterprise_customer_controller_for_self_serve）。合同层：①《GitLab Duo AI Terms》§2.3「To the extent Customer's use of AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models involves the processing of Personal Data, Customer's obligations as a Controller under the DPA will apply. Any sub-processors used to provide AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models will be listed at https://about.gitlab.com/privacy/subprocessors/ and all notifications of updates to that list will be done in accordance with Section 14 of the DPA.」——把 DPA 的 controller 义务加在客户身上，即 GitLab 站 processor 位

points.text: §2.1 also states that "these Terms, along with the Agreement and the DPA, govern Customer's access to and use of AI Functionality and GitLab Models". (2) Subscription Agreement §14.2, "If this Agreement is entered into on behalf of an Enterprise, the terms of the data processing addendum at ... (“DPA”) are hereby incorporated by reference and shall apply to the extent Customer Content includes Personal Data"
points.text_zh: §2.1 同时明确「these Terms, along with the Agreement and the DPA, govern Customer's access to and use of AI Functionality and GitLab Models」。②《Subscription Agreement》§14.2「If this Agreement is entered into on behalf of an Enterprise, the terms of the data processing addendum at ... (“DPA”) are hereby incorporated by reference and shall apply to the extent Customer Content includes Personal Data」

points.text: §14.4 also carries a PIPL cross-border clause requiring the customer, as "personal information processor", to give notice and obtain separate consent itself. (3) The subprocessor page opens with "When acting as a processor for Customer, Gitlab may engage the following entities to carry out specific processing activities". (4) The Privacy Statement, "For Enterprise Users or accounts that are members of a paid namespace, the enterprise that provisioned your account or invited you to its paid namespace is the Controller of your data. GitLab is a Processor in this scenario" — the same paragraph also confirms that in free/self-serve scenarios GitLab is itself the controller (the privacy statement is written throughout in a controller's voice: we collect / we use). (5) Bring-your-own models (Customer Models) and third-party products are excluded from GitLab's commitments and liability by AI Terms §1.3/§1.9/§2.2, and the role relationship on that hop is set between the customer and its own model vendor. Uncertainty: the body of the DPA (the handbook page only links to an external document, and the PDF text was not obtained this round) could not be checked clause by clause
points.text_zh: §14.4 另有 PIPL 出境条款，要求客户作为「personal information processor」自行完成告知与单独同意。③子处理商页开头「When acting as a processor for Customer, Gitlab may engage the following entities to carry out specific processing activities」。④《Privacy Statement》「For Enterprise Users or accounts that are members of a paid namespace, the enterprise that provisioned your account or invited you to its paid namespace is the Controller of your data. GitLab is a Processor in this scenario」——同一段也确认免费/自助场景下 GitLab 自任 controller（隐私声明通篇以 controller 口吻写 we collect / we use）。⑤自带模型（Customer Models）与第三方产品被 AI Terms §1.3/§1.9/§2.2 排除在 GitLab 承诺与责任之外，那一跳的角色关系由客户与其模型供应商自定。不确定性：DPA 正文（handbook 页只给外部文档链接，本轮未取到 PDF 正文）未能逐条核对

points.text: The Dedicated tier states no role of its own; under Subscription Agreement §14.2 it is presumed to follow the enterprise tier.
points.text_zh: Dedicated 档未单独表述角色，按 Subscription Agreement §14.2 推定同企业档。

training.quote: GitLab does not train generative AI models.

points.text: 与付费 SaaS 档相同：GitLab 不训练生成式 AI 模型，模型子处理商亦受协议限制不得用输入输出训练。

points.quote: GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI.

points.text: Conclusion: not zero retention across the whole chain (partial). The public material contains one express ZDR statement only, covering a single hop: "For GitLab Duo requests, GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI. Fireworks AI discards model input and output data immediately after the output is provided and does not store input and output data for abuse monitoring." The exceptions that immediately follow it: (1) "The exception to this policy is when prompt caching is turned on for GitLab Duo Code Suggestions and GitLab Duo Agentic Chat. For OpenAI models, you cannot turn off prompt caching."
points.text_zh: 结论：不是全链零保留（partial）。公开材料只有一条 ZDR 明文，且只覆盖一个跳：「For GitLab Duo requests, GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI. Fireworks AI discards model input and output data immediately after the output is provided and does not store input and output data for abuse monitoring.」该句紧接的例外：①「The exception to this policy is when prompt caching is turned on for GitLab Duo Code Suggestions and GitLab Duo Agentic Chat. For OpenAI models, you cannot turn off prompt caching.」

points.text: (2) "Certain Anthropic and OpenAI models, including when hosted on Amazon Bedrock and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, are subject to limited vendor-side data retention." — these models expressly do have vendor-side retention, so that hop is not zero retention. On the GitLab side there are two further retentions decoupled from ZDR: "On GitLab.com, GitLab retains chat and workflow history for anti-abuse purposes." and "Logging information related to AI features is separate from any zero data retention policy with GitLab AI model sub-processors." Under the multi-hop rule "a clear no on any hop makes the whole chain a no": the Fireworks tier can be called zero retention, while the Anthropic/OpenAI tier (including when hosted on Bedrock or the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform) is not
points.text_zh: ②「Certain Anthropic and OpenAI models, including when hosted on Amazon Bedrock and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, are subject to limited vendor-side data retention.」——这些模型在 vendor 侧明确有保留，即该跳不是零保留。GitLab 侧另有两条与 ZDR 脱钩的保留：「On GitLab.com, GitLab retains chat and workflow history for anti-abuse purposes.」与「Logging information related to AI features is separate from any zero data retention policy with GitLab AI model sub-processors.」按多跳规则「任一跳明确为否，则全链为否」：Fireworks 档可称零保留，Anthropic/OpenAI（含 Bedrock / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 托管）档不是零保留

points.text: And the public material offers no unified ZDR switch or application path (on the contrary, retaining inputs and outputs is what requires the customer's written consent through a support ticket). Uncertainty: GitLab does not disclose how to tell, per model or per feature, whether the current configuration falls within ZDR coverage, and provides no verifiable ZDR attestation document.
points.text_zh: 且公开材料没有统一的 ZDR 开关或申请入口（保留输入输出反而是「客户经 support ticket 书面同意」才发生）。不确定性：GitLab 未披露如何按模型/功能判断当前配置是否处于 ZDR 覆盖范围，也未提供可核验的 ZDR 声明文件。

role.quote: Customer’s obligations as a Controller under the DPA will apply.

points.text: Conclusion: on the enterprise/paid tiers GitLab positions itself as processor (the customer is controller)
points.text_zh: 结论：企业/付费档 GitLab 自认 processor（客户为 controller）

points.text: On the free/self-serve tiers GitLab appears as controller (processor_for_enterprise_customer_controller_for_self_serve). Contract layer: (1) GitLab Duo AI Terms §2.3, "To the extent Customer's use of AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models involves the processing of Personal Data, Customer's obligations as a Controller under the DPA will apply. Any sub-processors used to provide AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models will be listed at https://about.gitlab.com/privacy/subprocessors/ and all notifications of updates to that list will be done in accordance with Section 14 of the DPA." — it places the DPA's controller obligations on the customer, which puts GitLab in the processor position
points.text_zh: 免费/自助档 GitLab 以 controller 身份出现（processor_for_enterprise_customer_controller_for_self_serve）。合同层：①《GitLab Duo AI Terms》§2.3「To the extent Customer's use of AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models involves the processing of Personal Data, Customer's obligations as a Controller under the DPA will apply. Any sub-processors used to provide AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models will be listed at https://about.gitlab.com/privacy/subprocessors/ and all notifications of updates to that list will be done in accordance with Section 14 of the DPA.」——把 DPA 的 controller 义务加在客户身上，即 GitLab 站 processor 位

points.text: §2.1 also states that "these Terms, along with the Agreement and the DPA, govern Customer's access to and use of AI Functionality and GitLab Models". (2) Subscription Agreement §14.2, "If this Agreement is entered into on behalf of an Enterprise, the terms of the data processing addendum at ... (“DPA”) are hereby incorporated by reference and shall apply to the extent Customer Content includes Personal Data"
points.text_zh: §2.1 同时明确「these Terms, along with the Agreement and the DPA, govern Customer's access to and use of AI Functionality and GitLab Models」。②《Subscription Agreement》§14.2「If this Agreement is entered into on behalf of an Enterprise, the terms of the data processing addendum at ... (“DPA”) are hereby incorporated by reference and shall apply to the extent Customer Content includes Personal Data」

points.text: §14.4 also carries a PIPL cross-border clause requiring the customer, as "personal information processor", to give notice and obtain separate consent itself. (3) The subprocessor page opens with "When acting as a processor for Customer, Gitlab may engage the following entities to carry out specific processing activities". (4) The Privacy Statement, "For Enterprise Users or accounts that are members of a paid namespace, the enterprise that provisioned your account or invited you to its paid namespace is the Controller of your data. GitLab is a Processor in this scenario" — the same paragraph also confirms that in free/self-serve scenarios GitLab is itself the controller (the privacy statement is written throughout in a controller's voice: we collect / we use). (5) Bring-your-own models (Customer Models) and third-party products are excluded from GitLab's commitments and liability by AI Terms §1.3/§1.9/§2.2, and the role relationship on that hop is set between the customer and its own model vendor. Uncertainty: the body of the DPA (the handbook page only links to an external document, and the PDF text was not obtained this round) could not be checked clause by clause
points.text_zh: §14.4 另有 PIPL 出境条款，要求客户作为「personal information processor」自行完成告知与单独同意。③子处理商页开头「When acting as a processor for Customer, Gitlab may engage the following entities to carry out specific processing activities」。④《Privacy Statement》「For Enterprise Users or accounts that are members of a paid namespace, the enterprise that provisioned your account or invited you to its paid namespace is the Controller of your data. GitLab is a Processor in this scenario」——同一段也确认免费/自助场景下 GitLab 自任 controller（隐私声明通篇以 controller 口吻写 we collect / we use）。⑤自带模型（Customer Models）与第三方产品被 AI Terms §1.3/§1.9/§2.2 排除在 GitLab 承诺与责任之外，那一跳的角色关系由客户与其模型供应商自定。不确定性：DPA 正文（handbook 页只给外部文档链接，本轮未取到 PDF 正文）未能逐条核对

points.text: Conclusion: not_disclosed — the public terms contain neither an authorization that data "may be used for training" nor a commitment that it is "not used for training"; neither direction can be found. Evidence base: across all 33 documents fetched this round (9 legal texts + the FAQ aggregate and single pages + product and operations documentation + the Chinese and English website policies), the word "training" appears exactly once, in User Service Agreement §1.3.6(3)②: "where we, as the platform operator and technology provider, discover or receive a report of unlawful content, we will promptly take disposal measures such as stopping generation, stopping transmission and removal, carry out rectification through measures such as model optimization training, and report to the competent authorities" — this is the unlawful-content rectification context required by the Interim Measures for the Administration of Generative AI Services, not an authorization to use customer data for training. Pointing the other way (also not a commitment): the "special note" opening the platform privacy policy states that the platform "does not directly collect or process any business data or personnel data that you or the enterprise customer you represent provides or generates in the course of use. We only: on the mandate of the enterprise customer you belong to or represent, process and store your ... business data", and §2 again characterizes it as "processing the relevant data on an entrusted basis"
points.text_zh: 结论：not_disclosed——公开条款既没有「可用于训练」的授权，也没有「不用于训练」的承诺，两向都查不到。证据面：本轮抓下的全部 33 份文档（legal 9 篇 + FAQ 聚合与单页 + 产品与运维文档 + 官网中英文政策）中，「训练」二字只在《用户服务协议》§1.3.6(3)② 出现一次：「我们作为平台运营方/技术提供方发现或收到举报存在违法内容的，将及时采取停止生成、停止传输、消除等处置措施，采取模型优化训练等措施进行整改，并向有关主管部门报告」——这是《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》要求的违法内容整改语境，不是把客户数据用于训练客户模型的授权。相反面向（同样不构成承诺）：平台隐私政策开篇「特别说明」自认平台「并不直接收集或处理您或您代表的企业客户在使用过程中所提供或产生的任何业务数据或人员数据。我们仅：受您所属/所代表的企业客户委托，对您……业务数据……进行处理及存储」，§二 再次以「受托处理相关数据」定性

points.text: Under the Personal Information Protection Law, entrusted processing means processing on the mandating party's instructions without using the data beyond that scope, which structurally works against the platform using customer content for training, but not a word of the terms says so — that is inference, not disclosure. Also note: User Service Agreement §6.5 authorizes only "the use of your name, trademarks and logos in sales, marketing and other publicity and promotional materials and activities", and does not touch content. Uncertainties: (1) the "preset models" on the Agentic MaaS platform include third-party closed-source models (User Service Agreement §1.3.1 lists the filing entities for Wuqiong AI Assistant / Onetake / GenStudio, which deploy open-source models such as GLM-5, Moonshot, Kling-V3-omni, seedance-2.0 and deepseek), and Privacy Policy §2.2 also says "if you and your enterprise have a need to use third-party closed-source models, you may raise it with us and we will coordinate on your behalf" — if a request is forwarded to the original vendor of a third-party closed-source model, whether that vendor uses the input for training is not covered anywhere in this provider's documents
points.text_zh: 受托处理在《个人信息保护法》下意味着按委托方指示处理、不得超范围使用，这在结构上不利于平台拿客户内容去训练，但条款本身没有一个字这么说，属推断而非披露。另可注意：《用户服务协议》§6.5 只授权「在销售、营销等宣传、推广材料和活动中使用您的名称、商标、标识」，未触及内容。不确定性：①Agentic MaaS 平台上「预置模型」含第三方闭源模型（用户协议 §1.3.1 列出无穹 AI 助手/Onetake/GenStudio 分别部署了 GLM-5、Moonshot、Kling-V3-omni、seedance-2.0、deepseek 等开源模型的备案主体），隐私政策 §2.2 也说「如您及所属企业有第三方闭源模型使用需求，亦可向我们提出，我们将为您协调」——若请求被转给第三方闭源模型原厂，那些原厂是否用输入训练，本家的文档完全没有覆盖

points.text: (2) throughput content is sent to Alibaba Cloud and NetEase Yidun for content safety review (Privacy Policy §2.2 and §5.1.5); their retention and use rules are in their own policies, and this provider makes no binding statement about them
points.text_zh: ②吞吐内容会送阿里云与网易易盾做内容安全审核（隐私政策 §2.2 与 §5.1.5），这两家的留存/使用规则见其各自政策，本家未作约束性声明

points.text: (3) the earlier record saying "the privacy policy has no training-related clause" is correct, but it also wrote the conclusion as "maintain not_stated"; this round uses not_disclosed uniformly for the same meaning.
points.text_zh: ③旧记录说「隐私政策无训练相关条款」是对的，但它同时把结论写成「维持 not_stated」，本轮统一用 not_disclosed 表达同一含义。

zdr.quote: 对于您及您所属客户输入/输出内容，本平台已进行了全量加密并隔离存储

points.text: Conclusion: no ZDR / zero-retention / no-persistence commitment, switch, application path or enterprise data processing addendum can be found, recorded as not_found (no public evidence obtained is not the same as the vendor not offering it). This round fetched all 9 documents in the docs-site legal directory, the support FAQs (including the conversation history single page), the AgentWorks security and memory docs, the Chinese and English website privacy policies and the whole compute cloud website; full-text searches for "zero retention / zero data retention / not retained / not kept / immediate deletion / delete immediately / DPA / data processing agreement / subprocessor" returned no hit
points.text_zh: 结论：查不到任何 ZDR / 零保留 / 不落盘 的承诺、开关、申请方式或企业级数据处理附录，记 not_found（拿不到公开证据 ≠ 厂商不提供）。本轮把文档站 legal 目录 9 篇 + 支持类 FAQ（含会话历史单页）+ AgentWorks 安全与记忆文档 + 官网中英文隐私政策 + 智算云平台官网全部抓了一遍，全文检索「零保留 / 零数据保留 / 不保留 / 不留存 / 即刻删除 / 立即删除 / DPA / 数据处理协议 / 子处理者」均无命中

points.text: The docs site also has no DPA and no trust/security white paper page (the legal directory holds only 9 documents, none a DPA; /legal/legal-notice.html is a 404). The earlier record treated the FAQ sentence "we do not store the conversation history between users and large language models" as ZDR evidence "stronger than a standard no-retention statement"; this round disagrees, for three reasons: (1) the Q&A containing that sentence is "Can I retrieve the chat history of a conversation?", which asks about the user's ability to retrieve history, and the sentence commits only to not storing "conversation history" — it says nothing about request-level non-retention, nothing about deletion once processing completes, and gives no period or application path
points.text_zh: 文档站也不存在 DPA 或 trust/security 白皮书页（legal 目录只有 9 篇，没有 DPA；/legal/legal-notice.html 是 404）。旧记录把 FAQ 那句「我们均不会存储用户与大语言模型的会话历史记录」当成「强于标准不保留表述」的 ZDR 证据，本轮不同意，理由三条：①该句所在问答是「我可以检索会话的聊天历史记录吗？」，问的是用户侧的历史检索能力，句子本身只承诺不存储「会话历史记录」，没有说请求级不保留、没有说处理完成后即删、没有给任何期限或可申请口径

points.text: (2) it is not about the same object as platform Privacy Policy §2.2 — the privacy policy states that "for the input and output content of you and the customer you belong to, this platform applies full encryption and isolated storage", i.e. input and output content is stored (encryption + tenant isolation + decryption only on application by request ID during debugging), while this sentence commits only to not retaining "user-retrievable conversation history"; the two do not conflict (on re-checking on 2026-09-21 that source was reclassified from conflict to core, for the reasons in its scope_note)
points.text_zh: ②它与平台隐私政策 §2.2 讲的不是同一个对象——隐私政策写明「对于您及您所属客户输入/输出内容，本平台已进行了全量加密并隔离存储」，即输入输出正文是被存储的（加密 + 租户隔离 + 仅 debug 时按请求 ID 申请授权解密），而本句只承诺不保留「用户可检索的会话历史」，两者不构成冲突（该源 2026-09-21 重查后由 conflict 改判 core，理由见其 scope_note）

points.text: (3) it appears in the developer documentation FAQ rather than in a legal document, and none of the three legal texts — the platform privacy policy, the user agreement and the website privacy policy — carries a corresponding statement. Three observations in the other direction (which do not amount to the vendor not offering ZDR): (a) the platform privacy policy opens by stating that it "does not directly collect or process" customer business data and processes only "on the mandate of the enterprise customer", and the entrusted role is contractually incompatible with "using content for its own purposes", but that is not a zero-retention commitment
points.text_zh: ③它出现在开发者文档 FAQ 而非法律文件，且隐私政策、用户协议、官网隐私政策三份法律文本中都没有对应表述。反向观察三点（不等于厂商不提供 ZDR）：(a) 平台隐私政策开篇自认「并不直接收集或处理」客户业务数据、仅「受企业客户委托」处理，受托角色在条款上与「把内容用于自身目的」相斥，但这不是零保留承诺

points.text: (b) throughput content is returned after content safety review by Alibaba Cloud and NetEase Yidun, and retention at that third-party leg is not disclosed
points.text_zh: (b) 吞吐内容会经阿里云与网易易盾内容安全审核后回传，第三方环节的保留未披露

points.text: (c) the AgentWorks documentation states that the retention and deletion policies for Traces and logs must be "confirmed with the platform provider and the owner of the external system", i.e. the platform side does not disclose them.
points.text_zh: (c) AgentWorks 文档明确 Trace 与日志的保留/删除策略需「向平台提供方和外部系统负责人确认」，即平台侧不披露。

retention.quote: 对于您及您所属客户输入/输出内容，本平台已进行了全量加密并隔离存储

points.text: Conclusion: no quantified uniform period; retained for "the period necessary for the purpose"
points.text_zh: 结论：无量化统一期限，按「目的所必需」保留

points.text: Object and context have to be written separately, because this provider has two sentences pointing in different directions about the same object. (1) Object = input/output content (API and the experience center): platform Privacy Policy §2.2, "for the input and output content of you and the customer you belong to, this platform applies full encryption and isolated storage; only when you or the customer you belong to requests that we carry out program debugging will we look up the corresponding log by request ID and apply to you and your customer for authorization to decrypt the throughput content" — that is, input and output content is stored, and the controls are encryption plus isolation plus an application requirement for decryption, not "not retained". Set against it is the developer FAQ (the aggregate page and the single page /support/faq/027-chat-history.html are word for word identical): "whether in the experience center or in the API service, we do not store the conversation history between users and large language models." The reconciling reading: the FAQ addresses only the product concept "conversation history" (multi-turn conversation history the user can retrieve), while Privacy Policy §2.2 addresses "input/output content" as an object of data processing
points.text_zh: 对象与语境必须分开写，因为本家同一对象有两句方向不同的话。①对象=输入/输出正文（API 与体验中心）：平台隐私政策 §2.2「对于您及您所属客户输入/输出内容，本平台已进行了全量加密并隔离存储，仅在您及您所属客户请求我们开展程序调试（debug）时，我们将根据相关请求ID查看对应日志并向您及您所属客户申请对吞吐内容进行授权解密」——即输入输出正文是被存储的，控制手段是加密 + 隔离 + 解密需申请，不是「不保留」。与之并列的是开发者 FAQ（聚合页与单页 /support/faq/027-chat-history.html 逐字相同）：「无论是体验中心还是 API 服务，我们均不会存储用户与大语言模型的会话历史记录。」两句的调和读法：FAQ 只针对「会话历史记录」这一产品概念（用户侧可检索的多轮对话历史），隐私政策 §2.2 针对「输入/输出内容」这一数据处理对象

points.text: But on their face the two sentences do pull against each other, and no sentence in the legal documents marks the boundary between them, so confidence is recorded as medium rather than high. (2) Object = personal information (account, real-name, refund, logs): §4.2.1, "we will retain your personal information only for the period necessary for the purpose of providing this platform and related services", listing three criteria (the time needed for the business purpose / a longer period the user consents to / legal and contractual requirements), with no day count
points.text_zh: 但两句字面上确实互相拉扯，而法律文件里没有任何一句说明二者的边界，故置信度记 medium 而非 high。②对象=个人信息（账号、实名、退费、日志）：§四.2.1「我们将仅在为提供本平台及相关服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的个人信息」，并列出三条确定标准（业务目的所需时间/用户同意的更长期限/法律与合同要求），未给天数

points.text: §4.2.2: deleted or anonymized once the period expires (except where laws and regulations provide otherwise). Suspended-service users are an express exception: §1.1, "we will continue to keep the mobile number, account and password such suspended-service users submitted when creating the account, in order to provide them with account login, until the suspended-service user deregisters the account or our statutory storage period expires". (3) Object = access and operation logs: §1.3(3) discloses the network log fields as "customer APIKey, request time, request processing result (success/failure, whether finished)", with no period
points.text_zh: §四.2.2 超期删除或匿名化（法律法规另有规定除外）。停服用户是明确的例外：§1.1「该等停服用户创建账户时提交的手机号码、账号、密码，我们将会继续保存，以为其提供账号登录服务，直至停服用户注销其账号，或我们法定的存储时间届满」。③对象=访问/操作日志：§1.3(3) 披露网络日志字段为「客户APIKey、请求时间、请求处理结果（成功/失败、是否结束）」，无期限

points.text: User Service Agreement §1.3.5(2), in the context of implicit labelling of generated synthetic content, says "as the service provider we will retain the relevant log information in accordance with laws, administrative regulations and relevant national provisions" — a statutory floor, which cannot be read in reverse as "deleted when it expires"
points.text_zh: 《用户服务协议》§1.3.5(2) 在生成合成内容隐式标识语境下写「我们作为服务提供方将依照法律、行政法规和国家有关规定保存相关日志信息」——这是法定下限口径，不能反推「到期即删」

points.text: The feature documentation gives the only observable floor: the "query operation audit events" page states that event queries "only support operation records from 2024-10-31 onwards", i.e. operation audit events have been retained continuously since at least 2024-10-31 (about 23 months); note that this is a query-range limit, not a deletion commitment, and that the 30-day single-query window is a query limit, not a retention period. (4) Object = agent memory and Trace: the AgentWorks memory doc states that "retention period, automatic deduplication, recall threshold and end-user self-service deletion need to be managed through the organization's data processes or external systems", and the security doc states that "URL expiry only means the URL can no longer be used for access; it does not mean every copy has been deleted", adding "please confirm the retention and deletion policies for Traces, logs and other copies with the platform provider and the owner of the external system" — i.e. the platform discloses no period for these two objects. (5) Object = portrait material uploaded to Onetake: the "ONEtake Platform Important Notice" confirms it will be "collected, edited, previewed, stored and processed", with no period. (6) Object = data the customer uploads to the platform: User Agreement §2.4.2 only "purges" it on deregistration for violations
points.text_zh: 功能文档给了唯一可观测的下限：「查询操作审计事件」页面写明事件查询「仅支持 2024-10-31 至今的操作记录」，即操作审计事件至少自 2024-10-31 起持续留存（约 23 个月），注意那是查询范围限制，不是删除承诺，且 30 天的单次查询窗口是查询限制不是保留期。④对象=智能体记忆与 Trace：AgentWorks 记忆文档写明「保留期限、自动去重、召回阈值和最终用户自助删除需要通过组织的数据流程或外部系统管理」，安全文档写明「URL 过期只表示不能再通过该 URL 访问，不代表所有副本已经删除」，并「请向平台提供方和外部系统负责人确认 Trace、日志及其他副本的保留和删除策略」——即平台不披露这两个对象的期限。⑤对象=Onetake 上传的人像素材：《ONEtake 平台重要提示》确认会被「收集、编辑、预览、存储并处理」，无期限。⑥对象=客户主动上传到平台的数据：用户协议 §2.4.2 只在违规注销时「清空」

points.text: §3.5 places security and backup responsibility wholly on the customer. (7) A general exception to deletion: §7.1, "because you use this platform's services on an enterprise's mandate or as an employee of an enterprise customer, business data in the corresponding account, such as business operations and service usage records, cannot be deleted or anonymized except on the instruction or request of your enterprise" — the end user cannot delete business data themselves. (8) Third-party leg: throughput content is reviewed by Alibaba Cloud and NetEase Yidun (§2.2 and §5.1.5 state that NetEase Yidun receives "the user's request content" and "the service's response content"), and this provider does not constrain their retention. Period type: all of the "needed for the purpose / statutory floor" kind, with no cap and no typical range
points.text_zh: §3.5 把安全与备份责任整体压给客户。⑦删除的普遍例外：§七.1「因您是受企业委托/作为企业客户员工使用本平台服务，除受您所在企业指示或要求，对应账号中与业务开展、服务使用记录等业务数据无法进行删除或匿名化处理」——最终用户本人无法删除业务数据。⑧第三方环节：吞吐内容经阿里云与网易易盾审核（§2.2、§5.1.5 列明网易易盾共享「用户的请求内容」与「服务的响应内容」），其保留期本家未约束。期限类型：全部为「目的所需/法定下限」型，无任何上限或典型区间

points.text: This provider discloses no request-level deletion period.
points.text_zh: 本家未披露任何请求级删除期限。

processing_region.quote: 除非另有约定或法律另有规定，我们在中华人民共和国境内收集和产生的个人信息将储存在中华人民共和国境内

points.text: Conclusion: stored within China (CN). Platform Privacy Policy §4.1, "unless otherwise agreed or otherwise provided by law, personal information we collect and generate within the territory of the People's Republic of China will be stored within the territory of the People's Republic of China. For personal information collected and generated outside the territory of the People's Republic of China, we will store it in accordance with laws, regulations, international rules or international practice recognized as effective by the People's Republic of China" — note the second half: personal information collected or generated abroad is stored under internationally recognized rules, which leaves an unclear opening
points.text_zh: 结论：境内（CN）存储。平台隐私政策 §四.1「除非另有约定或法律另有规定，我们在中华人民共和国境内收集和产生的个人信息将储存在中华人民共和国境内。对在中华人民共和国境外收集和产生的个人信息，我们将按照中华人民共和国认可效力的法律、法规、国际规则或国际惯例予以存储」——注意后半句：境外收集/产生的个人信息按中国认可的国际规则存储，等于留了一个不明确的出口

points.text: The first half also carries the exception "unless otherwise agreed or otherwise provided by law". The website tier says the same and more strongly: website enquiry-form Privacy Policy §7.1, "in accordance with laws and regulations, we will store the personal information collected about you only within the territory of the People's Republic of China" (the English version has the same sentence: will be stored within the territory of the People’s Republic of China), and the privacy policy summary matches. So the Chinese and English sites, and the platform and website tiers alike, are consistent on storage location: within China. Inconsistent or uncovered points, recorded faithfully alongside: (a) User Agreement §3.6 permits "arranging for Infini-AI affiliates or other third parties to provide all or part of the services to you, and where necessary granting them the access to service information they require" — without limiting where those affiliates or third parties are located
points.text_zh: 前半句也带「除非另有约定或法律另有规定」的例外。官网档同向且更强：官网问卷隐私政策 §七.1「我们依照法律法规的规定，仅会将收集到的有关您的个人信息存储于中华人民共和国境内」（英文版同句：will be stored within the territory of the People’s Republic of China），隐私政策摘要亦同。因此中英文两站、平台与官网两档在存储地点上口径一致，均为境内。不一致/未覆盖的点如实并列：(a) 用户协议 §3.6 允许「安排无问芯穹关联公司、其他第三方为您提供全部或部分服务，必要时为其开通必需的服务信息访问权限」——未限定这些关联公司/第三方的所在地

points.text: (b) platform Privacy Policy §2.2 and §5.1.5 show that throughput content is sent to Alibaba Cloud and NetEase Yidun for content safety review; both are domestic entities (Alibaba Cloud Computing Co., Ltd. and Hangzhou NetEase Zhiqi Technology Co., Ltd.), which is compatible with the in-China storage commitment, but whether they in turn sub-entrust is not disclosed
points.text_zh: (b) 平台隐私政策 §2.2 与 §5.1.5 显示吞吐内容会送阿里云与网易易盾做内容安全审核，两家均为境内主体（阿里云计算有限公司、杭州网易智企科技有限公司），与境内存储承诺相容，但其自身是否再转委托未披露

points.text: (c) the AgentWorks documentation notes that private deployment is a separate delivery scope, in which case the processing location is determined by the delivery environment and the public documentation does not cover it. No "data export" commitment and no statement of a completed cross-border transfer assessment was found, nor any overseas compute or overseas inference node.
points.text_zh: (c) AgentWorks 文档提到私有部署属单独交付范围，私有部署时的处理地由交付环境决定，公开文档未覆盖。未发现任何「数据出境」承诺或已通过出境评估的表述，也未发现境外算力/境外推理节点。

role.quote: 我们并不直接收集或处理您或您代表的企业客户在使用过程中所提供或产生的任何业务数据或人员数据

points.text: Conclusion: for customer business data (including API request and response content) the provider identifies itself as an entrusted processor
points.text_zh: 结论：对客户业务数据（含 API 请求与响应内容）自认为受托处理方（processor）

points.text: For personal information it collects itself, such as account and real-name information, it is the handler
points.text_zh: 对账号/实名等自身收集的个人信息是处理者

points.text: On the website tier it identifies itself as a joint handler. The three tiers differ and are recorded one by one. (1) Platform tier (model services / platform services): the "special note" opening the privacy policy — "the infini-ai platform is a platform through which we provide services to enterprise users; we do not directly collect or process any business data or personnel data that you or the enterprise customer you represent provides or generates in the course of use. We only: on the mandate of the enterprise customer you belong to or represent, process and store the business data that you or that enterprise customer actively provides or that the operation of the service generates (including but not limited to the account management information you fill in and service log data)"
points.text_zh: 官网档则自认为共同处理者。三档不同，逐档记录。①平台档（模型服务/平台服务）：隐私政策开篇「特别说明」——「infini-ai平台是由我们向企业用户提供服务的平台，我们并不直接收集或处理您或您代表的企业客户在使用过程中所提供或产生的任何业务数据或人员数据。我们仅：受您所属/所代表的企业客户委托，对您或您所属/代表的企业客户在使用过程中所主动提供或服务运营产生的业务数据（包括但不限于您主动填写的账号管理信息、服务日志数据）进行处理及存储」

points.text: §2 characterizes it again: "this part describes only the technical support services we provide to you on the mandate of your enterprise and the entrusted processing of the relevant data in that course." This is an express admission of entrusted processing. §5.1.2 also states that "for scenarios where the processing of personal information is entrusted out, we will sign the relevant processing agreements with the entrusted partner as required by law and supervise its use of personal information" — showing that the provider itself also contracts downstream as an entrusting party. (2) The counterweight on the platform tier: User Agreement §1.3.2/§1.3.3 repeatedly calls itself "platform operator / technology provider", §3.5 places the security, backup and lawfulness of user data wholly on the enterprise customer, and the §8 disclaimers assign availability risk to force majeure and third parties
points.text_zh: §二 再次定性「本部分仅介绍，我们受您所属企业委托为您提供的技术支持服务情况及该等过程中受托处理相关数据的情况」。这是明确的受托处理自认。§5.1.2 还写明「对于委托处理个人信息的场景，我们会与受托合作方根据法律规定签署相关处理协议，并对其个人信息使用活动进行监督」——说明本家自己也作为委托方向下游受托方签约。②平台档的对照面：用户协议 §1.3.2/§1.3.3 反复自称「平台运营方/技术提供方」，§3.5 把用户数据的安全、备份、合法性责任整体压给企业客户，§8 免责条款把可用性风险归给不可抗力与第三方

points.text: Privacy Policy §7.1 states that an end user "cannot delete or anonymize" the business data under their account, and §7.2 states that "except on the instruction or request of your enterprise, we cannot provide you personally with account deregistration" — both typical behaviours of an entrusted party (answerable only to the mandating party), consistent with the processor characterization. (3) Website tier: the introduction to the website enquiry-form privacy policy says "Shanghai Infinigence Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. and Beijing Infinigence Technology Co., Ltd. ... jointly operate the website as joint handlers of the data (links: infinigence-ai.com, infini-ai.com)" — joint handlers (joint controllers); and the website tier expressly states "at present, this platform does not share your (or your organization's) information with any third party, nor does it integrate software development kits (SDKs) provided by third parties ...", in contrast with the platform tier, which lists four third-party SDKs. (4) Contracting entities: both the user agreement and the platform privacy policy name "Shanghai Infinigence Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. and Beijing Infinigence Technology Co., Ltd." as joint operators / joint handlers, and no public document explains how responsibility is divided between them. Uncertainties: (1) there is a naming conflict within the docs site — the "Third-Party Information Sharing List and Third-Party SDK Catalogue" links "Shanghai Infinigence Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. Website Privacy Policy" to the platform-tier privacy.html, while the "Privacy Policy Summary" uses the same name for the website-tier document
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §七.1 明确最终用户对其账号下业务数据「无法进行删除或匿名化处理」、§七.2 明确「除受您所在企业指示或要求，我们无法为您个人提供账号注销的服务」——这些都是受托方行为的典型特征（只对委托方负责），与 processor 定性一致。③官网档：官网问卷隐私政策引言写「上海无问芯穹智能科技股份有限公司、北京无问芯穹科技有限公司……作为数据的共同处理者共同运营的官网（链接：infinigence-ai.com、infini-ai.com）」——共同处理者（joint controller），且官网档明确「目前，本平台并不存在与第三方共享您（或您的组织）信息的情况，亦不存在会接入由第三方提供的软件开发包(SDK)……的情况」，与平台档列出四个第三方 SDK 形成对比。④签约主体：用户协议与平台隐私政策均写「上海无问芯穹智能科技股份有限公司、北京无问芯穹科技有限公司」两家共同运营/共同处理，公开文件中未见两家之间责任划分的说明。不确定性：①文档站内存在名称冲突——《第三方共享信息清单和第三方 SDK 目录》把「《上海无问芯穹智能科技股份有限公司官网隐私政策》」链到平台档 privacy.html，而《隐私政策摘要》用同一名称指官网档文档

points.text: User Agreement §1.2 cites the "Infini-AI Website Privacy Policy" for collecting sales contact information (pointing to the website tier). The naming conflict itself does not affect the processor determination (which rests on the platform-tier text), but it shows that this provider's cross-references are not rigorous. (2) The AgentWorks documentation uses wording such as "platform provider" and "target deployment" and notes that private deployment is a separate delivery scope; if the actual delivery form is a private deployment, the role determination must follow the delivery contract, which the public documentation cannot cover. (3) This provider publishes no DPA or data processing addendum (there is none among the 9 documents in the legal directory) and no subprocessor list in text (the third-party sharing list page is dynamically rendered and its body is empty).
points.text_zh: 用户协议 §1.2 引用《无问芯穹官网隐私政策》收销售联系信息（指向官网档）。名称冲突本身不影响 processor 的认定（认定依据是平台档正文），但说明本家文档的引用关系不严谨。②AgentWorks 文档中出现「平台提供方」「目标部署」等措辞，且提到私有部署属单独交付范围，若实际交付形态是私有化部署，角色认定需以交付合同为准，公开文档不能覆盖。③本家没有任何公开 DPA/数据处理附录（legal 目录 9 篇中无 DPA），也没有子处理者清单的正文（第三方共享清单页面动态渲染，正文为空）。

points.text: The compute tier has no separately named terms document. User Agreement §1.3 confines "this platform" to two modules, Agentic MaaS (GenStudio/AgentWorks/ComfyStack) and Onetake, while compute instances and per-GPU-hour billing appear only in the FAQ and the billing documentation

points.text: The console login page states that the user agrees to the "Infini-AI Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and Product Service Agreement", but this round found no public text of the "Product Service Agreement" on the website, on the docs site, in the legal directory or among the 276 pages listed in llms.txt. The training position for the compute tier is therefore recorded as undisclosed, and the not_disclosed conclusion of the model service tier is not borrowed to cover it (the evidence differs).

points.text: No public document contains any retention clause for compute instances (containers, images, mounted volumes, job logs). The only usable adjacent evidence is that operation audit events "only support operation records from 2024-10-31 onwards" (which applies equally to operation events such as creating, starting and stopping compute instances), and User Agreement §2.4.2, which on deregistration for violations "purges the data you have uploaded to and stored in this platform and the services" — neither is a retention commitment for compute instance data. Recorded as not_found; §4.2 of the model service tier is not used as a substitute.
points.text_zh: 公开文件中没有任何针对算力实例（容器、镜像、挂载卷、任务日志）的保留期限条款。唯一可用的相邻证据是操作审计事件「仅支持 2024-10-31 至今的操作记录」（对算力实例的创建/启停等操作事件同样适用），以及用户协议 §2.4.2 违规注销时「清空您所上传和存储在本平台及服务中的数据」——都不是算力实例数据的保留承诺。按 not_found 记，不拿模型服务档的 §四.2 去顶替。

processing_region.quote: 除非另有约定或法律另有规定，我们在中华人民共和国境内收集和产生的个人信息将储存在中华人民共和国境内

points.text: The in-China storage commitment in platform Privacy Policy §4.1 has "this platform" as its scope, and §1.3/§2 define this platform as Agentic MaaS plus Onetake, without naming compute instances. The FAQ separately carries Q&As such as "the compute cloud platform uses a strict multi-tenant architecture that ensures data isolation between tenants" and "where are the compute resources", but neither is a storage-location commitment. Hence low confidence only: the compute tier is very likely processed within China as the platform tier is (the same tenancy system, the same privacy policy framework), but the public terms do not name compute instances, so it cannot be recorded as high.
points.text_zh: 平台隐私政策 §四.1 的境内存储承诺，其范围是「本平台」，而 §1.3/§二 把本平台界定为 Agentic MaaS + Onetake，算力实例未被点名。FAQ 另有「智算云平台采用严格的多租户架构，确保租户间的数据隔离」与「算力资源在哪里」类问答，但都不构成存储地域承诺。因此只记 low confidence：算力档很可能与平台档同为境内处理（同一套租户体系、同一份隐私政策框架），但公开条款没有点名算力实例，不能按 high 记。

role.quote: 我们并不直接收集或处理您或您代表的企业客户在使用过程中所提供或产生的任何业务数据或人员数据

points.text: No separate role clause was found for the compute tier. The platform privacy policy's admission of entrusted processing ("on the mandate of the enterprise customer you belong to or represent") textually covers all business data of "this platform", and customer data inside a compute instance is a kind of "business data", but the clause does not name the compute service, so the same conclusion is recorded with low confidence: an entrusted processor for customer business data. If the enterprise customer signs a separate compute service contract with Infini-AI (the "Product Service Agreement" mentioned in the console), the role follows that contract.
points.text_zh: 算力档未见独立的角色条款。平台隐私政策的受托处理自认（「受您所属/所代表的企业客户委托」）在文本上覆盖「本平台」的全部业务数据，算力实例中的客户数据属「业务数据」的一种，但条款没有点名算力服务，故记 low confidence 的同一结论：对客户业务数据为受托处理方。若企业客户与无问芯穹另签算力服务合同（控制台提及的《产品服务协议》），角色应以该合同为准。

points.text: Deleted or anonymized once that period is exceeded. The English version has the same sentence (shortest period necessary to fulfill the stated service purposes). There is also one limit on deletion: a deletion request excludes "data that laws and regulations require to be retained", and after deletion the data may not be purged from backups immediately, being stored in isolation until the backup can be purged or anonymized. Note that these periods hold only for website form information and cannot be extrapolated to API request content.

points.text: Model Use Agreement Section VI.3 grants the same license but with no opt-out. The official FAQ (api-data-security) and the ZDR page state that API / enterprise customer data is not used for training, which is the opposite of the contractual grant; under contract > developer_data the contract prevails. Re-checked (2026-09-21): after ruling out the scope, tier and site readings one by one, judged a genuine contradiction (recency could not be ruled out because the page carries no date, but there is no evidence of a superseding version); marked contradiction, see the contradiction_note on api-data-security.
points.text_zh: modeluse 六、3 同款授权但无 opt-out。官方 FAQ（api-data-security）与 ZDR 页声明 API/企业客户数据不用于训练，与合同授权相反，按 contract > developer_data 取合同。重查(2026-09-21)：逐条排除范围/档位/站点三种解释后判为真矛盾（时效因该页无日期未能排除，但无版本取代证据），标 contradiction，见 api-data-security 的 contradiction_note。

points.text: This tier discloses no specific processing location or data residency. Only two relevant sentences appear in the texts that govern it: (1) the closing paragraph of Privacy Policy v2 §7, "Your information may be transferred to and stored on servers located outside of your country of residence" — which states only that cross-border transfer and storage may happen, with no location given
points.text_zh: 本档没有任何具体处理地/数据驻留披露。适用本档文本里唯一相关的两句:(1) 隐私政策 v2 §7 末段「Your information may be transferred to and stored on servers located outside of your country of residence」——只说明可能跨境转移与存储,未给地点

points.text: (2) ToS v2 §12 provides for Singapore governing law, SIAC arbitration and Singapore as the seat of arbitration — that is governing law and dispute-resolution venue, not the data processing location, and cannot stand as a processing-region conclusion. The Data locations page on the Kimi Code docs site only covers CLI local data held on the user's machine under ~/.kimi-code/, which is likewise not a server-side processing location. The Open Platform privacy policy does say "servers located in Singapore", but that is a disclosure for the platform.kimi.ai line (MOONSHOT AI PTE. LTD.) and must not be applied to this tier (the NOVASCENT PRIVATE LIMITED subscription line).
points.text_zh: (2) ToS v2 §12 约定新加坡法管辖、SIAC 仲裁、仲裁地新加坡——这是法律管辖与争议解决地,不等于数据处理地,不能当处理地结论。Kimi Code 文档站的 Data locations 页只讲 CLI 本地数据在用户机器 ~/.kimi-code/,也不是服务端处理地。开放平台隐私政策明写「servers located in Singapore」,但那是 platform.kimi.ai 线的披露(MOONSHOT AI PTE. LTD.),不得套用到本档(NOVASCENT PRIVATE LIMITED 订阅线)。

points.text: This tier has no mechanism for excluding particular traffic from training

points.text_zh: 不想被训练只能改用 Standard Services(Data Commitments 给出同样路径)。

points.text: The ZDR help page does not distinguish tiers and says only "ZDR support may vary by model", without stating whether the Contributor/Discounted tier can enable ZDR. This tier exists on the premise that Meta may use Content for training, which is contractually incompatible with request-level zero retention, but Meta has taken no position, so it is recorded faithfully as not_found and must not be read in reverse as the vendor declining to offer it.
points.text_zh: ZDR 帮助页不区分档位，只说『ZDR support may vary by model』，没有说明 Contributor/Discounted 档能否启用 ZDR。该档的存在前提是 Meta 可用 Content 训练，与请求级零保留在条款上相斥，但官方未表态，故如实记 not_found，不得反推为厂商拒绝提供。

points.text: Beyond the five purposes in §4.4, §6.1 also permits retaining Content in order to exercise Meta's rights to use Content under that section (that is, the training use is itself a ground for retention)
points.text_zh: §6.1 除 §4.4 的五项目的外，另允许为『行使 Meta 在本节下的内容使用权』而保留 Content(即训练用途本身构成保留理由)

points.text: §6.1 also points to Meta's consumer Privacy Policy, whose wording is case-by-case as needed with no fixed period. No quantified period.
points.text_zh: §6.1 同时指向 Meta 消费者隐私政策，该政策的口径是按需个案判断、无固定期限。无量化期限。

points.text: Same as top-level processing_region

points.text: The Discounted tier sets no separate processing-location clause.

role.quote: You agree that Meta may use your Content to train, develop, evaluate, and improve Meta’s artificial intelligence models, products, and services.

points.text: Section 6 contains no Service Provider or Processor wording at all (the opposite of §5.1), and Content is used by Meta to train Meta's own models, i.e. used for Meta's own purposes, which is not an entrusted processor. This is a determination that "this section makes no processor statement", and the anchor can only land on the own-purpose use clause in §6.1.
points.text_zh: §6 全文没有 Service Provider / Processor 表述(与 §5.1 相反)，Content 被 Meta 用于训练自己的模型，即为自身目的使用，不属于受托处理方。此项是『该节未作 processor 声明』的判断，锚点只能落在 §6.1 的自身目的使用条款上。

training.quote: 在经安全加密技术处理、去标识化且无法重新识别特定个人的前提下，我们可能会将输入内容、输出内容、行为信息进行分析和用于模型训练，以不断调整优化模型效果和产品体验。

points.text: MiniMax Code Privacy Policy (the official index page minimaxi.com/privacy-policy-v2-cn.html points the "MiniMax Code Privacy Policy" entry at code.minimaxi.com/doc/zh/privacy-policy.html, which 302-redirects to this page), §1.7.2 verbatim: "Provided that the data has been processed with secure encryption technology, de-identified and cannot be used to re-identify a specific individual, we may analyse input content, output content and behavioural information and use them for model training, so as to continuously tune and improve model performance and the product experience." — after de-identification the data "may" be used for model training, with no off switch. The API side points the same way: Open Platform User Agreement §5.4 "we will access and process customer data in accordance with this agreement for the purposes of providing MiniMax Open Platform services and improving algorithmic services", and §6.3 "provided the data is de-identified and cannot be used to re-identify a specific individual ... we may use the inputs collected by the service and the corresponding outputs for optimizing the services under this agreement and for statistical analysis, troubleshooting and security risk control". Both are conditional (de-identified) grants, and none of the three China-site Open Platform agreements contains a "not used for training" commitment to the contrary. Value recorded on the conservative reading: "may be used for model training / service optimization after de-identification".
points.text_zh: MiniMax Code 隐私政策（官方索引页 minimaxi.com/privacy-policy-v2-cn.html 把『MiniMax Code 隐私政策』入口指定为 code.minimaxi.com/doc/zh/privacy-policy.html，302 到本页）1.7.2 逐字写：『在经安全加密技术处理、去标识化且无法重新识别特定个人的前提下，我们可能会将输入内容、输出内容、行为信息进行分析和用于模型训练，以不断调整优化模型效果和产品体验。』——去标识化后『可能』用于模型训练，无关闭开关。API 侧同向：开放平台用户协议 5.4『为提供MiniMax开放平台服务和提升算法服务之目的…访问和处理客户数据』、6.3『去标识化且无法重新识别特定个人的前提下…输入及对应输出，用于本协议下服务的优化以及统计分析、问题排查、安全风控』。两处均为有条件（去标识化）授权，且中国站三份开放平台协议全文无『不用于训练』的反向承诺。取值口径=按保守情形记『去标识化后可能用于模型训练/服务优化』。

points.text: None of the current China-site agreements contains a zero-retention commitment of the "prompts/responses are not stored once the request has been processed" kind, and there is no application path for zero retention. The two closest passages are not ZDR: the Open Platform Privacy Policy says "we will not bind or create any association between your conversations and the personal information you gave when registering for or applying to the Open Platform ... conversation content that may be your personal information is filtered, deleted and not stored" — the subject is personal information, not request content as a whole
points.text_zh: 中国站现行协议全文均无『请求处理完成后不存储 prompt/response』式零保留承诺，也无零保留申请入口。最接近的两处都不是 ZDR：开放平台隐私政策『我们不会将您的对话和您注册、申请开放平台时的个人信息进行绑定或建立任何关联…对可能是您的个人信息…过滤、删除并不予保存』——主语是个人信息，不是请求内容整体

points.text: MiniMax Code Privacy Policy §3.1.2: "we retain your personal information only for the period necessary for the purpose of providing the service" — retention for a necessary period, which is retention rather than zero retention. Scope searched: the China-site sitemap.xml registers only 4 agreement pages (user-agreement / privacy-policy / paid-agreement / auto-renewal); probes of /protocol/token-plan-terms and /protocol/terms both returned HTTP 404
points.text_zh: MiniMax Code 隐私政策 3.1.2『仅在为提供服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的个人信息』——必要期间保留，属保留而非零保留。穷尽范围：中国站 sitemap.xml 登记的协议页只有 4 个（user-agreement / privacy-policy / paid-agreement / auto-renewal），另探测 /protocol/token-plan-terms、/protocol/terms 均为 HTTP 404

points.text: The documentation site has no dedicated data-security page (404).
points.text_zh: 文档站无 data-security 专题页（404）。

retention.quote: 我们仅为实现目的所必需的最短时间保留您的个人信息，

points.text: Recorded separately by object: (1) Personal information — Open Platform Privacy Policy "we retain your personal information only for the shortest time necessary to achieve the purpose", deleted or anonymized once that period is exceeded, and deleted or anonymized after the service is terminated
points.text_zh: 按对象分开记：①个人信息——开放平台隐私政策『我们仅为实现目的所必需的最短时间保留您的个人信息』，超期后删除或匿名化，终止服务后删除或匿名化

points.text: MiniMax Code Privacy Policy §3.1.2 says the same (retention for the necessary period; deletion, destruction or anonymization on account cancellation, expiry of the period, or when no longer needed). Both are ceiling-style statements with no quantified number of days. (2) Request content itself (inputs and outputs) — no retention period committed
points.text_zh: MiniMax Code 隐私政策 3.1.2 同口径（必要期间保留，注销/期限届满/不再需要时删除、销毁或匿名化）。均为上限口径，无量化天数。②请求内容本体（输入输出）——无保留期限承诺

points.text: User Agreement §3.13 only provides that for "services that include a storage function", data is kept for the period set by that service's rules after the service expires or terminates and is deleted when the period ends
points.text_zh: 用户协议 3.13 仅规定『含存储功能的服务』到期或终止后按服务规则保留相应期限、届满删除

points.text: Paid Services Agreement §8.3(3): after termination of the service the company "has the right but not the obligation" to retain user data, which is not a commitment. (3) Uploaded media files — the Files API docs give quantified periods: video_understanding video files have a "maximum storage time of 7 days", and video_generation_input is "valid for 7 days (after expiry a generation request returns file expired and the file must be re-uploaded)". (4) Context / KV cache — the passive cache's expiry is "adjusted automatically according to system load", and the Anthropic-style explicit cache has a "5 min expiry, automatically renewed with continued use".
points.text_zh: 付费协议 8.3(3) 服务终止后对用户数据『有权利但无义务』保留，不是承诺。③上传媒体文件——Files API 文档给出量化期限：video_understanding 视频文件『最长保存时间为 7 天』，video_generation_input『有效期 7 天（过期后发起生成返回 file expired，需重新上传）』。④上下文/KV 缓存——被动缓存过期时间『根据系统负载自动调整』，Anthropic 主动缓存『5min过期时间，持续使用会自动续期』。

points.text_zh: 开放平台隐私政策『我们将在中华人民共和国境内收集的个人信息存储在中华人民共和国境内』

points.text_zh: 用户协议 3.16 要求用户『在中国境内（不含香港、澳门、中国台湾地区）使用服务』——三处同向。但主语均限定为『个人信息』，未见针对 API 请求内容本体处理地域的独立声明

points.text: Recorded separately by mode of use, both with source text: (1) When the subscription quota is used inside the official Agent product MiniMax Code — the "Data Processing" clause (DPA) in Article 7 of the MiniMax User Agreement: "You confirm and agree that, as between you and us, you are the data handler and the entrusting party, and we, as the entrusted party you have engaged, assist you in processing data according to your instructions and purposes", and the entrusted party "may process data only according to your instructions and purposes", with this agreement and the service rules constituting the "complete instructions" — MiniMax is the entrusted party. (2) When the subscription key (sk-cp) calls the Open Platform API directly — the role table in the Open Platform Privacy Policy labels the "API call" scenario "personal information handler" and the "enterprise SDK integration" scenario "entrusted party for personal information processing"
points.text_zh: 按使用方式分开记，两者都有原文：①在官方 Agent 应用 MiniMax Code 中使用订阅额度时——《MiniMax用户协议》第七条『数据处理』(DPA)：『在您与我们之间，您是数据处理者和委托方，根据您的指示和目的，我们作为接受您委托的受托方，协助您处理数据』，且受托方『只能依照您的指示和目的处理数据』，本协议与服务规则构成『完整的指示』——MiniMax 为受托方。②订阅 Key（sk-cp）直接调用开放平台 API 时——开放平台隐私政策角色表把『调用API』场景标注为『个人信息处理者』、『企业 SDK 接入』场景标注为『个人信息处理受托方』

points.text: Open Platform User Agreement §5.1/§5.2 require the customer to obtain the end user's authorization before transmitting data to MiniMax for processing. The same company assigns itself different roles in different scenarios; recorded separately as written, without reconciling them.
points.text_zh: 开放平台用户协议 5.1/5.2 要求客户自行取得终端用户授权后再把数据传输给 MiniMax 处理。同一家在不同场景自认角色不同，如实分记不调和。
