training.quote: Mistral AI will not use Customer Data or Outputs to train its artificial intelligence models except (a) when you (i) opted-in to training on a Mistral AI Product set to opt-out by default or (ii) have not opted-out of training on a Mistral AI Product set to opt-in by default, (b) when Customer or an End User provides Feedback to Mistral AI, (c) as otherwise may be provided in an Order Form or (d) when Customer uses Labs or Preview Models.

points.text: Commercial ToS §4.2 is a direct contract-level clause: "Mistral AI will not use Customer Data or Outputs to train its artificial intelligence models", except (a) where the customer opted in to training on a Mistral AI Product set to opt-out by default, or has not opted out of training on a Product set to opt-in by default, (b) where Customer or an End User provides Feedback, (c) as otherwise provided in an Order Form, or (d) where Customer uses Labs or Preview Models
points.text_zh: Commercial ToS §4.2 是合同层的直接条款:Mistral AI 不会用 Customer Data / Outputs 训练其模型,例外为 (a) 产品被设为 opt-out by default 时用户主动 opt-in,或产品被设为 opt-in by default 时用户未 opt-out、(b) Feedback、(c) Order Form 另行约定、(d) Labs / Preview 模型

points.text: §4.1 expressly puts model training outside the license granted by the customer ("excludes model training")
points.text_zh: §4.1 把 model training 明确排除在客户授予的许可之外

points.text: §4.3 states separately for Labs / Preview Models that "Mistral AI may use Customer Data and Outputs generated from Labs or Preview Models to train its artificial intelligence models" (use means training, and it is unaffected by the opt-out and ZDR available on other products). But DPA §2.3 in the same contract package authorizes Mistral AI to process Personal Data as Controller for training purposes, conditioned as "unless Customer is or has opted-out of training" (an opt-out regime: training by default unless the customer opts out), and DPA §11.2 provides that the DPA prevails in the event of conflict → the two contract-level clauses conflict, so §4.2's "no training by default" cannot stand on its own. The former direct statement at product/developer level (the old docs page "Privacy and data controls": "API: data sent through the API isn't used for model training.") now returns 404 and has been removed from the docs sitemap (896 entries)
points.text_zh: §4.3 对 Labs / Preview 模型另有明示(用了就训练,且不受其他产品的 opt-out 与 ZDR 影响)。但同一合同包内的 DPA §2.3 授权 Mistral AI 以 Controller 身份为训练目的处理 Personal Data,条件写作『unless Customer is or has opted-out of training』(即 opt-out 制:默认训练,除非客户退出),且 DPA §11.2 规定冲突时以 DPA 为准 → 合同层两条互相冲突,§4.2 的『默认不训练』不能单独成立。产品/开发者层原先的直接声明(旧 docs 页『Privacy and data controls』:API : data sent through the API isn't used for model training.)现行 404、已从 docs sitemap(896 条)移除

points.text: The current Help Center says of Studio Pay-as-you-go only that "Customers retain full control over this processing and have the right to opt out at any time.", no longer stating that there is no training by default, while the Free mode paragraph on the same page says plainly "we may use your data (input and output) to train". Conclusion: the current official texts cannot establish that paid API inputs and outputs are not used for training by default, hence confidence=low (this is a disclosure conflict/gap, not a commitment to the contrary by the vendor).
points.text_zh: 现行 Help Center 对 Studio Pay-as-you-go 只写『Customers retain full control over this processing and have the right to opt out at any time.』,不再声明默认不训练,而同页 Free mode 段明写『we may use your data (input and output) to train』。结论:现行官方文本无法确证付费 API 输入输出默认不训练,故 confidence=low(这是披露冲突/缺口,不等于厂商反向承诺)。

points.text: Structured conclusion: the contract layer conflicts with itself (§4.2 says no training by default; DPA §2.3 authorizes processing for training purposes as Controller under an opt-out regime, and DPA §11.2 gives the DPA precedence), and the current Help Center no longer states a no-training default. Under the conservative assumption (✓ requires an explicit no-training commitment) the tier is recorded as mark=no (used for training) with mode=opt_out. Both clauses are kept side by side; no averaging.
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：合同层自相冲突（§4.2 默认不训练 vs DPA §2.3 授权以 Controller 身份为训练目的处理、opt-out 制，且 §11.2 冲突时 DPA 优先），现行 Help Center 又不再声明默认不训练。按保守假设（✓ 要求明确的不训练承诺）记 mark=no（会训练）+ mode=opt_out；两条官方文本并列保留，不取平均。

zdr.quote: ZDR is available on paid plans for supported stateless API calls.

points.text: Official developer documentation, ZDR page (current this round, 2026-09-21): "ZDR is available on paid plans for supported stateless API calls", and once enabled Mistral "does not store or log inputs and outputs for supported API requests" beyond what is needed to generate the output. It covers stateless endpoints such as /v1/chat/completions, /v1/fim/completions, /v1/embeddings, moderations, classifications, ocr and audio, and does not apply to stateful APIs or products (Agents, Batch, Conversations, Libraries, /v1/files, Vibe Work, Chat) or to Labs models. Application-based: a justification must be submitted to support, "We review each request and may approve or deny it.", and once approved it appears in Admin privacy settings
points.text_zh: 官方开发者文档 ZDR 页(本轮 2026-09-21 现行):ZDR 在付费计划上对受支持的无状态 API 调用可用,启用后 Mistral 不会为受支持的 API 请求存储或记录输入输出(超出生成输出所需)。覆盖 /v1/chat/completions、/v1/fim/completions、/v1/embeddings、moderations、classifications、ocr、audio 等无状态端点,不覆盖 stateful API 与产品(Agents、Batch、Conversations、Libraries、/v1/files、Vibe Work、Chat)与 Labs 模型。申请制:需向支持提交正当理由,逐案审核,可批准或拒绝,批准后出现在 Admin privacy settings

points.text: ZDR and training opt-out are two separate controls. Help Center 347612 (updated 2026-08-12) is stricter in wording: pay-as-you-go only (Free mode must first enable pay-as-you-go), stateless APIs only. At contract level, DPA §2.3 excludes abuse monitoring as a processing purpose "when zero data retention has been activated", so ZDR is recognized in the DPA.
points.text_zh: ZDR 与训练 opt-out 是两个独立控制。Help Center 347612(2026-08-12 更新)措辞更严:仅 pay-as-you-go(Free mode 需先开通按量付费)、仅无状态 API。合同层另有 DPA §2.3:滥用监测这一处理目的在『zero data retention has been activated』时被排除,即 ZDR 在 DPA 里被承认。

retention.quote: Except for specific APIs, we keep your Input and Output for the period necessary to generate the Output and then for thirty (30) rolling days to monitor abuse (unless zero data retention is activated).

points.text: Privacy Policy §5: "Except for specific APIs, we keep your Input and Output for the period necessary to generate the Output and then for thirty (30) rolling days to monitor abuse (unless zero data retention is activated)." Exception: with the Agents API, Input and Output are kept until the account is terminated
points.text_zh: Privacy Policy §5:除特定 API 外,Input / Output 在生成输出所需时间之后滚动保留 30 天用于滥用监测,除非启用 ZDR。例外:Agents API 的 Input / Output 保留至销户

points.text: With the Fine-Tuning API, fine-tuning data is kept until it is deleted or the account is terminated. DPA §10.1 separately provides that Personal Data will no longer be accessible upon expiry of a thirty (30) day period following termination (a termination-cleanup rule). The ZDR page and Help Center 347612 give the contrasting state once ZDR is enabled (no longer retained). Help Center 347628 adds statutory retention periods for account-level data (identity data 5 years, account data 1 year, technical data 1 rolling year, invoices 10 years), but that is account/billing data, not API inputs and outputs.
points.text_zh: Fine-Tuning API 的微调数据保留至主动删除或销户。DPA §10.1 另定终止后 30 天内 Personal Data 不再可访问(终止清理口径)。ZDR 页与 Help Center 347612 给出启用 ZDR 后的对照态(不再留存)。Help Center 347628 补充账户类数据的法定保留期(身份数据 5 年、账户数据 1 年、技术数据 1 滚动年、发票 10 年),但那是账号/账单数据而非 API 输入输出。

processing_region.quote: Mistral does not commit to a specific inference location for requests sent to this endpoint.

points.text: Official developer documentation, Regional inference page (independently re-checked this round): the default global endpoint is api.mistral.ai, and Mistral states expressly that "Mistral does not commit to a specific inference location for requests sent to this endpoint"
points.text_zh: 官方开发者文档 Regional inference 页(本轮独立复核):默认 global 端点 api.mistral.ai,官方明确『Mistral does not commit to a specific inference location for requests sent to this endpoint』

points.text: Regional endpoints api.eu.mistral.ai (multiple data centers in EU and EFTA countries, 1.1x price) and api.us.mistral.ai (multiple data centers in the United States)
points.text_zh: 区域端点 api.eu.mistral.ai(EU 与 EFTA 多数据中心,加价 1.1×)与 api.us.mistral.ai(美国多数据中心)

points.text: Regionalization covers inference only; control-plane data (account configuration, API keys, billing, access management, usage analytics and other operational metadata) may still be handled by Mistral systems outside the selected geography
points.text_zh: 区域化只覆盖推理,控制面数据(账号配置、API key、账单、访问管理、用量分析等运营元数据)仍可能在所选地理之外处理

points.text: Regionalization and ZDR are two separate controls. Help Center 347629 (updated 2026-08-12) adds that data is hosted in the EU by default and in the United States where the US API endpoint is used explicitly, and that some features may temporarily transfer data outside the EU (destinations listed in the Trust Center subprocessors). DPA §8.1 is the contractual authorization for cross-border transfers (adequacy-decision countries / appropriate safeguards / SCCs). Note the difference between the two statements: the Help Center speaks of hosting (storage) being in the EU by default, while the docs speak of the global endpoint not committing to an inference location.
points.text_zh: 区域化与 ZDR 是两个独立控制。Help Center 347629(2026-08-12 更新)补充:默认数据托管在欧盟,显式使用 US API 端点则托管在美国,部分功能可能临时把数据传出欧盟(去向见 Trust Center subprocessors)。DPA §8.1 为跨境传输的合同授权(充分性认定国家 / 适当保障 / SCC)。注意两处口径差异:Help Center 说的是『托管(存储)默认在欧盟』,docs 说的是『global 端点不承诺推理处理地』。

role.quote: Customer is the Controller of the Personal Data. Mistral AI Processes the Personal Data on behalf of Customer as a Processor.

points.text: DPA §2.1: "Customer is the Controller of the Personal Data. Mistral AI Processes the Personal Data on behalf of Customer as a Processor." (the DPA is incorporated into the Agreement by §11.2 and applies to commercial customers using the Products on Mistral AI Infrastructure). The role splits by data category: Commercial ToS §12.2 states that account-level Personal Data is collected and processed by Mistral AI as Data Controller (under its privacy policy), while §12.3 repeats the Processor role in the Mistral Infrastructure case and points to this DPA
points.text_zh: DPA §2.1:客户是 Personal Data 的 Controller,Mistral AI 以 Processor 身份代表客户处理(DPA 经 §11.2 并入协议,适用于在 Mistral AI Infrastructure 上使用产品的商业客户)。角色按数据类别分裂:Commercial ToS §12.2 明确账户类 Personal Data 由 Mistral AI 以 Data Controller 身份收集处理(依其隐私政策),§12.3 重申 Mistral Infrastructure 场景下的Processor 身份并指向本 DPA

points.text: DPA §2.3 lists the limited purposes for which Mistral may process as Controller (training, abuse monitoring, aggregated usage statistics). The general privacy policy's own Scope states that it "does not apply if you use our Mistral AI Products to process personal data in the context of your business activities" (in that case the customer is controller and Mistral the processor), consistent with this conclusion.
points.text_zh: DPA §2.3 列出 Mistral 以 Controller 身份可做的有限处理目的(训练、滥用监测、用量聚合统计)。通用隐私政策自身 Scope 明确不适用于『以企业身份处理个人数据』的场景(该场景客户是 controller、Mistral 是 processor),与本结论一致。

training.quote: Modal will not, except with Customer's prior written consent: (i) train any AI model using Customer Data, or (ii) export Customer Data into, or cause Customer Data to be ingested by, large language models.

points.text: Same as top-level training.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training。

points.text: Same as endpoints-shared: zero retention on the payload path.
points.text_zh: 同 endpoints-shared：payload 路径零保留。

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 30 天

points.text: Same as endpoints-shared: payloads are not stored

points.text: Logs are plan-dependent and metadata lasts for the lifetime of the account. Customer-supplied weights and custom images live in Images and Volumes, which is durable storage (retained until the customer deletes them).
points.text_zh: 日志按套餐、元数据随账户存续。客户自带权重与自定义镜像存放在 Images/Volumes，属持久存储（客户删除前保留）。

processing_region.quote: Modal will not process Customer Data on servers in other regions, except with Customer's prior written consent.

points.text: The data-residency page table: for Endpoints (Dedicated), both container region and routing region are Yes
points.text_zh: data-residency 页表格：Endpoints (Dedicated) 容器区域与路由区域均为 Yes

points.text_zh: 区域锁定严格。持久存储与日志仍在美国（同 data-residency 页）。

role.quote: Modal shall act as a Service Provider to Customer and shall collect, access, maintain, use, process, and transfer Customer Personal Data solely for the purpose of performing Modal's obligations under this Agreement for or on behalf of Customer and for no commercial purpose other than the performance of such obligations.

points.text: Same as top-level role.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role。

training.quote: Modal will not, except with Customer's prior written consent: (i) train any AI model using Customer Data, or (ii) export Customer Data into, or cause Customer Data to be ingested by, large language models.

points.text: Same as top-level training. §5.5.1 states that the Input and Output of AI Tools are Customer Data, so this tier's prompts and completions fall within the protection of §5.5.4, "will not train any AI model using Customer Data"
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training。§5.5.1 明确 AI Tools 的 Input 与 Output 属 Customer Data，故本档的 prompt 与 completion 落入 §5.5.4「不得用于训练 AI 模型」的保护范围

points.text: §5.5.3 further states that subcontractors processing Customer Data in order to provide AI Tools are on the subprocessor list. No clause was found that allows Modal to use inference requests to train models.
points.text_zh: §5.5.3 另说明为提供 AI Tools 而处理 Customer Data 的分包商在 subprocessor 名单上。未发现任何条款允许 Modal 用推理请求训练模型。

zdr.quote: Modal Inference endpoints are zero data retention: request and response payloads are never written to disk and pass through Modal’s infrastructure only as in-flight network traffic.

points.text: The Modal Inference endpoints section of the security page: request and response payloads "are never written to disk and pass through Modal’s infrastructure only as in-flight network traffic", in effect by default with no application required. The scope is limited to payloads and excludes logs and metadata.
points.text_zh: security 页 Modal Inference endpoints 节：请求与响应 payload「never written to disk and pass through Modal's infrastructure only as in-flight network traffic」，默认生效、无需申请。范围限于 payload，不含日志与元数据。

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 30 天
retention.quote: Dedicated Endpoints, Shared Endpoints, and Servers do not [store request and response payloads

points.text: Request and response payloads are not stored ("Dedicated Endpoints, Shared Endpoints, and Servers do not store request and response payloads"). But logs and metadata for the same product are still retained: app and container logs 1 or 30 days depending on plan, metadata for the lifetime of the account
points.text_zh: 请求与响应 payload 不存储（「Dedicated Endpoints, Shared Endpoints, and Servers do not store request and response payloads」）。但同产品的日志与元数据仍留存：应用/容器日志按套餐 1/30 天、元数据随账户存续

points.text: Audit logs are per Enterprise contract. Session affinity reuses the in-container KV prefix cache (endpoints docs), and the lifetime and purge rules of that cache are not disclosed — the unquantified item for retention on this tier.
points.text_zh: 审计日志按企业合同。会话亲和会复用容器内 KV 前缀缓存（endpoints 文档），该缓存的生命周期与清除规则官方未披露——这是本档 retention 的未量化项。

processing_region.quote: * _Shared Endpoints route through `us-west`, and containers are distributed across Modal’s global compute pool._

points.text: The data-residency page: for Shared Endpoints, neither the container region nor the routing region is selectable
points.text_zh: data-residency 页：Shared Endpoints 的容器区域与路由区域均不可选

points.text: Footnote: "Shared Endpoints route through us-west, and containers are distributed across Modal’s global compute pool"
points.text_zh: 脚注「Shared Endpoints route through us-west, and containers are distributed across Modal's global compute pool」

points.text: The shared-endpoints page is to the same effect. So region pinning is not possible on this tier, and customers with hard data residency requirements must switch to Dedicated Endpoints.
points.text_zh: shared-endpoints 页同旨。即本档无法做区域锁定，对数据驻留有硬要求的客户须改用 Dedicated Endpoints。

role.quote: Modal shall act as a Service Provider to Customer and shall collect, access, maintain, use, process, and transfer Customer Personal Data solely for the purpose of performing Modal's obligations under this Agreement for or on behalf of Customer and for no commercial purpose other than the performance of such obligations.

points.text: Same as top-level role. The operator of this tier is Modal itself (Modal hosts the compute pool and Modal bills), with no "third-party technical support provider" style resale layer
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role。本档的运营主体是 Modal 自己（Modal 托管算力池、Modal 计费），不存在「第三方技术支持商」式的转售层

points.text: Whether requests are forwarded to the original model vendor is disclosed neither in the documentation nor in the subprocessor list (which holds only cloud hosting providers and logging/monitoring/data-warehouse vendors). This is the unverified item for role on this tier.
points.text_zh: 请求是否转发给模型原厂，官方文档与 subprocessor 名单中均无披露（名单只有云托管商与日志/监控/数据仓库类）。这是本档 role 的未核项。

training.quote: Modal will not, except with Customer's prior written consent: (i) train any AI model using Customer Data, or (ii) export Customer Data into, or cause Customer Data to be ingested by, large language models.

points.text: Same as top-level training. The difference on the enterprise tier is that the §5.5.4 exception, "Customer's prior written consent", can be extended through a Service Order or a separate written authorization — that is, an arrangement of the form "may be used for training with written consent" is more likely to arise on the enterprise tier, but the public terms disclose no authorization that is on by default.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training。企业档的差异在 §5.5.4 的例外「Customer's prior written consent」可通过 Service Order 或单独书面授权扩展——即企业档更容易出现「经书面同意可用于训练」的约定，但公开条款未披露任何默认开启的授权。

zdr.quote: Modal Inference endpoints are zero data retention: request and response payloads are never written to disk and pass through Modal’s infrastructure only as in-flight network traffic.

points.text: Consistent with the self-serve tiers: the payload path for Endpoints and Servers is zero retention by default, and Functions have no zero retention. No separate ZDR commitment text was found for the enterprise tier.
points.text_zh: 与自助档一致：Endpoints/Servers 的 payload 路径默认零保留，Functions 无零保留。未发现企业档另有独立的 ZDR 承诺文本。

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: | App and container logs | [Functions](https://modal.com/docs/guide), [Sandboxes](https://modal.com/docs/guide/sandboxes) | Plan-dependent: 1 day on Starter, 30 days on Team, configurable on Enterprise

points.text: On the enterprise tier, app and container log retention is "configurable on Enterprise" and audit logs are "Per Enterprise contract" — both sit in the contract and the public documentation gives no numbers, so this is recorded as unspecified. The periods for the other objects are the same as on the self-serve tiers (Function inputs and outputs up to 7 days, payloads not written to disk, metadata for the lifetime of the account). In the BAA scenario there are further exclusions: Volumes v1, Images (not including Filesystem and Directory Snapshots), Memory Snapshots and user code fall outside the BAA commitment.
points.text_zh: 企业档的应用/容器日志保留期「configurable on Enterprise」，审计日志「Per Enterprise contract」——两项都落在合同里，公开文档不给数字，故记 unspecified。其余对象的期限与自助档相同（函数输入输出 ≤7 天、payload 不落盘、元数据随账户存续）。BAA 场景下另有排除项：Volumes v1、Images（不含 Filesystem/Directory Snapshots）、Memory Snapshots 与用户代码不在 BAA 承诺范围内。

processing_region.quote: Modal will not process Customer Data on servers in other regions, except with Customer's prior written consent.

points.text: Same as top-level processing_region. The enterprise tier can obtain more granular container region definitions (region-selection page: "Need access to more granular region definitions? Contact sales@modal.com"), but the public documentation gives no list.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 processing_region。企业档可获得更细粒度的容器区域定义（region-selection 页「Need access to more granular region definitions? Contact sales@modal.com」），但公开文档未给清单。

role.quote: Modal shall act as a Service Provider to Customer and shall collect, access, maintain, use, process, and transfer Customer Personal Data solely for the purpose of performing Modal's obligations under this Agreement for or on behalf of Customer and for no commercial purpose other than the performance of such obligations.

points.text: Same as top-level role. The enterprise tier also has a BAA path (security page: Modal is the business associate where you are processing PHI on Modal, and the BAA is offered on Enterprise), consistent with the processor characterization.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role。企业档另有 BAA 路径（security 页：Modal 在 PHI 场景下自认 business associate，BAA 在企业版提供），与 processor 定性一致。

training.quote: Modal will not, except with Customer's prior written consent: (i) train any AI model using Customer Data, or (ii) export Customer Data into, or cause Customer Data to be ingested by, large language models.

points.text: Same as top-level training: §5.5.4 bars training any AI model using Customer Data, except with Customer's prior written consent
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training：§5.5.4 禁止用 Customer Data 训练 AI 模型（除客户事先书面同意）

points.text: The Data privacy section of the security page separately commits that Modal will never access or use your source code, the inputs and outputs of your Modal Functions, or any data you store in Images or Volumes. A customer running their own training job on this tier is the customer's own act and does not change this conclusion.
points.text_zh: security 页 Data privacy 节另承诺不访问/不使用客户源代码、函数输入输出与 Images/Volumes 数据。客户在该档跑自己的训练任务是客户自己的行为，不改变本结论。

zdr.quote: | Request and response payloads | [Server](https://modal.com/docs/guide/servers) and [Auto Endpoints](https://modal.com/docs/guide/endpoints) | Not stored — proxied directly to your container |

points.text: This tier is internally inconsistent and has to be read in parts: Function inputs and outputs are retained for up to 7 days (the security page table row "Up to 7 days, then deleted"), so there is no zero retention for Functions
points.text_zh: 本档内不一致，必须分开看：Functions 的输入输出有上限 7 天的留存（security 页表行「Up to 7 days, then deleted」），故对 Functions 无零保留

points.text: For Servers, request and response payloads are "Not stored — proxied directly to your container", sharing the zero-retention path with Endpoints. Logs and metadata are not included and are still retained for their own periods.
points.text_zh: Servers 的请求与响应 payload「Not stored — proxied directly to your container」，与 Endpoints 同享零保留路径。日志与元数据不在此列，仍按各自期限留存。

retention.quote: Up to 7 days, then deleted

points.text: Retention on this tier (object → period): Function input and output content up to 7 days (a maximum TTL)
points.text_zh: 本档保留期（对象→期限）：函数输入输出正文 ≤7 天（上限）

points.text: Request and response payloads for Servers are not written to disk
points.text_zh: Servers 的请求响应 payload 不落盘

points.text: App and container logs are plan-dependent: 1 day on Starter, 30 days on Team, configurable on Enterprise
points.text_zh: 应用/容器日志按套餐 1 天（Starter）/30 天（Team）/企业版可配置

points.text: Metadata is stored for the lifetime of the account
points.text_zh: 元数据随账户存续

points.text: Volumes and Images persist until the customer deletes them
points.text_zh: Volumes/Images 持久直到客户删除

points.text: Memory snapshots 7 days, filesystem and directory snapshots 30 days (configurable)
points.text_zh: 内存快照 7 天、文件系统与目录快照 30 天（可配置）

points.text: Dict entries 7 days
points.text_zh: Dicts 条目 7 天

points.text: Queue partitions have a default TTL of 24h
points.text_zh: Queues 分区默认 24h TTL

points.text: Audit logs are per Enterprise contract. At the contract layer, ToS §5.4, Customer Data "is expunged promptly following completion of processing", and §3.3, the account is deleted within 60 days following the termination date.
points.text_zh: 审计日志按企业合同。合同层 ToS §5.4「expunged promptly following completion of processing」、§3.3 账户终止后 60 天内删除。

processing_region.quote: Modal will not process Customer Data on servers in other regions, except with Customer's prior written consent.

points.text: Same as top-level processing_region: container and routing regions can be specified (region= / routing_region= for Functions, compute_region= for Servers), and region pinning is strict
points.text_zh: 同顶层 processing_region：容器与路由区域可指定（Functions 用 region=/routing_region=、Servers 用 compute_region=），区域锁定严格

points.text: Durable storage and logs are fixed in the United States
points.text_zh: 持久存储与日志固定在美国

points.text: Cross-border transfer is governed by DPA §11.1. Sandboxes have no routing-region concept (the data plane connects directly to the container, while lifecycle requests go through the us-east control plane).
points.text_zh: 跨境受 DPA §11.1 约束。Sandboxes 无路由区域概念（数据面直连容器，生命周期请求经 us-east 控制面）。

role.quote: Modal shall act as a Service Provider to Customer and shall collect, access, maintain, use, process, and transfer Customer Personal Data solely for the purpose of performing Modal's obligations under this Agreement for or on behalf of Customer and for no commercial purpose other than the performance of such obligations.

points.text: Same as top-level role: DPA §2.3.1 states that "Modal shall act as a Service Provider to Customer", SCC Modules 2/3 are entered into in the processor capacity, §2.1 sets the purpose limitation, and ToS §1.8 leaves all right, title and interest with the customer, granting Modal only a limited licence.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role：DPA §2.3.1 自认 Service Provider、SCC Module 2/3 以 processor 身份签署、§2.1 目的限制、ToS §1.8 客户保留所有权仅给有限许可。

points.text: China-site conclusion: undisclosed by the vendor (not_found) — there is neither an admission that "the platform uses API inputs/outputs to train or optimize models" nor an explicit "not used for training" commitment, and the latter must not be read as the former. Checked: the full text of both China-site agreements (User Agreement 2025-08-27, Privacy Policy 2024-06-05) plus every policy-type document on the docs site (content compliance review, AI ethics initiative, the three API-Inference pages, the Magicube credit system, FlexTrain, deployment introduction). The word "training" appears in only three places on the China site, none of them about the platform training on user data: (1) User Agreement §4.1(8) "in order to improve your experience, this community may provide you with a certain amount of free computing resources, which you may use for model training and other related development activities" — this is **the user training their own model on the platform's free compute** (with a requirement to credit "this model was trained with technical support from the ModelScope community"), the opposite direction from "the platform trains on your data"
points.text_zh: 中国站结论：官方未披露（not_found），既没有「平台使用 API 输入/输出训练或优化模型」的自认，也没有「不用于训练」的明确承诺——不得把后者当成前者来解读。原绑的 §3.2.1 授权清单只界定用户内容许可的范围（列举托管、存储、传输、公开展示等，未含模型训练），它既未授权也未排除平台训练，不构成对本维度的表述，已撤锚；查阅范围见 searched。核过中国站两份协议全文（用户协议 2025-08-27、隐私政策 2024-06-05）+ docs 站全部政策类文档（内容合规审查、AI 伦理倡议书、API-Inference 三页、魔粒体系、FlexTrain、部署简介）。「训练」一词在中国站的分布只有三类，全部与平台使用用户数据训练无关：(1) 用户协议 §4.1(8)「为提升您的使用体验，本社区可能为您提供一定额度的免费计算资源，您可将其用于模型训练等相关开发活动」——这是**用户用平台免费算力训练自己的模型**（并要求标注「本模型训练获得魔搭社区技术支持」），方向与「平台拿你的数据训练」相反

points.text: (2) Privacy Policy §2.4.2 "to try out online model debugging, training and deployment, you may choose to bind an Alibaba Cloud account" — a user-side feature entry point
points.text_zh: (2) 隐私政策 §2.4.2「为体验模型在线调试、训练及部署能力，您可选择绑定阿里云账号」——是用户侧功能入口

points.text: (3) User Agreement §4.2.1(2), the compliance obligation of Studio creators for "management of training data and generated content" — the obligation falls on the creator. The two clauses closest to this dimension are: Privacy Policy §2.3.2, which limits the purpose of collecting "the text, voice, images and video you input, reply with or generate" to "providing you with those services" and adds that the platform "has the right to display your nickname, avatar and published content"
points.text_zh: (3) 用户协议 §4.2.1(2) 创空间创建者的「训练数据与生成内容管理」合规义务——义务落在创建者身上。与本维度最接近的两条条款是：隐私政策 §2.3.2 把「您输入、回复、生成的文字、语音、图片、视频」收集目的限定为「为向您提供该等服务」并「有权展示您的昵称、头像和发布内容」

points.text: The license list in User Agreement §3.2.1 is to host, store, transmit, publicly display, publicly perform, communicate to the public, reproduce, create derivative works and distribute, and **does not include model training or model optimization**. Two clauses pulling the other way must be recorded alongside: User Agreement §3.2.1(2) says plainly that "we may access or share your private user content in accordance with what is set out in our privacy policy", and §4.1(2) reserves the right to review user content (including Demo inputs, see the content compliance review document) by technical or human means. Uncertainties: (a) the privacy policy gives no affirmative "not used for training without explicit authorization" commitment of the kind PPIO gives, and no switch for any training purpose
points.text_zh: 用户协议 §3.2.1 的授权清单是托管、存储、传输、公开展示、公开表演、向公众传播、复制、创建衍生作品、分发，**不含模型训练/模型优化**。另有两条反向张力的条款须并列：用户协议 §3.2.1(2) 明说「我们可能会根据我们的隐私政策中规定的内容访问或分享您的私有用户内容」，§4.1(2) 保留对用户内容（含 Demo 输入，见内容合规审查文档）的技术或人工审核权。不确定性：(a) 隐私政策没有像 PPIO 那样给出「未经明确授权不用于训练」的正面承诺，也没有给出任何训练用途的选项开关

points.text: (b) On the API-Inference path, the public documentation says only that "compute is provided by Alibaba Cloud", and whether Alibaba Cloud retains or trains on inputs and outputs is not disclosed in this vendor's documents
points.text_zh: (b) API-Inference 的推理链路上，公开文档只写「由阿里云提供算力支持」，阿里云侧对输入输出是否留存/训练未在本家文档披露

points.text: (c) This conclusion covers the China site only
points.text_zh: (c) 本结论只覆盖中国站

points.text: The international site has its own separate conclusion.
points.text_zh: 国际站另有独立结论。

points.text: Removed anchor: §3.2.1(2) "we will use reasonable and appropriate measures to keep your content confidential ... however, we may access or share your private user content as provided in our privacy policy" is a confidentiality clause with a carve-out, not a statement about zero retention; it neither promises nor denies ZDR, so it is not a statement on this dimension. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：§3.2.1(2)「我们将使用合理和适当的措施来保密您的内容……然而，我们可能会根据我们的隐私政策中规定的内容访问或分享您的私有用户内容」是保密义务条款加例外口子，不是关于零保留的表述——既不承诺也不否认 ZDR，故不构成对本维度的表述。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: China-site conclusion: no zero data retention (ZDR) commitment, switch or application path exists in any public document. Scope checked: User Agreement, Privacy Policy, content compliance review, AI ethics initiative, API-Inference usage limits / introduction / API-Provider, the Magicube credit system, FlexTrain, deployment introduction, the two stable protocol entry points (SPAs whose body r.jina.ai cannot fetch and whose direct HTML has no embedded body), and the official document version API. The keywords "zero data retention / zero retention / not stored / not written to disk / not retained / deleted once the request is processed" return zero hits in the full text of both agreements (and zero hits in the two English international-site documents). Three observations that are incompatible with, or at least do not support, ZDR (not equivalent to "the vendor refuses ZDR"): (1) User Agreement §3.2.1 grants an "irrevocable" license to host, store and distribute content, and §3.2.1(2) states expressly that private user content may be accessed
points.text_zh: 中国站结论：全部公开文档中不存在零数据保留（ZDR）承诺、开关或申请入口。核过的范围：用户协议、隐私政策、内容合规审查、AI 伦理倡议书、API-Inference 使用限制/介绍/API-Provider、魔粒体系、FlexTrain、部署简介、两个 protocol 稳定入口（SPA，r.jina.ai 抓不到正文，直连 HTML 亦无内嵌正文）、官方文档版本 API。关键词「零数据保留 / 零保留 / 不存储 / 不落盘 / 不留存 / 请求处理完成后删除 / zero retention」在两份协议全文零命中（国际站英文两份亦零命中）。三条与 ZDR 相斥或至少不支持的观察（不等价于「厂商拒绝 ZDR」）：(1) 用户协议 §3.2.1 给出「不可撤销」的内容托管/存储/分发授权，§3.2.1(2) 明确可能访问私有用户内容

points.text: (2) Privacy Policy §6.2 sets a "period necessary for the purpose", not per-request immediate deletion
points.text_zh: (2) 隐私政策 §6.2 是「目的所需期限」而非请求级即时删除

points.text: (3) The content compliance review document states that the platform reviews "the input of model Demos" by technical or human means — review means the input can be accessed on the platform's side. Recorded as not_found under the ledger's rules: the absence of public evidence is not the same as the vendor not offering ZDR
points.text_zh: (3) 内容合规审查文档说明平台会对「模型Demo的输入」做技术或人工审核——审核意味着输入在平台侧可被接触。按台账规则记 not_found：拿不到公开证据 ≠ 厂商不提供 ZDR

points.text: This vendor has no enterprise privacy FAQ, no public DPA and no trust/security compliance page to check (no document of that kind exists in the full enumeration of the docs site index).
points.text_zh: 本家没有企业版隐私 FAQ、没有公开 DPA、没有 trust/security 合规页可查（docs 站 index 全量枚举中不存在这类文档）。

retention.quote: 我们只会在达成本政策所述目的所需的期限内保留您的用户信息，除非受到法律的允许

points.text: China-site conclusion: no quantified retention period, only the principle of "the period necessary for the purpose + deletion or anonymization once exceeded", with an express acknowledgement of delayed deletion from backups. Objects and context, itemized: **Object** — Privacy Policy §2.3.1 brings "the text, voice, images and video you input, reply with or generate" within user content, and the appendix further lists "conversation content" as part of "log information" ("including time, user ID, conversation ID, conversation content, as well as IP address, browser type, telecom carrier, language, and date and time of access"), so on the China site inference interaction content and access logs are covered by the same "user information / personal information" regime and the documents do not regulate them separately. **Period** — §6.2 "we retain your user information only for the period necessary to achieve the purposes stated in this policy, unless permitted by law. Once that retention period is exceeded, we will delete or anonymize your personal information" (ceiling-type, unquantified, a statement of principle rather than a verifiable number of days). **Exceptions and triggers** — (1) §4.3.3 delayed deletion from backups: "because of applicable law and security-technology limits, we may not be able to delete the corresponding information from backup systems immediately ... until the backup can be cleared or anonymized"
points.text_zh: 中国站结论：没有量化保留期限，只有「目的所需期限 + 超期删除或匿名化」的原则，且明确承认备份延迟删除。对象与语境逐条列清：**对象**——隐私政策 §2.3.1 把「您输入、回复、生成的文字、语音、图片、视频」纳入用户内容，附录又把「对话内容」列为「日志信息」的组成部分（「包括时间、用户ID、对话ID、对话内容，以及IP地址、浏览器类型、电信运营商、使用语言、访问日期和时间」），即推理交互内容与访问日志在中国站是被同一套「用户信息/个人信息」口径覆盖的，文档没有把二者分开规定。**期限**——§6.2「我们只会在达成本政策所述目的所需的期限内保留您的用户信息，除非受到法律的允许。超出上述用户信息保存期限后，我们会对您的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理」（上限型、未量化；属原则性表述，不是可核对的天数）。**例外与触发点**——(1) §4.3.3 备份延迟删除：「因为适用的法律和安全技术限制，我们可能无法立即从备份系统中删除相应的信息……直到备份可以清除或实现匿名化」

points.text: (2) §4.5.2 deletion after account cancellation, "except where laws, regulations or industry supervisory rules provide otherwise"
points.text_zh: (2) §4.5.2 注销后删除「但法律法规或行业监管规则另有规定的除外」

points.text: (3) §6.5 deletion or anonymization of personal information held when operations cease
points.text_zh: (3) §6.5 停止运营时对持有个人信息删除或匿名化

points.text: (4) User Agreement §9.2.1 "once the feature is withdrawn, your right to use this community terminates immediately and any information you have stored in this community may be unrecoverable" — no retention is promised when a free feature is withdrawn
points.text_zh: (4) 用户协议 §9.2.1「一旦功能取消，您使用本社区的权利立即终止，您在本社区中储存的任何信息可能无法恢复」——免费功能取消不承诺保留

points.text: (5) The corresponding international-site text (which does not apply to the China site) separately says that data stored by the platform "may be removed or rendered inaccessible from time to time". **What is absent**: no request-level retention commitment (such as 0 days or 30 days)
points.text_zh: (5) 国际站对应文本（不适用中国站）另说平台存储的数据「may be removed or rendered inaccessible from time to time」。**没有的东西**：没有请求级保留期（如 0 天/30 天）的承诺

points.text: No retention rule for a KV cache or prompt cache (the docs site has no documentation for such a feature)
points.text_zh: 没有 KV 缓存/Prompt 缓存的保留规则（docs 站没有相关功能文档）

points.text: And no "network logs kept for no less than six months" floor of the kind common on Chinese sites — that wording appears nowhere in either ModelScope China-site agreement, so the practice of other domestic vendors cannot be carried over. Uncertainty: how long call logs on the free API-Inference tier are actually kept is not disclosed.
points.text_zh: 也没有国内站常见的「相关网络日志不少于六个月」下限表述——魔搭中国站两份协议全文都没有出现该表述，因此不能按其他国内厂商的口径套用。不确定性：免费档 API-Inference 的调用日志实际保留多久，官方未披露。

processing_region.quote: 原则上，我们在中华人民共和国境内开展业务过程中产生或收集的个人信息，将存储在中华人民共和国境内

points.text: China-site conclusion: personal information generated by the community service is, in principle, stored within China. Privacy Policy §6.6: "In principle, personal information generated or collected in the course of our business within the People's Republic of China is stored within the People's Republic of China; unless it is necessary to provide you with a service, in which case we will transfer your personal information abroad only after obtaining your separate consent and taking the other measures required by laws and regulations"
points.text_zh: 中国站结论：社区服务产生的个人信息原则上境内存储。隐私政策 §6.6「原则上，我们在中华人民共和国境内开展业务过程中产生或收集的个人信息，将存储在中华人民共和国境内；除非为向您提供某项服务所必需，我们会在获得您单独同意，并采取其他法律法规要求的措施下，方会向境外传输您的个人信息」

points.text: User Agreement §10.2 adds that "this community is intended for users in mainland China, and we do not warrant that the service is suitable or available for access or use outside mainland China". Three pieces of circumstantial support on the compute and account side (same direction, but product-implementation descriptions rather than regional commitments): the API-Inference usage limits document says "the free inference API is backed by compute provided by Alibaba Cloud" and requires "binding an Alibaba Cloud account" with real-name verification
points.text_zh: 用户协议 §10.2 进一步限定「本社区旨在供中华人民共和国内地用户使用，我们不保证该服务适合或可供中国内地以外的地区访问或使用」。算力与账号侧的三条旁证（同一方向，但它们是产品实现描述而非地域承诺）：API-Inference 使用限制文档「免费推理API由阿里云提供算力支持」且强制「绑定阿里云账号」并实名认证

points.text: The FlexTrain training service: "ModelScope works with Alibaba Cloud PAI-DLC", connected over a virtual private cloud
points.text_zh: FlexTrain 训练服务「ModelScope与阿里云PAI-DLC合作」并通过专有网络链接

points.text: The deployment service "supports mainstream Alibaba Cloud infrastructure" (Function Compute FC, PAI-EAS and others). Uncertainties: (a) those three only show that the compute is on Alibaba Cloud (domestic regions), which is not a contractual commitment that "inference request content does not leave the country"
points.text_zh: 部署服务「支持主流阿里云基础设施」（函数计算 FC、PAI-EAS 等）。不确定性：(a) 上述三处只说明算力在阿里云（国内 Region），不等于「推理请求内容不出境」的合同承诺

points.text: (b) On the API-Provider tier (where the user explicitly selects an external provider such as DashScope or DeepSeek), requests are forwarded to a third party and the processing location is decided by that provider; this vendor's documentation makes no regional commitment at all — that tier is outside this ledger's coverage (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio / DashScope is a separate provider)
points.text_zh: (b) API-Provider 档（用户显式选择 DashScope/DeepSeek 等外部提供方）会把请求转发给第三方，处理地由该提供方决定，本家文档未作任何地域承诺——此档不在本台账覆盖范围（阿里云百炼/DashScope 是另一 provider）

points.text: (c) Privacy Policy §3.2 permits user information to be shared where it is "necessary to conclude or perform a contract to which you are a party" and in similar cases, without limiting where the recipient is located.
points.text_zh: (c) 隐私政策 §3.2 允许在「为订立、履行您作为一方当事人的合同所必需」等情形下共享用户信息，未限定接收方地域。

role.quote: 我们可能委托授权合作伙伴（如技术服务方、授权合作伙伴等）处理您的个人信息，以便授权合作伙伴代表我们为您提供某些服务或履行职能

points.text: China-site conclusion: for the community service the platform designates itself a personal information handler (the independent-controller side), while also calling itself a "neutral platform" at the agreement level; both statements are recorded side by side and not reconciled. Supporting the handler side: the privacy policy opens by positioning "Shanghai ModelScope Technology Co., Ltd. as the operator of the ModelScope community"; §2.3.2 determines the purpose of collecting user content itself ("in order to provide you with those services ... and we have the right to display your nickname, avatar and published content"); §3.1 is an entrusting-party clause for engaging others ("we may entrust authorized partners (such as technical service providers and authorized partners) to process your personal information ... we will only entrust them to process your information for the lawful, legitimate, necessary, specific and explicit purposes stated in this policy" — ModelScope is the entrusting party, the partner the entrusted party); and §3.2 makes "your explicit consent" the rule for external sharing. Supporting the neutral-platform side: User Agreement §4.1(6) "as a neutral open-source community service provider"
points.text_zh: 中国站结论：平台对社区服务自认个人信息处理者（独立控制者一侧），同时在协议层面自称「中立平台」，两处表述并列记录、不调和。支持处理者一侧：隐私政策开篇以「上海魔搭科技有限公司作为魔搭社区的运营方」自我定位，§2.3.2 自行决定收集用户内容的目的（「为向您提供该等服务……并有权展示您的昵称、头像和发布内容」），§3.1 是委托他人处理时的委托方条款（「我们可能委托授权合作伙伴（如技术服务方、授权合作伙伴等）处理您的个人信息……我们仅会出于本政策声明的合法、正当、必要、特定、明确的目的委托其处理您的信息」——即魔搭是委托方，合作方是受托方），§3.2 对外共享以「获得您明确同意」为原则。支持中立平台一侧：用户协议 §4.1(6)「我们作为中立性开源社区服务提供方」

points.text: §4.2.1(3) / §4.2.2(3) describe the platform in the Studio scenario as "merely a technical platform providing free code hosting and limited trial compute resources", and place deep-synthesis and generative-AI compliance obligations on the Studio creator (§4.2.1(2)). Tension the other way: §3.2.1(2) admits that "we may access or share your private user content in accordance with what is set out in our privacy policy", and §4.1(2) reserves the right to review and delete user content and Demo inputs. **Key gap**: who acts as entrusted processor on the API-Inference path is not disclosed anywhere in the public documents — there are only technical statements such as "bind an Alibaba Cloud account" and "compute provided by Alibaba Cloud", and the China site has no list of third parties information is shared with (PPIO, by contrast, has a dedicated list page), so whether Alibaba Cloud is an entrusted party or an independent handler on the inference path cannot be answered from this vendor's documents. That is also why confidence for this dimension is only medium. The role conclusion differs between the China site and the international site: international terms §9 states expressly that "any processing of personal data submitted through ModelScope.AI is for your purposes and on your behalf only" (processor wording), see the intl row under products.
points.text_zh: §4.2.1(3)/§4.2.2(3) 在创空间场景自称「仅作为免费提供代码托管、有限的体验试用计算资源等技术平台」，并明确深度合成/生成式 AI 的合规义务由创空间创建者承担（§4.2.1(2)）。反向张力：§3.2.1(2) 承认「我们可能会根据我们的隐私政策中规定的内容访问或分享您的私有用户内容」，§4.1(2) 保留对用户内容与 Demo 输入的审核删除权。**关键缺口**：API-Inference 推理链路上谁是受托处理方，公开文档完全没有披露——只有「绑定阿里云账号」「由阿里云提供算力支持」这类技术表述，且中国站没有第三方信息共享清单（对比 PPIO 有专门的清单页），因此「阿里云在推理链路上是受托方还是独立控制者」在本家文档中无解。这也是本维度置信度只给 medium 的原因。中国站与国际站的 role 结论不同：国际站 terms §9 明文「any processing of personal data submitted through ModelScope.AI is for your purposes and on your behalf only」（受托方口径），见 products 的 intl 行。

training.quote: for improving our products, services, processes or business, understanding customer preferences and personalising experiences and recommendations

points.text: International-site conclusion: equally undisclosed. The user content license in international Terms §3.2 is worded "to access, use, host, modify, communicate, reproduce, adapt, make derivative works of, publish, perform, and/or distribute any User Content" — "use" is broad, but training or model training never appears anywhere as a platform purpose
points.text_zh: 国际站结论：同样未披露。国际站 Terms §3.2 的用户内容许可措辞是「to access, use, host, modify, communicate, reproduce, adapt, make derivative works of, publish, perform, and/or distribute any User Content」——「use」很宽泛但全文没有出现 training 或 model training 作为平台用途

points.text: §3.11's "free computing resources for model training" matches China-site §4.1(8): users training their own models. The closest thing to platform self-use is the legitimate-interest basis in Privacy Policy §6, "for improving our products, services, processes or business, understanding customer preferences and personalising experiences and recommendations" — a general product-improvement authorization that does not name training and rests on legitimate interests rather than the user's express grant. §6 also carries an IPR clause stating that "trained/upgraded models, output, analytics results … shall be solely and absolutely owned by us", which is an ownership clause and not an admission of using inputs for training. Uncertainty: the international site has no separate API terms, and whether model inference request content is used for training is not answered in the public texts.
points.text_zh: §3.11 的「free computing resources for model training」与中国站 §4.1(8) 同旨，是用户自己训练模型。最接近「平台自我使用」的是 Privacy Policy §6 基于合法利益的「for improving our products, services, processes or business, understanding customer preferences and personalising experiences and recommendations」——这是「改进产品」的概括授权，未点名训练，且属合法利益基础而非用户明示授权。另有 §6 IPR 条款声明「trained/upgraded models, output, analytics results … shall be solely and absolutely owned by us」，是成果归属条款，不构成「使用输入训练」的自认。不确定性：国际站没有面向 API 的单独条款，模型推理请求内容是否被训练在公开文本中无答案。结构化结论：本档按口径「厂商写『用于提高质量/改进服务』而不提训练即按会训练算」记 mark=no——该句是平台自我使用用户数据的概括授权，未把模型训练排除在外。

points.text: International-site conclusion: neither the Terms nor the Privacy Policy contains a zero data retention / zero retention / not-stored-after-the-request commitment, switch or application method (the keywords zero, retention and retain return zero hits in the Terms, and in the Privacy Policy appear only in an unrelated reservation-of-rights context). The international site has no public DPA and no trust/compliance page. Recorded as not_found under the rules, and not read in reverse as "the vendor refuses ZDR".
points.text_zh: 国际站结论：Terms 与 Privacy Policy 全文均无 zero data retention / 零保留 / 请求完成后不存储 的承诺、开关或申请方式（关键词 zero、retention、retain 在 Terms 中零命中，Privacy Policy 中仅出现于无关的权利保留语境）。国际站没有公开的 DPA、没有 trust/compliance 页。按规则记 not_found，不反向解读为「厂商拒绝 ZDR」。

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: Your use of ModelScope.AI may result in data provided to or stored by us being removed or rendered inaccessible from time to time, even if not marked for deletion or destruction by you

points.text: International-site conclusion: no retention period is laid down at all; the only relevant provision is a disclaimer-style "data may be removed". Terms §8: "Whether or not we make available backup services or tools from time to time (this being at our sole and absolute discretion), it is your sole responsibility to take appropriate measures to backup copies of data that you require. Your use of ModelScope.AI may result in data provided to or stored by us being removed or rendered inaccessible from time to time, even if not marked for deletion or destruction by you" — backup and data continuity are placed entirely on the user
points.text_zh: 国际站结论：没有任何保留期限规定，唯一相关的是一条免责式的「数据可能被移除」。Terms §8「Whether or not we make available backup services or tools from time to time (this being at our sole and absolute discretion), it is your sole responsibility to take appropriate measures to backup copies of data that you require. Your use of ModelScope.AI may result in data provided to or stored by us being removed or rendered inaccessible from time to time, even if not marked for deletion or destruction by you」——把备份与数据存续责任完全推给用户

points.text: §7 reserves the right to remove "any content stored on any systems associated with ModelScope.AI" at any time. The Privacy Policy has no retention clause at all (only the §7 cookies wording "we shall retain all rights, title and interest in … analytics data", a reservation of rights unrelated to retention periods). Recorded as duration_kind=unspecified: neither a ceiling nor a floor. Uncertainty: whether international-site inference request logs are kept, and for how long, is not disclosed.
points.text_zh: §7 保留随时移除「any content stored on any systems associated with ModelScope.AI」的权利。Privacy Policy 全文没有 retention/retain 条款（只有 §7 cookies 的「we shall retain all rights, title and interest in … analytics data」这种权利保留表述，与保留期限无关）。结论按 duration_kind=unspecified 记录：既无上限也无下限。不确定性：国际站的推理请求日志是否留存、留存多久，公开文档未披露。

points.text: International-site conclusion: the privacy policy has no storage-location clause, so no processing-location conclusion can be drawn. The only usable circumstantial evidence is the operating entity and the governing law: the Privacy Policy opens with "Alibaba Cloud (Singapore) Private Limited and its related corporations", the DPO's mailing address is at Times Square, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, and §11 provides that it "shall be governed by the laws of the Republic of Singapore"
points.text_zh: 国际站结论：隐私政策没有存储地域条款，因此无法给出处理地结论。可用的旁证只有运营主体与法律适用：Privacy Policy 开篇主体为「Alibaba Cloud (Singapore) Private Limited and its related corporations」，DPO 通信地址在香港铜锣湾时代广场，§11「shall be governed by the laws of the Republic of Singapore」

points.text: §4 says expressly that personal data may be provided to "our related corporations; analytics, search engine providers or other third party service providers …", "whether they are located overseas or in Singapore" — the document only states that disclosure abroad is possible and promises no particular region for the data. Where the entity sits is not where the data is processed, so this is recorded faithfully as not_found rather than filled in as Singapore.
points.text_zh: §4 明说个人信息可能提供给「our related corporations; analytics, search engine providers or other third party service providers …」，「whether they are located overseas or in Singapore」——即文档只承诺「可能向境外披露」，不承诺数据留在某一地域。主体所在地 ≠ 数据处理地，故本条如实记 not_found 而不是填新加坡。已撤锚：原绑的 §4 只说明个人信息「可能提供给位于境外或新加坡的接收方」，是披露/接收方所在地条款，不构成对处理地的表述。

points.text: Removed anchor: Privacy Policy §4 states only that personal data may be provided to recipients "whether they are located overseas or in Singapore" — a disclosure/recipient-location clause, not a statement about where processing takes place.

role.quote: any processing of personal data submitted through ModelScope.AI is for your purposes and on your behalf only

points.text: International-site conclusion: the contract expressly designates the platform a processor. Terms §9: "You agree that any processing of personal data submitted through ModelScope.AI is for your purposes and on your behalf only, and you remain responsible for complying with all applicable data protection requirements in relation to such personal data", and it further requires the user to warrant that all consents for uploading personal data have been obtained and the required notices given to the individuals concerned. §9 also provides that the user's consents "supplement and do not supersede" the existing privacy policy consents, so the two texts run in parallel. Alongside this, the Privacy Policy still describes collection and use with Alibaba Cloud itself as the subject (§3 purposes, §6 legitimate interests), producing a two-layer structure: processing positioned as on your behalf at the terms-of-service level, with controller-style wording retained at the privacy-policy level. In addition, §6 declares that the IPR in trained/upgraded models and output belongs to the platform, which is in tension with a purely processor position (an ownership clause). The China-site role conclusion differs (see the top-level role).
points.text_zh: 国际站结论：合同层明文自认受托处理方（processor）。Terms §9「You agree that any processing of personal data submitted through ModelScope.AI is for your purposes and on your behalf only, and you remain responsible for complying with all applicable data protection requirements in relation to such personal data」，并进一步要求用户保证已取得上传个人数据的全部同意、并已向相关个人提供告知。§9 另规定用户的同意「supplement and do not supersede」既有的隐私政策同意，即两套文本并行。与此并存的是 Privacy Policy 仍以 Alibaba Cloud 自身为主体描述收集使用（§3 目的、§6 合法利益），二者构成「服务条款层面把处理定位为 on your behalf，隐私政策层面仍保留自身控制者表述」的双层结构。另 §6 声明训练/升级模型与 output 的 IPR 归平台所有，与「完全受托」的定位存在张力（成果归属条款）。中国站的 role 结论与此不同（见顶层 role）。

points.text: Two statements govern the gateway tier: gateway request records may include prompts, tool calls and streamed output, and may be used for "auditing, performance analysis and authorized data analysis"
points.text_zh: 网关档的两条口径：请求记录可含 Prompt/工具调用/流式输出，可用于「审计、效果分析以及经授权的数据分析」

points.text: "Before call records are used for fine-tuning or retraining, complete authorization confirmation under the enterprise's data management process" — retraining is written as an action that requires authorization confirmation, but the vendor makes no "not used for training by default" commitment and gives the customer no switch. Combined with the de-identified training authorization in community-tier Privacy Policy §1(5)3 (the same policy also covers this platform service), the training determination for this tier points the same way as the community tier, so value is permitted, but confidence can only reach medium: the upstream is a third-party commercial API, and the upstream's training use of request bodies falls outside the coverage of OpenCSG's own documents (a multi-hop chain, where a no on any hop makes the whole chain no, and the upstream policy for this hop is not given in this provider's file).
points.text_zh: 「将调用记录用于微调或再训练前，按企业的数据管理流程完成授权确认」——即再训练被写成需要授权确认的动作，但官方没有承诺「默认不用于训练」，也没有给客户开关。叠加社区档隐私政策 §一（五）3 的去标识化训练授权（同一份政策也覆盖本平台服务），本档训练判定与社区档同向，故 value 取 permitted，但置信度只能到 medium：上游是第三方商业 API，上游对请求正文的训练用途不在 OpenCSG 文件覆盖范围内（多跳链路，任一跳为否即全链为否，而本跳的上游政策本台账不在本家文件里给出）。

points.text: The gateway tier offers no zero-retention option, switch or application path
points.text_zh: 网关档没有任何零保留选项、开关或申请方式

points.text: None of the 590 URLs on the docs site is a ZDR or DPA page. Multi-hop note: the upstream is a third-party commercial API, and whether ZDR can be applied for separately on each hop is not disclosed; this ledger does not infer from that that the hops can be combined into an enabled ZDR.

points.text: On caching, the docs speak of "viewing how the upstream reuses the cache of the input context", and billing includes input cache hits (cached_price_per_million), but cache retention and purge rules are not disclosed. Note also: this wording sits in the configuration context of Kubernetes/Helm self-deployment, and the corresponding values on the SaaS side are not disclosed item by item — it cannot be taken as the SaaS retention parameter, nor read in reverse as "the SaaS side retains nothing".

points.text: Same as top-level zdr: neither the policy document nor the site-wide resource bundle contains any zero-retention or no-storage statement, and there is no DPA entry point (/dpa, /trust, /security and /compliance all 302 → /errors/not-found → 404).
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr：整份政策载体与全站资源包无零保留/不存储表述，无 DPA 入口（/dpa /trust /security /compliance 均 302→/errors/not-found→404）。

retention.summary: 按对象分列留至服务终止
retention.quote: 我们只会在达成本政策所述目的所需的期限内保留您的用户信息，除非受到法律的允许。超出上述用户信息保存期限后，我们会对您的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理。

points.text: See top-level retention points 1-5: retained for the period needed to achieve the purposes stated in the policy (no quantified cap) + after account deletion, retained for the time required by regulators (a floor) + deleted or anonymized if the platform ceases operation + records of unlawful content preserved as required by law
points.text_zh: 见顶层 retention 第 1-5 点：目的所需期限（未量化上限）+ 注销后按监管要求保存（下限）+ 停止运营时删除/匿名化 + 违法记录依法保存

points.text: Information "stored in this product" is not guaranteed to be recoverable once the feature is cancelled.
points.text_zh: 平台「储存的信息」在功能取消后不保证可找回。

processing_region.quote: 我们将收集到的您的用户信息存放在中华人民共和国境内

points.text: See top-level processing_region: user information collected by the platform is in principle stored within the territory of the People's Republic of China, and any cross-border transfer requires separate consent and notification.
points.text_zh: 见顶层 processing_region：平台收集的用户信息原则上境内存储，出境需单独同意并告知。

role.quote: 在您使用本平台的产品和服务的过程中，我们会如何收集、使用、共享、存储和保护您的个人信息以及您可以如何管理您的个人信息

points.text: See top-level role (a)(d)(e): the platform identifies itself as the party collecting and using the information, claims rights in generated content, and imposes entrustment obligations on downstream partners
points.text_zh: 见顶层 role (a)(d)(e)：平台自认收集使用主体、主张对生成内容享有权益、对下游合作伙伴作委托约束

points.text: No entrusted-processor commitment, and no DPA.
points.text_zh: 无受托处理者承诺，无 DPA。

points.text: Removed anchor: "OpenRouter does not use your Inputs or Outputs for model training." is a statement about OpenRouter's own hop only. This tier's mark is about the whole chain, and the upstream hop follows the policy of the selected Model Provider, so that clause does not settle the chain and is not a statement on this verdict. It remains the anchor for the provider's own commitment. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：「OpenRouter does not use your Inputs or Outputs for model training.」只说明 OpenRouter 自身这一跳，而本档判定的是全链（上游那一跳按所选 Model Provider 的政策），该句不足以定论，故不构成本判定的表述；它仍是「OpenRouter 自身不训练」这条事实的锚点。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: See top-level training. OpenRouter itself is not_permitted ("OpenRouter does not use your Inputs or Outputs for model training." in the privacy policy, plus the FAQ's "zero logging"), while upstream follows the policy of the selected Model Provider
points.text_zh: 见顶层 training。OpenRouter 自身 not_permitted（隐私政策明文 + FAQ「zero logging」），上游按所选 Model Provider 的政策

points.text: Account settings and the request-level `data_collection` / `provider.zdr` parameters can restrict routing, but OpenRouter does not guarantee upstream compliance.
points.text_zh: 账户设置与请求级 `data_collection`/`provider.zdr` 可限制路由，但 OpenRouter 不保证上游合规。

zdr.quote: means OpenRouter does not persistently store API Payloads after completion of the applicable API request and response, except for transient processing in memory, short-lived buffering or caching strictly necessary to transmit, secure, or complete the request, and records required by law.

points.text: See top-level zdr. Four ways to enforce it: account level, model-group level, guardrail, and request level with `provider.zdr: true`
points.text_zh: 见顶层 zdr。账户级/模型组级/guardrail/请求级 `provider.zdr: true` 四种强制方式

points.text: "ZDR enforcement only applies to provider routing for inference requests." — it does not cover plugins or web search.
points.text_zh: 只覆盖推理路由，不含 plugins 与 web search。

retention.quote: OpenRouter does not store your prompts or responses, _unless_ you opt in to one or both of the following

points.text: See top-level retention. By default, "OpenRouter does not store your prompts or responses"
points.text_zh: 见顶层 retention。默认不存输入输出正文

points.text: Once you opt in to private logging, the content is kept for at least 3 months
points.text_zh: opt-in 私有日志后正文至少留 3 个月

points.text: Request metadata is always stored, with no period given
points.text_zh: 请求元数据始终保留且无期限

points.text: DPA customers can request deletion: "OpenRouter deletes Customer Data from the datastores and backups within 30 business days of request".
points.text_zh: DPA 客户可要求删除，30 个工作日内从数据存储与备份中删除。

processing_region.quote: Google Cloud Platform hosting in US regions; data at rest is region-restricted

points.text: See top-level processing_region. The default is "Google Cloud Platform hosting in US regions; data at rest is region-restricted"
points.text_zh: 见顶层 processing_region。默认 GCP US regions

points.text: In-region routing (EU/US) is a paid Business/Enterprise feature, and EU-only processing has its own DPA Exhibit A.
points.text_zh: in-region（EU/US）是 Business/Enterprise 付费功能，EU-only 另有 DPA Exhibit A。

role.quote: Customer is the Controller, and OpenRouter is the Processor

points.text: See top-level role. For customer personal data, "Customer is the Controller, and OpenRouter is the Processor"
points.text_zh: 见顶层 role。对客户个人数据 OpenRouter 是 Processor

points.text: For site and account data it uses the data in its own right as a controller (marketing, analytics).
points.text_zh: 对站点/账户数据它自己以控制者身份使用（营销、分析）。

points.text: Removed anchor: "Your data policies apply to BYOK endpoints. A BYOK key changes the credential for the upstream request. It does not change which endpoints you can route to." says the routing and data policies are unchanged — it is not a statement about training. The upstream hop is governed by the customer's own agreement with that provider, so the chain cannot be settled here. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：「Your data policies apply to BYOK endpoints… It does not change which endpoints you can route to.」说的是路由与 data policy 不变，不是对训练的表述；上游那一跳由客户与厂商自己的协议决定，全链无法在此定论。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: BYOK changes neither which endpoints can be routed to nor the data policy: "Your data policies apply to BYOK endpoints. A BYOK key changes the credential for the upstream request. It does not change which endpoints you can route to." OpenRouter itself commits not to train
points.text_zh: BYOK 不改变可路由端点，也不豁免 data policy：「Your data policies apply to BYOK endpoints. A BYOK key changes the credential for the upstream request. It does not change which endpoints you can route to.」OpenRouter 自身承诺不训练

points.text: The upstream hop is governed by your own agreement with that provider (which OpenRouter cannot see).
points.text_zh: 上游那一跳以你自己与厂商的协议为准（OpenRouter 看不到该协议）。

zdr.quote: Some providers give your own account zero data retention. The shared endpoint that OpenRouter tracks for that provider can still retain prompts. OpenRouter cannot see your provider agreement.

points.text: By default a BYOK key does not exempt you from ZDR restrictions: an endpoint that retains prompts stays blocked ("When you do, an endpoint that retains prompts stays blocked. Your own key does not change that."). The exception is a key whose "Provider agreement → Zero data retention" is declared as "My account has ZDR", which is let through; the declaration **does not cover video generation**, and OpenRouter says plainly that "OpenRouter cannot see your provider agreement", i.e. it is the customer's own attestation, not verification by OpenRouter.
points.text_zh: 默认情况下 BYOK 键不豁免 ZDR 限制：端点会保留 prompt 时仍被拦（「When you do, an endpoint that retains prompts stays blocked. Your own key does not change that.」）。例外是 key 上「Provider agreement → Zero data retention」声明为「My account has ZDR」时放行，声明**不覆盖视频生成**，且 OpenRouter 明说「OpenRouter cannot see your provider agreement」，即这只是客户自述、不是 OpenRouter 的核验。

retention.quote: OpenRouter does not store your prompts or responses, _unless_ you opt in to one or both of the following

points.text: OpenRouter's own hop is the same as the default tier (nothing written to disk by default; at least 3 months once you opt in to logging)
points.text_zh: OpenRouter 这一跳同默认档（默认不落盘，opt-in 记录后至少 3 个月）

points.text: The upstream hop is determined by the customer's own agreement, which OpenRouter does not disclose on their behalf.
points.text_zh: 上游那一跳由客户自有协议决定，OpenRouter 不代为披露。

processing_region.quote: Some providers give your own account zero data retention. The shared endpoint that OpenRouter tracks for that provider can still retain prompts. OpenRouter cannot see your provider agreement.

points.text: Region likewise rests on a declaration: the BYOK docs explain that under a regional domain OpenRouter routes only to endpoints onboarded in that region, while "OpenRouter cannot see where your own OpenAI account processes requests, so you tell OpenRouter"
points.text_zh: 区域同样靠声明：byok 文档说明区域域名下 OpenRouter 只路由到该区域已接入的端点，而「OpenRouter cannot see where your own OpenAI account processes requests, so you tell OpenRouter」

points.text: A region declaration does not change the key's retention policy ("A region declaration does not change your key's retention policy.").
points.text_zh: 区域声明不改变 key 的保留政策（「A region declaration does not change your key's retention policy.」）。

role.quote: Customer is the Controller, and OpenRouter is the Processor

points.text: For the part of the data OpenRouter itself processes it is still the Processor
points.text_zh: 就 OpenRouter 自己处理的那部分数据仍是 Processor

points.text: But on the BYOK tier there is a further direct relationship between the customer and the upstream vendor (the customer holds the key), and the upstream's use of content is determined by that agreement.
points.text_zh: 但 BYOK 档下客户与上游厂商之间另有一层直接关系（客户自持密钥），上游对内容的使用由该协议决定。

points.text: Removed anchor: "OpenRouter does not use your Inputs or Outputs for model training." covers OpenRouter's own hop; this verdict is about the whole chain, and upstream follows the selected Model Provider's policy, so the clause does not settle it. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：「OpenRouter does not use your Inputs or Outputs for model training.」只覆盖 OpenRouter 自身这一跳；本档判定全链，上游按所选 Model Provider 的政策，该句不足以定论。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: OpenRouter itself does not train on inputs or outputs (the same commitment)
points.text_zh: OpenRouter 自身不训练输入输出（同一条承诺）

points.text: Upstreams still follow their own policies, and the "Model Provider Data Practices" section of the privacy policy applies to the Chatroom as well.
points.text_zh: 上游仍按其自身政策，隐私政策「Model Provider Data Practices」一节同样适用于 Chatroom。

zdr.quote: OpenRouter itself has a ZDR policy; your prompts are not retained unless you specifically opt in to prompt logging.

points.text: OpenRouter's own "your prompts are not retained unless you specifically opt in to prompt logging" holds for the Chatroom as well
points.text_zh: OpenRouter 自身的「prompts are not retained unless you specifically opt in to prompt logging」对 Chatroom 同样成立

points.text: But the ZDR enforcement switches sit on the API routing side (`provider.zdr` / guardrail) and the Chatroom has no equivalent parameter, so this is recorded as a policy-layer statement only.
points.text_zh: 但 ZDR 强制开关是 API 路由侧的（`provider.zdr` / guardrail），Chatroom 没有对应参数，故此处只作政策层说明。

retention.quote: All conversations in the chatroom are stored locally on your device. Conversations will not sync across devices.

points.text: FAQ "What data is logged during Chatroom use?": "The same data privacy applies to the chatroom as the API. All conversations in the chatroom are stored locally on your device. Conversations will not sync across devices." — i.e. conversation history does not go to the cloud
points.text_zh: FAQ「What data is logged during Chatroom use?」：『The same data privacy applies to the chatroom as the API. All conversations in the chatroom are stored locally on your device. Conversations will not sync across devices.』即会话历史不上云

points.text: Logging on the request side is the same as the API (prompts and completions are not logged by default).
points.text_zh: 请求侧日志口径同 API（默认不记录 prompt/completion）。

processing_region.quote: your personal data may be transferred to our servers in the US, or to other countries outside the European Economic Area

points.text: In-region routing does not apply to the consumer tier (a Business/Enterprise feature); there is only the default wording of privacy policy §9: "your personal data may be transferred to our servers in the US, or to other countries outside the European Economic Area".
points.text_zh: 消费档不适用 in-region routing（Business/Enterprise 功能），只有隐私政策 §9 的默认口径：数据可能被转移到美国或 EEA/UK 以外。

role.quote: Customer is the Controller, and OpenRouter is the Processor

points.text: Individual users on the consumer tier generally do not fall under the DPA (terms §10.2 limits it to organizational or commercial use), and OpenRouter then processes account and usage data as a controller (privacy policy §11 table: improving the service, research, interest-based advertising)
points.text_zh: 消费档个人用户一般不落入 DPA（terms §10.2 限定组织/商业用途），此时 OpenRouter 对账户与使用数据以控制者身份处理（隐私政策 §11 表格：改进服务、研究、兴趣广告）

points.text: For content forwarded to a model provider, the model provider is independently responsible for its own use of it.
points.text_zh: 对转发给模型厂商的内容，模型厂商对其自身使用独立负责。

training.quote: not use API Payloads submitted through the EU API to train, fine-tune, improve, or develop models or services except as expressly instructed by Customer in writing

points.text: When the EU API is selected (Exhibit A), the DPA expressly says OpenRouter will "not use API Payloads submitted through the EU API to train, fine-tune, improve, or develop models or services except as expressly instructed by Customer in writing". Without EU-only it falls back to the general tier: OpenRouter itself does not train, and upstreams may still train (see top-level training).
points.text_zh: 选择 EU API（Exhibit A）时，DPA 明文「not use API Payloads submitted through the EU API to train, fine-tune, improve, or develop models or services except as expressly instructed by Customer in writing」。未选择 EU-only 时回到通用档：OpenRouter 自身不训练，上游仍可能训练（见顶层 training）。

zdr.quote: means OpenRouter does not persistently store API Payloads after completion of the applicable API request and response, except for transient processing in memory, short-lived buffering or caching strictly necessary to transmit, secure, or complete the request, and records required by law.

points.text: Beyond ZDR enforcement at the routing layer, on the enterprise tier the DPA itself supplies the ZDR definition and the deletion commitment, and provides that ZDR-only routing admits only upstreams registered as ZDR-eligible — but the same section states that "it does not constitute OpenRouter's guarantee of AI Model Provider compliance", so upstreams are still judged hop by hop.
points.text_zh: 企业档除路由层面的 ZDR 强制外，DPA 本身给出 ZDR 定义与删除承诺，并规定 ZDR-only 路由只放行登记为 ZDR-eligible 的上游——但同一节明确「it does not constitute OpenRouter's guarantee of AI Model Provider compliance」，上游仍逐跳判定。

retention.quote: OpenRouter will delete Inputs and Outputs promptly following generation of the relevant Output

points.text: DPA §2.4(a) is an unconditional deletion commitment (except where required by law, for abuse investigations, or where the customer has opted in to logging), and §9 restates that the ZDR commitment takes effect immediately on completion of each API request and response
points.text_zh: DPA §2.4(a) 是无条件删除承诺（除法律要求/恶意使用调查/客户 opt-in 记录），§9 重申 ZDR 承诺在每次 API 请求与响应完成时立即生效

points.text: The customer may request deletion at any time, and Schedule 2 commits to deletion from the datastores and backups within 30 business days. Content under opt-in private logging is still at least 3 months.
points.text_zh: 客户可随时要求删除，Schedule 2 承诺 30 个工作日内从数据存储与备份删除。opt-in 私有日志的正文仍是至少 3 个月。

processing_region.quote: process those API Payloads only in the European Union or EEA and will not intentionally transfer or permit access to those API Payloads from outside the European Union or EEA

points.text: The default is still Google Cloud Platform hosting in US regions
points.text_zh: 默认仍是 GCP US regions

points.text: Enterprise customers can choose in-region routing (EU/US), or select DPA Exhibit A on the Order Form for EU-only processing (which covers API Payloads only; account, billing and security logs are not restricted).
points.text_zh: 企业客户可选 in-region routing（EU/US），或在 Order Form 选择 DPA Exhibit A 做 EU-only 处理（仅覆盖 API Payloads，账户/账单/安全日志不受限）。

role.quote: Customer is the Controller, and OpenRouter is the Processor

points.text: The DPA states that Customer = Controller and OpenRouter = Processor, and includes subprocessor clauses (§5, with the list at trust.openrouter.ai), audit rights, SCCs/UK Addendum and other enterprise terms.
points.text_zh: DPA 明确 Customer=Controller、OpenRouter=Processor，并含子处理者条款（§5，名单在 trust.openrouter.ai）、审计权、SCC/UK Addendum 等企业条款。

training.quote: **Note:** All prompts and completions for this model are logged by the provider and may be used to improve the model.

points.text: The upstream hop on the free tier is a no: for each free/anonymous model listed at the time, the model catalogue page discloses "All prompts and completions for this model are logged by the provider and may be used to improve the model." (a few entries read "logged by the model creator for feedback and training"). OpenRouter itself still commits not to train (the same privacy policy clause applies to the free tier), but under "a clear no on any hop makes the whole chain a no", the free tier's whole chain should be treated as **possibly used for training**. Control: account settings have a separate training toggle for free models (provider-logging: "There are separate settings for paid and free models."). Uncertainty: that list is dynamic and OpenRouter writes no separate clause for the free tier in its policy documents — this point rests on the per-model disclosures on the model catalogue page, not on policy text.
points.text_zh: 免费档的上游那一跳为「否」：模型目录页对当时列出的免费/匿名模型逐条披露「All prompts and completions for this model are logged by the provider and may be used to improve the model.」（个别条目为「logged by the model creator for feedback and training」）。OpenRouter 自身仍承诺不训练（隐私政策同一条适用于免费档），但按「任一跳明确为否，则全链为否」，免费档全链应视为**可能用于训练**。控制手段：账户设置里 free 档有独立的训练开关（provider-logging「There are separate settings for paid and free models.」）。不确定性：该清单是动态的，且 OpenRouter 未在政策文档中单独为免费档写条款——本条依据是模型目录页的逐模型披露，不是政策文本。

points.text: Removed anchor: "we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such" describes how OpenRouter labels endpoints whose policy it cannot ascertain. It does not state whether this tier itself has a zero-retention option, so it is not a statement on this dimension. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：「we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such」说的是 OpenRouter 对「政策无法确认的端点」如何标注，并未对本档自身是否有零保留选项表态，故不构成本维度的表述。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: OpenRouter's own ZDR policy applies to the free tier, but enforcing ZDR excludes non-ZDR endpoints
points.text_zh: OpenRouter 自身的 ZDR 政策适用于免费档，但强制 ZDR 时会排除非 ZDR 端点

points.text: For endpoints whose policy cannot be confirmed, OpenRouter takes a conservative stance and will "assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such". So whether "free tier + ZDR" can hold at the same time depends on whether that free endpoint is on the ZDR list, which cannot be confirmed in advance from the public pages (the list is a dynamic table).
points.text_zh: 对政策无法确认的端点，OpenRouter 取保守假设「assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such」。因此「免费档 + ZDR」能否同时成立，取决于该免费端点是否在 ZDR 清单内，公开页面无法预先确认（清单是动态表格）。

retention.quote: OpenRouter does not store your prompts or responses, _unless_ you opt in to one or both of the following

points.text: Object and context kept apart: on OpenRouter's own hop prompts and responses are likewise not written to disk on the free tier (the same policy clause), but the **upstream** retention period for free/anonymous models is not disclosed on OpenRouter's public pages (in the dynamic provider-logging table most upstreams show "Prompts are retained for unknown period"). So the content retention period for the free tier is unspecified overall.
points.text_zh: 对象与语境分开：OpenRouter 自身这一跳对免费档同样不落盘 prompt/response（同一条政策），但**上游**对免费/匿名模型的保留期在 OpenRouter 公开页面上未披露（provider-logging 的动态表里多数上游显示「Prompts are retained for unknown period」）。故免费档的正文保留期整体为 unspecified。

processing_region.quote: Google Cloud Platform hosting in US regions; data at rest is region-restricted

points.text: Same as the API tier: Google Cloud Platform hosting in US regions by default
points.text_zh: 同 API 档：默认 GCP US regions

points.text: In-region routing is a paid Business/Enterprise feature that the free tier usually does not have. The actual processing location of an upstream endpoint is decided by each vendor, and OpenRouter does not disclose it model by model for free models.
points.text_zh: in-region 是 Business/Enterprise 付费功能，免费档通常不具备。上游端点的实际处理地由各厂商决定，OpenRouter 未按免费模型逐条披露。

role.quote: Customer is the Controller, and OpenRouter is the Processor

points.text: Same as the API tier. But terms §10.2 limits the DPA to organizational customers or commercial, for-profit use, and whether an individual user on the free tier falls under the DPA is not stated, hence low confidence.
points.text_zh: 同 API 档。但 DPA 的适用对象在 terms §10.2 里限定为组织客户或商业营利用途，免费档的个人用户是否落入 DPA 未明确，故置信度低。

lines.entity: OVH Hosting Limited / OVH US LLC dba OVHcloud®

ovhcloud/ai-tools-eu.entity: OVH Hosting Limited / OVH US LLC dba OVHcloud®

training.quote: as a Processor acting under Client’s instruction, to process the Controller’s Personal Data to the extent necessary to provide the Services.

points.text: AI Tools 档（AI Training / AI Notebooks / AI Deploy）的合同附录 7 完全没有「数据是否用于训练」的条款——与 AI Endpoints 附录 10 §5 的逐字不重用条款形成对比。可用的最接近依据是通用层：EU DPA §1.1「as a Processor acting under Client's instruction, to process the Controller's Personal Data to the extent necessary to provide the Services」+「OVHcloud shall process Personal Data only under the Client's instruction」+ GTS §6.2.2「does not exercise prior control over the Content and has no knowledge of it」——即 OVHcloud 只能按客户指示、为提供服务所必需而处理，不得另作训练用途。这是受托处理者的目的限制推导，不是厂商逐字的「不训练」承诺，故 confidence=medium，且必须注明本档缺 AI Tools 专用训练条款。另注意术语陷阱：AI Training 的产品语义是「客户自己训练模型」，与「厂商拿客户数据训练自己的模型」是两件事，不要混读。

zdr.quote: It is permanently deleted thirty (30) days after the Client deletes a Notebook, unless the Client decides otherwise.

points.text: Structured conclusion: the cited contract clause states an affirmative retention period for this tier's data ("It is permanently deleted thirty (30) days after the Client deletes a Notebook, unless the Client decides otherwise."), and the service is designed around persistent storage, with no ZDR option or application path anywhere in Annex 7. The tier is therefore recorded as mark=no (terms state retention) rather than as undisclosed.
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：原引合同条款对本档数据正面写明保留期（「It is permanently deleted thirty (30) days after the Client deletes a Notebook, unless the Client decides otherwise.」），且该服务按设计包含持久存储，附录 7 全文无 ZDR 选项或申请入口。据此记 mark=no（条款明示会留存），而不是「未披露」。
