role.quote: OVHcloud is entitled, as a Processor and as part of the Services defined in the Agreement, to carry out the processing of Personal Data on behalf of, and on instructions from the Client

points.text: API 档结论：OVHcloud 在协议上自认 processor（受托处理方）——但依据来自通用 DPA 与 GTS，不来自 AI Endpoints 自己的产品条款。附录 10 内没有任何 data processing / 角色条款，这一点可与同一份 SC 的其他附录对照：附录 4（DBaaS）与附录 8（Managed Rancher）逐字写「OVHcloud carries out processing of personal data as a sub-processor on the instructions of the Client」，附录 6（Quantum）反而写「In order to provide the Service, OVHcloud does not process personal data as a processor or access the Client Content」，附录 10 两者皆无，只有 §5「The Client is responsible for Inputs and Outputs.」与「OVHcloud has no knowledge of Inputs and Outputs」。依据链：①EU/IE 版 DPA（Version dated on 17.10.2025）抬头「entered into between OVH Hosting Ltd. … and the Client」，目的条款「OVHcloud is entitled, as a Processor and as part of the Services defined in the Agreement, to carry out the processing of Personal Data on behalf of, and on instructions from the Client」，§1.1「as a Processor acting under Client's instruction」
points.text_zh: API 档结论：OVHcloud 在协议上自认 processor（受托处理方）——但依据来自通用 DPA 与 GTS，不来自 AI Endpoints 自己的产品条款。附录 10 内没有任何 data processing / 角色条款，这一点可与同一份 SC 的其他附录对照：附录 4（DBaaS）与附录 8（Managed Rancher）逐字写「OVHcloud carries out processing of personal data as a sub-processor on the instructions of the Client」，附录 6（Quantum）反而写「In order to provide the Service, OVHcloud does not process personal data as a processor or access the Client Content」，附录 10 两者皆无，只有 §5「The Client is responsible for Inputs and Outputs.」与「OVHcloud has no knowledge of Inputs and Outputs」。依据链：①EU/IE 版 DPA（Version dated on 17.10.2025）抬头「entered into between OVH Hosting Ltd. … and the Client」，目的条款「OVHcloud is entitled, as a Processor and as part of the Services defined in the Agreement, to carry out the processing of Personal Data on behalf of, and on instructions from the Client」，§1.1「as a Processor acting under Client's instruction」

training.quote: Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models.

points.text: See the top-level training entry: §2.3.3 bars Perplexity and third parties alike from using Customer Content for training

points.text: DPA §5 points the same way. Usage Data (§3.3) is outside that restriction.

zdr.quote: Perplexity maintains a strict **Zero Data Retention Policy** for the Chat Completions API. We do not retain data sent through the Chat Completions API, and we do not use customer data to train our models or for any purpose beyond processing the immediate request.

points.text: Zero retention by default (the original sentence is limited to the Chat Completions API)
points.text_zh: 默认零保留（原句限定 Chat Completions API）

points.text: A separate ZDR agreement can also be signed, and stateful Agent API features require checking with the account team first. No public application path found.
points.text_zh: 另有可签的 ZDR 协议，Agent API 有状态功能须先与 account team 确认。未找到公开申请入口。

points.text: See the top-level retention entry. This tier also has a feature-level exception: stateful Agent API conversations are persisted server-side with no period disclosed (store: false does not disable persistence).
points.text_zh: 见顶层 retention。本档内还有功能级例外：Agent API 有状态会话服务端持久化且未披露期限（store:false 不关闭持久化）。

role.quote: The Parties acknowledge that in relation to any Personal Data received from Customer in providing the Services, for purposes of Privacy Laws, Customer is the Controller or Processor or Business and Perplexity is the Service Provider or Processor.

points.text: See the top-level role entry: DPA §2 processor
points.text_zh: 见顶层 role：DPA §2 processor

points.text: Usage Data and Search Data are the exceptions.
points.text_zh: Usage Data 与 Search Data 属例外。

points.text: The DPA expressly carves it out of the main posture. This must not be read in reverse as a vendor commitment to the contrary.
points.text_zh: DPA 明确把它划出主姿态。不得反向解读为厂商承诺相反。已撤锚：DPA 序言「Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API …) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA」只声明本档不适用 DPA 主姿态，没有对训练表态，故不构成本维度的表述。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: The zero-retention commitment in Privacy & Security names only the Chat Completions API, and the FAQ says only "the API"; neither names Embeddings
points.text_zh: Privacy & Security 的零保留承诺只写 Chat Completions API，FAQ 只写「the API」，均未点名 Embeddings

points.text: The DPA preamble instead carves Embeddings out of the main posture. ZDR for this tier is therefore recorded as undisclosed.
points.text_zh: DPA 序言反而把 Embeddings 划出主姿态。故本档 ZDR 记未披露。已撤锚：该句只声明本档不适用 DPA 主姿态，没有对本档是否提供零保留表态。查阅范围见 searched。

retention.quote: Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA

points.text: DPA preamble: "Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA... the applicable product-specific terms shall govern and control over this DPA." — so the DPA's retention clauses may not apply to this tier, and no product-specific terms are public. This is "undisclosed" rather than a denial.
points.text_zh: DPA 序言：「Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA... the applicable product-specific terms shall govern and control over this DPA.」即 DPA 的保留条款对本档可能不适用，而专属条款未见公开。这是「未披露」而非否定。

points.text: No processing-location clause specific to Embeddings
points.text_zh: 无 Embeddings 专属处理地条款

points.text: The subprocessor list is not broken down by product.
points.text_zh: 子处理者清单未按产品拆分。已撤锚：DPA 序言的产品划出句只声明本档不适用 DPA 主姿态，没有对处理地表态。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: Once the DPA preamble carves this tier out of the main posture, nothing further is said about role allocation.
points.text_zh: DPA 序言把本档划出主姿态后，角色归属未再说明。已撤锚：该句只声明本档不适用 DPA 主姿态，没有对 controller / processor 归属表态。查阅范围见 searched。

training.quote: Perplexity may retain, copy, distribute and otherwise use Search Data for its lawful business purposes, including the improvement and development of products and services.

points.text: Structured conclusion: §2.2 authorizes Perplexity to use Search Data for its lawful business purposes "including the improvement and development of products and services", and the Addendum gives no no-training commitment. Under the rule that service-improvement wording which does not exclude model training counts as training, this tier is recorded as mark=no.
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：§2.2 授权 Perplexity 为「lawful business purposes, including the improvement and development of products and services」使用 Search Data，且 Addendum 未给不训练承诺。按口径「写『用于服务改进』而不排除模型训练即按会训练算」，本档记 mark=no。

points.text: The Addendum gives no no-training commitment
points.text_zh: Addendum 未给不训练承诺

points.text: §2.2 instead authorizes Perplexity to retain, copy and distribute Search Data "for its lawful business purposes, including the improvement and development of products and services". Whether the no-training commitment in API ToS §2.3.3 still applies to Search Data is not stated — §1.2.2 names only obligations such as "update, upgrade and/or zero data retention obligations" as excluded, and does not name §2.3.3. This uncertainty has to be flagged in the ledger and must not be resolved on the vendor's behalf.
points.text_zh: §2.2 反而授权 Perplexity 为「lawful business purposes, including the improvement and development of products and services」保留、复制、分发 Search Data。API ToS §2.3.3 的不训练承诺是否仍适用于 Search Data，文档未明说——§1.2.2 只点名排除了「update, upgrade and/or zero data retention obligations」这类义务，未点名 §2.3.3。此不确定性必须在台账上标明，不得替厂商推定。

zdr.quote: except for obligations expressly set out in this Addendum, any Perplexity obligations in the Agreement applicable to its other products and services (e.g., update, upgrade and/or zero data retention obligations) do not apply to the Search Services.

points.text: §1.2.2：「any Perplexity obligations in the Agreement applicable to its other products and services (e.g., update, upgrade and/or zero data retention obligations) do not apply to the Search Services」
§4.1 likewise states that the security and service-level commitments for other products (the Sonar APIs included) do not apply to the Search Services. This is an express denial, not a non-disclosure.
points.text_zh: §4.1 亦声明其他产品（含 Sonar APIs）的安全/服务水平承诺不适用于 Search Services。这是明确否定，不是未披露。

retention.quote: Perplexity may retain, copy, distribute and otherwise use Search Data for its lawful business purposes, including the improvement and development of products and services.

points.text: §2.2 authorizes retention, copying and distribution of Search Data (Search Data = Input + Output, §1.1.1), with no period given
points.text_zh: §2.2 授权保留/复制/分发 Search Data（Search Data = Input + Output，§1.1.1），未给期限

points.text: §1.2.2 states expressly that the zero-retention obligations for other products do not apply. §2.3 prohibits the customer from submitting personal information (unless authorized in writing), so the question of personal information retention largely does not arise on this tier.
points.text_zh: §1.2.2 明确其他产品的零保留义务不适用。§2.3 禁止客户提交个人信息（除非书面授权），因此本档的个人信息保留问题主要不适用。

points.text_zh: Search Addendum 与 API ToS 均无处理地条款

role.quote: Customer shall not submit Personal Data (as defined in the DPA) to the Search Services unless explicitly authorized by Perplexity in writing

points.text: §2.3 requires the customer not to submit personal information (unless explicitly authorized by Perplexity in writing), implying that personal information is still handled under the DPA
points.text_zh: §2.3 要求客户不得提交个人信息（除非书面授权），暗示个人信息仍按 DPA 处理

points.text: But §2.2 states expressly that "Search Data is not Customer's Confidential Information", the opposite of API ToS §5.1, which makes Customer Content the customer's confidential information. The processor relationship is weaker on this tier than on the Sonar tier.
points.text_zh: 但 §2.2 明文「Search Data is not Customer's Confidential Information」，与 API ToS §5.1 把 Customer Content 定为客户保密信息相反。本档的受托关系比 Sonar 档弱。

points.text: Removed anchor: the clause cited here ("We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary…") is a retention-period statement and says nothing about training, so it is not a statement on this dimension. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：原引句「We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary…」是保留期限条款，与训练无关，不构成本维度的表述。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: The purposes listed in the consumer privacy notice include "develop services", "conduct internal research" and "improve our websites", but no sentence states affirmatively whether consumer queries are used to train models
points.text_zh: 消费者隐私声明列出的处理目的包含「develop services」「conduct internal research」「improve our websites」等，但没有一句正面说明消费者查询是否用于训练模型

points.text: Only for the Email Assistant is there an explicit "We do not use the content of emails to create, train, improve, or fine-tune AI models." There are also in-product switches such as AI Data Retention (help center, not fetched this round). Recorded as undisclosed and not written up as a commitment.
points.text_zh: 只对 Email Assistant 有明文「We do not use the content of emails to create, train, improve, or fine-tune AI models.」。另有 AI Data Retention 之类的产品内开关（帮助中心，本轮未取）。按未披露记，不得写成承诺。

zdr.quote: We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes in this Notice unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

points.text: Structured conclusion: the cited clause states affirmatively that personal data is kept for as long as necessary ("We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary…"), and the consumer tier offers no zero-retention mechanism. The tier is therefore recorded as mark=no (terms state retention).
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：原引句正面写明个人数据会被保留（「We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary…」），消费档也没有任何零保留机制。据此记 mark=no（条款明示会留存）。

points.text: No zero-retention commitment on the consumer tier (the product has only an AI Data Retention switch, a feature setting, and no official policy document explains its effect).
points.text_zh: 消费者档无零保留承诺（产品内只有 AI Data Retention 开关，属功能设置，未见官方政策文档说明其效果）。

retention.quote: We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes in this Notice unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

points.text: "We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes in this Notice unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law." — a purpose-necessity period, not quantified
points.text_zh: 「We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes in this Notice unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.」——目的必要期限，未量化

points.text: The deletion-rights clause separately states that "in many cases we must keep your personal data to comply with legal obligations...".
points.text_zh: 另有删除权条款说明「in many cases we must keep your personal data to comply with legal obligations...」。

points.text: Removed anchor: the cited subprocessor-list row ("Amazon Web Services / Cloud infrastructure and security / Cloud provider / US") records where the subprocessor company sits, not where data is processed. Entity location is not processing location, so it is not a statement on this dimension. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：原引子处理者清单条目（「Amazon Web Services / Cloud infrastructure and security / Cloud provider / US」）记的是该子处理者公司所在地，不是数据处理地。主体所在地 ≠ 数据处理地，故不构成本维度的表述。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: The consumer privacy notice states no storage or processing location
points.text_zh: 消费者隐私声明未写存储/处理地

points.text: Only the DPF (EU-U.S. / UK Extension) and the all-US subprocessor list are available as indirect clues.
points.text_zh: 只有 DPF（EU-U.S./UK Extension）与子处理者清单全 US 可作间接线索。

role.quote: This notice does not apply to data collected through Perplexity’s [Enterprise](https://www.perplexity.ai/enterprise/home) and [API](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/privacy-security) offerings where we act as a service provider or processor with regard to the data collected through those systems.

points.text: The privacy notice merely excludes the Enterprise and API tiers, describing Perplexity as service provider or processor for those two, from which it follows that the consumer tier is processed by Perplexity as an independent controller in its own right
points.text_zh: 隐私声明只把 Enterprise 与 API 档排除在外并自认那两档为 service provider/processor，反推消费者档是自有的独立控制者处理

points.text: The notice is written throughout in "we collect" terms, with no processor wording.
points.text_zh: 声明全篇以「we collect」口径书写，未见受托表述。

training.quote: Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models.

points.text: Enterprise ToS §1.3.3 is word for word the same as API ToS §2.3.3: "Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models."
points.text_zh: Enterprise ToS §1.3.3 与 API ToS §2.3.3 同文：「Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models.」

points.text: Removed anchor: the cited clause ("If your account has a Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreement with Perplexity, check with your account team…") is a conditional reference in the Agent API docs. It confirms ZDR agreements exist but does not state that this tier has one, so it is not a statement on this verdict's dimension. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：原引句「If your account has a Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreement with Perplexity, check with your account team…」是 Agent API 文档里的条件式提示，只说明存在 ZDR 协议这种安排，并未说明本档是否覆盖，故不构成本判定的表述。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: Neither the Enterprise ToS nor the DPA contains a zero-retention commitment
points.text_zh: Enterprise ToS 与 DPA 均无零保留承诺

points.text: ZDR is mentioned in the API documentation in the form of an "agreement", and whether it covers the Enterprise tier is not published.
points.text_zh: ZDR 在 API 文档里以「agreement」形式被提及，是否覆盖 Enterprise 档未公开。

retention.quote: Perplexity shall delete (or, at Customer’s option, return) all Personal Data within thirty days of the end of the provision of the Services to Customer, unless retention of the Personal Data is required by law

points.text: Enterprise ToS §5.1 incorporates the DPA, so §10's deletion (or, at the customer's option, return) within thirty days of the end of the provision of the Services applies, as does the Annex 1 retention period for personal information contained in Input
points.text_zh: Enterprise ToS §5.1 并入 DPA，故 §10 的「服务终止后 30 天内删除（或返还）」与 Annex 1 的输入个人信息保留期适用

points.text: There are also enterprise settings such as "Configuring Data Retention" inside the product (that page was not fetched this round).
points.text_zh: 产品内另有「Configuring Data Retention」类企业设置（本轮未取该页）。

processing_region.quote: To the extent Perplexity processes Personal Data subject to EU/UK Privacy Laws in a Third Country, and it is acting as a data importer, Perplexity shall comply with the data importer

points.text: DPA §11 commits only to a transfer compliance mechanism, not to a residency location
points.text_zh: DPA §11 只承诺传输合规机制，不承诺驻留地

points.text: The enterprise security page likewise has no regional clause.
points.text_zh: 企业安全页亦无地域条款。

role.quote: The DPA governs Perplexity’s processing of personal data as a processor on Customer’s behalf in connection with the provision of the Services.

points.text: §5.1「The DPA governs Perplexity's processing of personal data as a processor on Customer's behalf」

But that clause and §5.4 make clear that for personal data processed for the Marketing Services "Perplexity acts as an independent controller, and the DPA does not apply". So processor as the main position and independent controller for marketing data, recorded side by side.
points.text_zh: 但同条与 §5.4 明确：为客户人员信息做营销（Marketing Services）时「Perplexity acts as an independent controller, and the DPA does not apply」。即受托为主、营销数据为独立控制者，两层并列。

training.quote: Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models

points.text: Same as top-level training: API ToS §2.3.3 covers Customer Content and includes "or authorize third parties to use"
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training：API ToS §2.3.3 覆盖 Customer Content 且含「or authorize third parties to use」

points.text: DPA §5 covers Personal Data. The conduct of the upstream providers themselves falls outside Perplexity's commitment (§2.6).
points.text_zh: DPA §5 覆盖 Personal Data。上游提供方自身行为不在 Perplexity 承诺范围内(§2.6)。

zdr.quote: If your account has a Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreement with Perplexity, check with your account team before relying on stateful features

points.text: Same as top-level zdr: ZDR requires an agreement to enable
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr：ZDR 需协议开通

points.text: The default zero-retention commitment is written only for the Chat Completions tier (privacy-security) and in the platform-level FAQ.
points.text_zh: 默认的零保留承诺只写在 Chat Completions 档(privacy-security)与平台级 FAQ 上。

retention.quote: Any personal information contained within Input will be stored until the earlier of (a) the date it is deleted by Customer through the Services’ interface and (b) the date that is thirty days after Perplexity is no longer providing the Services to Customer

points.text: Same as top-level retention: the Input retention rule in DPA Annex 1 (the earlier of deletion by Customer and thirty days after Perplexity is no longer providing the Services) coexists with the absence of any disclosed period for server-side state
points.text_zh: 同顶层 retention：DPA Annex 1 的 Input 保留规则(客户删除或服务结束后 30 天)与服务端状态无期限披露并存

points.text: The "no retention / zero day retention" wording in the FAQ and the privacy-security page is recorded alongside it.
points.text_zh: FAQ/privacy-security 的「不保留/零日保留」与之并列。

processing_region.quote: Our compute is hosted via Amazon Web Services in North America. By default, the API has zero day retention of user prompt data, which is never used for AI training

points.text: Same as top-level processing_region: one FAQ sentence, "Our compute is hosted via Amazon Web Services in North America"
points.text_zh: 同顶层 processing_region：FAQ 一句「Our compute is hosted via Amazon Web Services in North America」

points.text: No commitment to region selection.
points.text_zh: 无区域可选承诺。

role.quote: Customer is the Controller or Processor or Business and Perplexity is the Service Provider or Processor

points.text: Same as top-level role: DPA §2 states that Perplexity is the Service Provider or Processor
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role：DPA §2 自认 Service Provider or Processor

points.text: API ToS §6.1 incorporates the DPA into the contract.
points.text_zh: API ToS §6.1 把 DPA 并入合同。

training.quote: Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models

points.text: Inherits API ToS §2.3.3 (Customer Content is not used for training, and third parties may not be authorized to do so). Note that §2.3.3 does not change according to whether store or previous_response_id is used
points.text_zh: 继承 API ToS §2.3.3(客户内容不训练，且不得授权第三方训练)。注意 §2.3.3 不因是否使用 store/previous_response_id 而改变

points.text: The conduct of the upstream Third-Party Providers themselves still falls outside the commitment.
points.text_zh: 但上游 Third-Party Providers 自身行为仍不在承诺范围。

zdr.quote: If your account has a Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreement with Perplexity, check with your account team before relying on stateful features

points.text: Same as top-level zdr. The key fact on this row: the docs expressly say that if your account has a Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreement you should check with your account team before relying on stateful features, which amounts to acknowledging an unresolved interaction between ZDR and stateful features
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr。本行的关键事实：官方明说 stateful 功能要先与客户团队确认 ZDR 是否适用，等于承认 ZDR 与有状态功能存在未解决的交互

points.text: store: false is not a ZDR switch.
points.text_zh: store:false 不是 ZDR 开关。

retention.quote: The Agent API persists response and conversation state server-side so responses can be retrieved (`store`) or continued (`previous_response_id`). Setting `store: false` only hides a response from retrieval — it does not disable persistence, and the response can still be used as a continuation source

points.text: The core conflict for retention on this tier: the Agent API persists response and conversation state server-side by default, and setting store: false only hides a response from retrieval — it does not disable persistence
points.text_zh: 本档 retention 的核心冲突：Agent API 默认服务端持久化 response 与会话状态，store:false 只隐藏检索、不关闭持久化

points.text: **The retention period, automatic expiry and deletion method are all undisclosed**. At the contract layer (DPA Annex 1) there is only one rule, covering Personal Data, "until the earlier of (a) the date it is deleted by Customer through the Services' interface and (b) the date that is thirty days after Perplexity is no longer providing the Services to Customer", and it does not address conversation state itself
points.text_zh: **保留期限、自动过期、删除方式均未披露**。合同层(DPA Annex 1)只给 Personal Data 一条「客户删除或服务结束后 30 天」的规则，且不涉及会话状态本身

points.text: The "no retention / zero day retention" wording in the FAQ and the privacy-security page coexists with that persistence, so both are recorded side by side without picking a side.
points.text_zh: FAQ/privacy-security 的「不保留 / 零日保留」与上述持久化并存，故并列保留、不选边。

processing_region.quote: Our compute is hosted via Amazon Web Services in North America. By default, the API has zero day retention of user prompt data, which is never used for AI training

points.text: Same as top-level processing_region. The storage location of conversation state is not separately disclosed; there is only the platform-level sentence that compute is hosted via AWS in North America.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 processing_region。会话状态的存储地未单独披露，只有平台级「compute 在 AWS 北美」一句。

role.quote: Customer is the Controller or Processor or Business and Perplexity is the Service Provider or Processor

points.text: Same as top-level role. The stateful path does not change the roles: the Customer remains Controller/Business and Perplexity is Processor/Service Provider.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role。有状态路径不改变角色：客户仍是 controller/business，Perplexity 是 processor/service provider。

training.quote: Perplexity maintains a strict **Zero Data Retention Policy** for the Chat Completions API. We do not retain data sent through the Chat Completions API, and we do not use customer data to train our models or for any purpose beyond processing the immediate request

points.text: The second half of the same sentence, "we do not use customer data to train our models or for any purpose beyond processing the immediate request", limited to the Chat Completions tier.
points.text_zh: 同句后半「we do not use customer data to train our models or for any purpose beyond processing the immediate request」，限 Chat Completions 档。

zdr.quote: Perplexity maintains a strict **Zero Data Retention Policy** for the Chat Completions API. We do not retain data sent through the Chat Completions API, and we do not use customer data to train our models or for any purpose beyond processing the immediate request

points.text: That page reads "Perplexity maintains a strict **Zero Data Retention Policy** for the Chat Completions API. We do not retain data sent through the Chat Completions API...". The qualifier is the Chat Completions API, **not** the Agent API
points.text_zh: 该页原文「Perplexity maintains a strict **Zero Data Retention Policy** for the Chat Completions API. We do not retain data sent through the Chat Completions API…」。限定语是 Chat Completions API，**不是** Agent API

points.text: This row exists only to mark the tier boundary.
points.text_zh: 本行只为划清档位边界。

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: This billing metadata does not include any content from your prompts, responses, or other user data

points.text: This tier keeps only billing metadata (token counts, model, timestamp, API key identifier), and "This billing metadata does not include any content from your prompts, responses, or other user data". That is the opposite of the Agent API tier, so it has to be a separate row.
points.text_zh: 该档只留计费元数据(token 数、模型、时间戳、API key 标识)，且「This billing metadata does not include any content from your prompts, responses, or other user data」。与 Agent API 档相反，故必须分行。

processing_region.quote: Our compute is hosted via Amazon Web Services in North America. By default, the API has zero day retention of user prompt data, which is never used for AI training

points.text: Same source and same conclusion as the top level and the api tier: one FAQ sentence, "Our compute is hosted via Amazon Web Services in North America. By default, the API has zero day retention of user prompt data..." — the first half takes "our compute" as its object, which is a platform-level statement not split by endpoint, so it covers the Chat Completions tier as well. Perplexity provides no region selection or data residency option, and does not disclose the specific AWS region (only North America). This row is a boundary marker: region and role agreeing across the two tiers does not mean the other dimensions agree — on zdr and retention, Chat Completions and the Agent API are exactly opposite, which is why this row is listed on its own. Uncertainty: the sentence comes from the FAQ (developer_data layer), the contract layer (API ToS and DPA) has no data-location clause, and the DPA's cross-border transfer mechanism is not given in the public text.
points.text_zh: 与顶层及 api 档同源、同结论：FAQ 一句「Our compute is hosted via Amazon Web Services in North America. By default, the API has zero day retention of user prompt data...」——前半句以「our compute」为对象，是平台级表述，不按端点分档，故同样覆盖 Chat Completions 档。官方未提供任何区域选择或数据驻留选项，也没有披露具体 AWS 区域（只说 North America）。本行是边界标注行：region 与 role 两维两档一致，并不意味着其他维度一致——zdr/retention 两维 Chat Completions 与 Agent API 恰好相反，这正是本行单列的原因。不确定性：该句出自 FAQ（developer_data 层），合同层（API ToS 与 DPA）没有数据所在地条款，DPA 的跨境传输机制未在公开文本中给出。

role.quote: Customer is the Controller or Processor or Business and Perplexity is the Service Provider or Processor

points.text: Same source and same conclusion as the top level and the api tier: DPA §2, "Customer is the Controller or Processor or Business and Perplexity is the Service Provider or Processor"
points.text_zh: 与顶层及 api 档同源、同结论：DPA §2「Customer is the Controller or Processor or Business and Perplexity is the Service Provider or Processor」

points.text: API ToS §6.1 incorporates the DPA into the contract by reference, and the scope in ToS §1 expressly covers "the Sonar by Perplexity and/or Agentic Research application programming interface (“API”) services" — Sonar's chat completions endpoint is among them, so the processor positioning applies to this tier as well. Why confidence is recorded as medium: DPA §1 carries its own exclusion, "Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA"; the ones named are the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search, and Chat Completions is not among them, but the list is open-ended (including but not limited to) and no complete list of excepted services is given. One hop upstream: ToS §2.6 acknowledges that the Services may use third-party models and DPA §6(c) requires subcontractors to carry obligations no less onerous than Perplexity's own, but the public text does not name one by one which model providers take part in the Chat Completions tier.
points.text_zh: API ToS §6.1 以引用方式把 DPA 并入合同，而 ToS §1 的适用范围明写覆盖「the Sonar by Perplexity and/or Agentic Research application programming interface ("API") services」——Sonar 的 chat completions 端点正在其中，故本档同样适用 processor 定位。置信度记 medium 的理由：DPA §1 自带排除条款「Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA」，被点名的是 Embeddings API 与 Perplexity Search，Chat Completions 不在其列，但该清单是开放式的（including but not limited to），官方未给出完整的例外服务清单。上游一跳：ToS §2.6 承认 Services 可能使用第三方模型，DPA §6(c) 要求子处理方承担不低于自身的义务，但公开文本未逐一点名哪些模型提供方参与 Chat Completions 档。

training.quote: Our third party AI model providers and third party developers may receive details about your interactions with bots and apps on Poe (including the contents of your chats and photos or documents you upload) to provide and generally improve their services

points.text: API 档**没有任何专门针对 API 输入的训练承诺**，只能套平台级条款，且平台级条款本身冲突：(a) 适用的是 Poe Privacy Policy——上游模型厂商「may receive details about your interactions with bots and apps on Poe … to provide and generally improve their services」
points.text_zh: API 档**没有任何专门针对 API 输入的训练承诺**，只能套平台级条款，且平台级条款本身冲突：(a) 适用的是 Poe Privacy Policy——上游模型厂商「may receive details about your interactions with bots and apps on Poe … to provide and generally improve their services」

points.text: (b) Privacy Center 的「do not train on your chats」承诺对象是「Official Poe bots and user-created prompt bots」，是消费档的 bot/app 概念，API 档没有 privacy shield 机制，该承诺是否延伸到直接调模型的 API 调用**无官方文字支持**
points.text_zh: (b) Privacy Center 的「do not train on your chats」承诺对象是「Official Poe bots and user-created prompt bots」，是消费档的 bot/app 概念，API 档没有 privacy shield 机制，该承诺是否延伸到直接调模型的 API 调用**无官方文字支持**

points.text: (c) Poe ToS §4.5 给 Poe 自身一项永久可转让许可，用途含「generally improve the Poe services」。另有明确为「是」的一跳：Poe API 的路由目标包括社区 bot（`poe.com/api/models` 价目表列 xAI / Moonshot AI / Google 等上游），而第三方开发者 bot 是允许拿对话训练自己模型的（Privacy Center half shield）。按多跳规则：任一跳明确为否则全链为否——但本链上游各跳的态度逐厂商不同，Poe 未披露路由到哪一跳、也未披露上游角色，因此本档只能记 conflicting，**按保守假设页面记 ✗**。
points.text_zh: (c) Poe ToS §4.5 给 Poe 自身一项永久可转让许可，用途含「generally improve the Poe services」。另有明确为「是」的一跳：Poe API 的路由目标包括社区 bot（`poe.com/api/models` 价目表列 xAI / Moonshot AI / Google 等上游），而第三方开发者 bot 是允许拿对话训练自己模型的（Privacy Center half shield）。按多跳规则：任一跳明确为否则全链为否——但本链上游各跳的态度逐厂商不同，Poe 未披露路由到哪一跳、也未披露上游角色，因此本档只能记 conflicting，**按保守假设页面记 ✗**。

zdr.quote: Each provider sets their own retention schedule (e.g. OpenAI and Anthropic retain your chats for 30 days). Please reach out to the AI model provider directly to learn more.

points.text: API 档没有任何零保留方案、开关或申请入口。读懂的依据：①Poe 没有 API 专用数据条款——/api/terms 是真 404（Poe 的 API 条款只有 /api_terms，而那份的标的是「把自建 bot 接入 Poe」的开发者档，不是本档）
points.text_zh: API 档没有任何零保留方案、开关或申请入口。读懂的依据：①Poe 没有 API 专用数据条款——/api/terms 是真 404（Poe 的 API 条款只有 /api_terms，而那份的标的是「把自建 bot 接入 Poe」的开发者档，不是本档）

points.text: poe.com/dpa 等路径只抓到 OneTrust cookie 外壳、未取得正文，**这是我方抓取失败，不能据此断言不存在**（上一轮写作「/dpa 404」，已修正）。②poe.com/api 自称「a single, unified gateway」
points.text_zh: poe.com/dpa 等路径只抓到 OneTrust cookie 外壳、未取得正文，**这是我方抓取失败，不能据此断言不存在**（上一轮写作「/dpa 404」，已修正）。②poe.com/api 自称「a single, unified gateway」

points.text: creator 文档站四页（external-applications、external-application-guide、api-reference/overview、FAQ）通读无保留期 / 日志 / prompt 缓存条款，请求字段表把 `store`、`metadata` 标为 Ignored——调用方无法用 OpenAI 标准字段表达存储意图。③Poe 把保留责任推给上游：「Each provider sets their own retention schedule (e.g. OpenAI and Anthropic retain your chats for 30 days). training.quote: 授予我们及关联公司一项全球范围、永久有效、免费的许可权，允许我们在优化模型和服务过程中使用您通过本服务上传、生成、发布或传播的所有信息内容

points.text: See top-level training. At the contract layer the default licence covers use "in the course of optimizing models and services" (§4.5), and coexists with the "we will not access or use your data without your consent" clauses in User Agreement §6.4 and PPIO Privacy Policy §2.4.5(2); the reading is that entering into the agreement constitutes that consent; no opt-out switch is documented; the licence is granted to "us and our affiliates" and does not cover the third-party technical support provider referred to in §8.6.
points.text_zh: 见顶层 training。合同层默认授权用于「优化模型和服务」（§4.5），与《用户协议》§6.4、《PPIO 隐私政策》§2.4.5(2) 的「未经（明确）同意不使用/不训练」条款并存，读法为签署协议即构成该同意；无退出开关说明；授权对象为「我们及关联公司」，不含 §8.6 所称的第三方技术支持商。

zdr.quote: 当请求与历史 Prompt 完全一致时，系统会直接返回缓存结果

points.text: Same as top-level zdr: zero retention is not supported (no); see the top level for the reasoning chain. All three grounds take the form "this line says X, therefore Y": (1) the Prompt Cache doc says X, "when a request is completely identical to a historical prompt, the system returns the cached result directly" — the object is request content (the historical prompt), therefore Y, the platform retains request content on the inference side, and "transparent to the application" shows this is not a customer-facing switch; the whole page gives no TTL, no purge rule and no way to turn it off
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr：不支持零保留（no），判断链见顶层。三条依据都是「这条说的是 X，所以 Y」：①Prompt Cache 文档说的是 X「当请求与历史 Prompt 完全一致时，系统会直接返回缓存结果」——对象是请求内容（历史 Prompt），所以 Y 平台在推理侧保留了请求内容，且「对应用透明」说明它不是客户开关，全篇无 TTL/清除规则/关闭方式

points.text: (2) Model Privacy Policy §5.3.3 says X, "we may not be able to delete the corresponding information from our backup systems immediately" — an admission that backups exist and that deletion is delayed, therefore Y, the "no recoverable copy" requirement of zero retention does not hold
points.text_zh: ②《模型隐私政策》§5.3.3 说的是 X「可能无法立即从备份系统中删除相应的信息」——自认存在备份且删除有延迟，所以 Y 零保留要求的「无副本可恢复」不成立

points.text: (3) the Batch Inference doc says X, "the file will be retained for 15 days" and "the result output file will be deleted 30 days after batch inference finishes" — therefore Y, on the batch tier request content is retained 15 days and output 30 days. For the contrary sentence see docs/model/FAQs ("a stateless interface ... does not save the full conversation content of each request"; that source has been judged drop and its anchor cleared): it says the console does not provide full conversation records (the qualifier is "full" and the context is "how to view API call records"), not "the platform retains no request content", which is not enough to overturn (1) and does not contradict (1) on the same proposition. The retention policy of the upstream technical support provider (User Agreement §8.6) is not disclosed; this conclusion covers only the PPIO hop.
points.text_zh: ③《批量推理》文档说的是 X「该文件将保留 15 天」「结果输出文件将在批量推理结束后 30 天删除」——所以 Y 批量档请求内容保留 15 天、输出 30 天。反向句见 docs/model/FAQs（「无状态接口…不会保存每次请求的完整对话内容」，该源已判 drop、锚点清空）：它说的是控制台不提供完整对话记录（限定词「完整」、语境为「如何查看 API 调用记录」），不是「平台不保留任何请求内容」，不足以推翻①，也不与①构成同一命题的矛盾。上游技术支持商（《用户协议》§8.6）的保留策略未披露，本结论只覆盖 PPIO 这一跳。

points.text: Replit 会用提示词、指令、上下文与回复改进模型和 AI 功能；关闭 Model Improvement 的控制仅向 Pro 开放，Core 没有该开关。

points.text: 隐私政策仅承诺不再需要可识别数据时删除或去标识化，没有公布 Core 提示词与响应的量化期限。
points.text_zh: 隐私政策仅承诺不再需要可识别数据时删除或去标识化，没有公布 Core 提示词与响应的量化期限。

processing_region.quote: Choose where your workspace and published app infrastructure is hosted to support data residency and reduce latency. Replit provides separate geography settings, so you can manage development and published app locations independently.

points.text: 服务主要托管于美国；Core 可在发布时选择部署地域，但 Workspace 地域选择仅向 Pro 开放。
points.text_zh: 服务主要托管于美国；Core 可在发布时选择部署地域，但 Workspace 地域选择仅向 Pro 开放。

points.text: DPA 并入商业协议，而公开条款只明确 Pro 与 Enterprise 适用商业协议；Core 的 controller/processor 角色未公开界定。
points.text_zh: DPA 并入商业协议，而公开条款只明确 Pro 与 Enterprise 适用商业协议；Core 的 controller/processor 角色未公开界定。

training.quote: Replit will not use Customer Content to develop or improve Replit's products or services, train machine learning models, or create derivative works, except as expressly permitted in this Agreement.

points.text: The Enterprise Agreement carries an express use restriction: Replit will not use Customer Content to develop or improve its own products or services, train machine learning models, or create derivative works, except as expressly permitted in the agreement.
points.text_zh: 企业协议含明确的使用限制：除协议明确允许外，Replit 不会用客户内容开发或改进自家产品或服务、训练机器学习模型或创作衍生作品。

points.text: Replit's product documentation states the same in one line: for Enterprise users, Replit does not use customer content to train its models.
points.text_zh: Replit 的产品文档用一句话重复了同一结论：对企业用户，Replit 不会用客户内容训练其模型。
points.quote: For Enterprise users, Replit does not use customer content to train its models.

points.text: Usage Data is carved out of the restriction — de-identified interaction data that excludes Customer Content remains usable for internal analytics and business purposes.
points.text_zh: Usage Data 被排除在该限制之外——不含客户内容的去标识化交互数据仍可用于内部分析与商业目的。

zdr.quote:
For Enterprise organizations, Replit enforces stricter privacy controls:

*   **Zero Data Retention (ZDR) endpoints only**: Only models with a Zero Data Retention policy are available

points.text: For Enterprise organisations Replit enforces a routing rule rather than offering an opt-in: only models with a Zero Data Retention policy are available, so Enterprise requests are only routed to endpoints that do not retain any data.
points.text_zh: 对企业组织，Replit 强制一条路由规则而非提供自助开关：只提供带零数据保留政策的模型，企业请求只路由到不保留任何数据的端点。
points.quote: This ensures that Enterprise requests are only routed to endpoints that do not retain any data

points.text: Scope matters here: this ZDR is about which upstream endpoints Replit will route to through AI Integrations, not a statement that Replit itself retains nothing. Replit's platform-side retention (privacy policy, DPA, deletion windows) is unchanged by it, and the trade-off is a more limited model list.
points.text_zh: 适用范围要注意：这条 ZDR 讲的是 Replit 经 AI Integrations 会路由到哪些上游端点，不等于 Replit 自身什么都不留。平台侧的保留（隐私政策、DPA、删除窗口）不因此改变，代价是可用模型更少。

retention.quote: Customer may request return or deletion of Customer Personal Data up to ninety (90) days after termination of the Agreement.

points.text: The DPA gives the enterprise-tier window: the customer may request return or deletion of Customer Personal Data up to ninety days after termination, and Replit may retain it where required by law.
points.text_zh: DPA 给出企业档窗口：客户可在终止后 90 天内请求返还或删除客户个人数据，法律要求保留的除外。

points.text: The Enterprise Agreement adds a 30-day migration window: the customer may migrate or request migration of its content for up to thirty days after termination.
points.text_zh: 企业协议另给 30 天迁移窗口：客户可在终止后 30 天内迁移或请求迁移其内容。
points.quote: Customer may migrate or request migration of its content from the Platform for up to thirty (30) days after termination of this Agreement.

points.text: Outside those windows the privacy policy's as-needed deletion rule still applies, and no period for prompt and response content is published.
points.text_zh: 在这些窗口之外，隐私政策的按需删除规则仍然适用，提示词与响应正文没有公布期限。
points.quote: We take measures to delete your data or maintain it in a de-identified form when it is no longer necessary to be kept in identifiable form, unless we are required by law to keep this information for a longer period.

processing_region.quote: Enterprise admins can enforce a publishing geography for all projects across their organization. When a policy is set, builders in the organization publish to the configured geography.

points.text: Enterprise admins can enforce a publishing geography for all projects across the organisation; the policy applies only to projects not yet published, and already-published projects keep their geography.
points.text_zh: 企业管理员可为全组织的项目强制发布地域；该策略只对尚未发布的项目生效，已发布项目保持原地域。

points.text: Outside the residency controls, services are primarily hosted in the United States and may be hosted elsewhere.
points.text_zh: 在驻留控制之外，服务主要托管在美国，也可能托管在其他地方。
points.quote: Our Services are primarily hosted in the United States and may also be hosted in locations outside of the jurisdiction in which you live.

points.text: The subprocessor list places the AI-model entries in the USA — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Baseten, Fireworks AI and OpenRouter are all listed as USA, which is the upstream hop this ledger has to account for separately.
points.text_zh: 子处理者清单把 AI 模型相关条目列在美国——Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Baseten、Fireworks AI 与 OpenRouter 均标 USA，这是台账必须单独核算的上游一跳。
points.quote: | Anthropic | USA | AI models |

role.quote: To the extent Customer acts as a Controller, Customer appoints Company as a Processor with respect to the Personal Data provided by Customer to Company to perform the Services on Customer's behalf.

points.text: Customer as controller, Replit appointed as processor for the personal data provided to perform the services on the customer's behalf; processor-to-processor terms apply where the customer is itself a processor.
points.text_zh: 客户为控制者，Replit 被指定为受托处理方，处理客户为履行服务而提供的数据；客户本身是处理方时适用处理方对处理方条款。

points.text: Replit's responsibility matrix assigns the processing of prompts and model interaction — how they are logged, retained and whether used for training — to Replit, compliant with the Terms of Service and the DPA.
points.text_zh: Replit 的责任矩阵把提示词与模型交互的处理（如何记录、保留、是否用于训练）划归 Replit 负责，依据是服务条款与 DPA。
points.quote: Processing of prompts and model interaction | How prompts and generated code are logged, retained, and whether used for training.

training.quote: We use content you provide, including your prompts, instructions, context, and responses generated for you, to help develop and improve our models and AI features. This allows us to make our services more powerful.If you opt out of model improvement, new content associated with your account will not be used to develop or improve our models. Opting out of model improvement does not delete your content, remove it from your projects, or affect your ability to use the services.You can change this setting at any time.This control is available to Pro users.

points.text: Replit uses the content you provide — prompts, instructions, context and the responses generated for you — to help develop and improve its models and AI features, and the off switch is tier-gated: the docs state plainly that this control is available to Pro users.
points.text_zh: Replit 会用你提供的内容（提示词、指令、上下文与为你生成的回复）来开发和改进其模型与 AI 功能，而关闭开关按档位设限：文档直说该控制只对 Pro 用户开放。

points.text: The privacy policy grounds the same processing in legitimate interest rather than consent: product development and internal analytics, specifically to improve the accuracy of machine learning technologies such as code generation.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策把同一处理建立在正当利益而非同意之上：产品开发与内部分析，具体是为了提高代码生成等机器学习技术的准确性。
points.quote: we have a legitimate interest in using Personal Data for product development and internal analytics purposes, to improve the accuracy of our machine learning technologies such as code generation, and otherwise to improve the safety, security, and performance of our Services.

points.text: Replit separately reserves the right to access the content of private apps for troubleshooting, improving the service, and ensuring safety and security — a content-access right that is not part of the training clause.
points.text_zh: Replit 另外保留了为排障、改进服务与保障安全而访问私有 app 内容的权利——这是一项内容访问权，与训练条款不是同一件事。
points.quote: Replit reserves the right to access the content of your private apps for the purpose of troubleshooting, improving our service, and ensuring the safety and security of the Service.

points.text: No zero-data-retention commitment covers this tier. ZDR appears in Replit's documentation only as an Enterprise control over which model endpoints requests may be routed to; the free tier's terms, the privacy policy and the ToS say nothing about zero retention.
points.text_zh: 本档没有任何零数据保留承诺。ZDR 在 Replit 文档里只以「企业档限定可用端点」的形式出现；免费档的条款、隐私政策与 ToS 都没有提到零保留。

points.text: Upstream handling on self-serve tiers is configured by Replit rather than chosen by the user: paid endpoints have training disabled, but free endpoints may train on your prompts and completions and may publish them to public datasets.
points.text_zh: 自助档的上游处理由 Replit 配置而非用户选择：付费端点关闭训练，但免费端点可以用你的提示词与补全做训练，并可能把它们发布到公开数据集。
points.quote:
For individual and team users, Replit configures OpenRouter requests with the following privacy defaults:

*   **Paid endpoints training disabled**: Your data will not be used for training by paid model providers
*   **Free endpoints training enabled**: Free model providers may train on your prompts and completions
*   **Free endpoints publishing enabled**: Free providers may publish your prompts and completions to public datasets

points.text: Whether a free-tier user can obtain ZDR by contract is not addressed in any public document — this is an undisclosed option, not a stated refusal.
points.text_zh: 免费档用户能否通过合同拿到 ZDR，公开文档没有涉及——这是未披露的选项，不是明确的拒绝。

retention.quote: We take measures to delete your data or maintain it in a de-identified form when it is no longer necessary to be kept in identifiable form, unless we are required by law to keep this information for a longer period.

points.text: The privacy policy commits only to deleting or de-identifying data when it is no longer needed in identifiable form, unless a longer period is required by law — no period for prompt and response content is published.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策只承诺在不再需要以可识别形式保存时删除或去标识化，法律要求更长期限的除外——提示词与响应正文没有公布任何期限。

points.text: Free accounts carry a concrete inactivity trigger: an account not used within a 1-year period may be terminated and its associated user data deleted, including the Replit Apps tied to it. Paid subscriptions are exempt from that trigger.
points.text_zh: 免费账号有一条明确的闲置触发条件：1 年内未使用的账号可被终止并删除关联用户数据，包括其下的 Replit Apps。付费订阅不受该触发条件约束。
points.quote: An inactive Replit account is one that has not been used within a **1-year** period, meaning the user has not logged in to the account during that period. Replit reserves the right to terminate inactive Replit accounts and delete associated user data. Replit will delete Replit Apps associated with inactive free accounts.

points.text: Account deletion is documented as removing all content from Replit and purging personal information from its systems, with no recovery afterwards.
points.text_zh: 账号删除被写明为移除 Replit 上的全部内容并从系统中清除个人信息，之后不可恢复。
points.quote: Deleting your account removes all of your content from Replit (including Replit Apps, templates, posts), and results in your personal information being purged from our systems.

points.text: Public-facing content is a different object with default exposure: profile, code and posts may be viewable and searchable by other users and indexed by search engines by default.
points.text_zh: 对外公开的内容是另一个对象且默认暴露：个人资料、代码与帖子默认可被其他用户查看与搜索，并被搜索引擎索引。
points.quote: Your profile, including your name, username, profile picture, code, and other profile information may be viewable and searchable by other users and search indexed by online search engines. The content you post to the Services, including your code and forum posts, may be displayed on the platform and visible to other users by default.

processing_region.quote: Our Services are primarily hosted in the United States and may also be hosted in locations outside of the jurisdiction in which you live.

points.text: Services are primarily hosted in the United States and may also be hosted outside your jurisdiction; using the Services from elsewhere means accepting transfer of your data to the US and other hosting jurisdictions for storage, access and processing.
points.text_zh: 服务主要托管在美国，也可能托管在你所在司法辖区之外；从其他地区使用服务即表示接受数据被转移到美国及其他托管地存储、访问与处理。

points.text: Publishing geography is a choice made when a project is published, and it is permanent: geography cannot be changed after publishing and a published project cannot be migrated to another geography.
points.text_zh: 发布地域是发布项目时做出的选择，且不可更改：发布后地域不能变更，已发布项目也无法迁移到其他地域。
points.quote: Geography cannot be changed after publishing.** Once you publish your project to a geography, that selection is permanent. You cannot migrate a published project to a different geography.

points.text: This tier has no controller/processor designation. The DPA is incorporated into the Replit Commercial Agreement, and the ToS states that the Commercial Agreement applies only if you use the Pro or Enterprise Service — so the free tier runs on the ToS and the privacy policy, neither of which assigns a role.
points.text_zh: 本档没有控制者/受托处理方的定性。DPA 并入的是 Replit Commercial Agreement，而 ToS 写明只有使用 Pro 或 Enterprise 服务才适用该商业协议——因此免费档只受 ToS 与隐私政策管辖，两者都未约定角色。
points.quote: forms part of and is incorporated into the Replit Commercial Agreement (the "**Agreement**") between Replit, Inc. ("**Company**") and the entity identified as Customer in the Agreement ("**Customer**") and reflects the Parties' agreement with respect to the Processing of Personal Data by Company on behalf of Customer.

points.text: The DPA's own definition of its scope points the same way: it is incorporated into the Commercial Agreement and covers processing by Replit on behalf of the Customer identified in that agreement.
points.text_zh: DPA 自己界定的适用范围也指向同一结论：它并入商业协议，覆盖 Replit 代该协议中确定的客户进行的处理。
points.quote: To the extent Customer acts as a Controller, Customer appoints Company as a Processor with respect to the Personal Data provided by Customer to Company to perform the Services on Customer's behalf.

training.quote: Replit may also use Customer Content to develop, train, and improve its models and AI Features. Customers can opt out of the use of Customer Content to develop, train, and improve models and AI Features through the settings page.

points.text: The Pro Agreement licenses the content for training and provides the exit in the same breath: Replit may also use Customer Content to develop, train, and improve its models and AI Features, and customers can opt out through the settings page.
points.text_zh: Pro 协议在同一处既给出训练许可也给出退出通道：Replit 可将客户内容用于开发、训练与改进其模型与 AI 功能，客户可通过设置页退出。

points.text: The documented path is Settings → Personalization → opt out of Model Improvement, and it applies to new content associated with the account.
points.text_zh: 文档给出的路径是 Settings → Personalization → 关闭 Model Improvement，作用于该账号此后产生的新内容。
points.quote: We use content you provide, including your prompts, instructions, context, and responses generated for you, to help develop and improve our models and AI features. This allows us to make our services more powerful.If you opt out of model improvement, new content associated with your account will not be used to develop or improve our models. Opting out of model improvement does not delete your content, remove it from your projects, or affect your ability to use the services.You can change this setting at any time.This control is available to Pro users.

points.text: Upstream endpoint behaviour is set by Replit's OpenRouter configuration, not by the user: paid endpoints have training disabled, free endpoints may train on prompts and completions and may publish them to public datasets.
points.text_zh: 上游端点行为由 Replit 的 OpenRouter 配置决定，而非用户：付费端点关闭训练，免费端点可用提示词与补全做训练，并可能发布到公开数据集。
points.quote:
For individual and team users, Replit configures OpenRouter requests with the following privacy defaults:

*   **Paid endpoints training disabled**: Your data will not be used for training by paid model providers
*   **Free endpoints training enabled**: Free model providers may train on your prompts and completions
*   **Free endpoints publishing enabled**: Free providers may publish your prompts and completions to public datasets

points.text: The Pro Agreement contains no zero-data-retention commitment, and the DPA does not mention ZDR either. In Replit's documentation ZDR exists only as an Enterprise routing rule.
points.text_zh: Pro 协议没有零数据保留承诺，DPA 也没有提到 ZDR。在 Replit 文档里 ZDR 只作为企业档的路由规则存在。
points.quote:
For Enterprise organizations, Replit enforces stricter privacy controls:

*   **Zero Data Retention (ZDR) endpoints only**: Only models with a Zero Data Retention policy are available

points.text: That Enterprise rule is explicit about being tier-specific: only models with a Zero Data Retention policy are available, so Enterprise requests are only routed to endpoints that do not retain any data — with the stated trade-off that fewer models are available.
points.text_zh: 那条企业规则明确是按档位限定的：只提供带零数据保留政策的模型，因此企业请求只路由到不保留任何数据的端点——代价是可用模型更少。
points.quote: This ensures that Enterprise requests are only routed to endpoints that do not retain any data

retention.quote: We take measures to delete your data or maintain it in a de-identified form when it is no longer necessary to be kept in identifiable form, unless we are required by law to keep this information for a longer period.

points.text: The privacy policy's commitment is only the as-needed deletion or de-identification rule; no period for prompt and response content is published.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策的承诺只有「不再需要即删除或去标识化」这一条；提示词与响应正文没有公布期限。

points.text: Pro is covered by the DPA: the customer may request return or deletion of Customer Personal Data up to ninety days after termination of the agreement, and Replit may retain it where the law requires.
points.text_zh: Pro 档受 DPA 覆盖：客户可在协议终止后 90 天内请求返还或删除客户个人数据，法律要求保留的除外。
points.quote: Customer may request return or deletion of Customer Personal Data up to ninety (90) days after termination of the Agreement.

points.text: Opting out of model improvement stops future training use but does not delete anything: opting out does not delete your content, remove it from your projects, or affect your ability to use the services.
points.text_zh: 退出模型改进只停止今后的训练用途，并不删除任何东西：退出不会删除你的内容、不会把它从项目中移除，也不影响你使用服务。
points.quote: Opting out of model improvement does not delete your content, remove it from your projects, or affect your ability to use the services.

points.text: Paid subscriptions are exempt from the free-tier inactivity deletion trigger.
points.text_zh: 付费订阅不受免费档闲置删除触发条件的约束。
points.quote: Replit accounts under a paid subscription plan are not subject to termination due to account inactivity.

processing_region.quote: Pro customers can choose a Workspace location during creation.

points.text: Pro customers can choose a Workspace location when the workspace is created; the responsibility matrix assigns data residency to Replit as the mechanism with the customer configuring it.
points.text_zh: Pro 客户可在创建工作区时选择 Workspace 位置；责任矩阵把数据驻留归为 Replit 提供机制、客户做配置。

points.text: Publishing geography is chosen at publish time and cannot be changed afterwards, and the two settings need not match.
points.text_zh: 发布地域在发布时选定且之后不可更改，两个设置也不必一致。
points.quote: Geography cannot be changed after publishing.** Once you publish your project to a geography, that selection is permanent. You cannot migrate a published project to a different geography.

points.text: Outside the residency controls, services are primarily hosted in the United States and may be hosted elsewhere.
points.text_zh: 在驻留控制之外，服务主要托管在美国，也可能托管在其他地方。
points.quote: Our Services are primarily hosted in the United States and may also be hosted in locations outside of the jurisdiction in which you live.

role.quote: To the extent Customer acts as a Controller, Customer appoints Company as a Processor with respect to the Personal Data provided by Customer to Company to perform the Services on Customer's behalf.

points.text: Where the customer acts as a controller, Replit is appointed as a processor for the personal data provided to perform the services on the customer's behalf. Module 3 (processor-to-processor) applies where the customer is itself a processor.
points.text_zh: 在客户作为控制者的情况下，Replit 被指定为受托处理方，处理客户为履行服务而提供的数据；客户本身是处理方时适用 Module 3（处理方对处理方）。

points.text: The DPA reaches this tier through the Commercial Agreement, which the ToS says applies to Pro and Enterprise Services.
points.text_zh: DPA 经由商业协议覆盖本档，而 ToS 写明商业协议适用于 Pro 与 Enterprise 服务。
points.quote: forms part of and is incorporated into the Replit Commercial Agreement (the "**Agreement**") between Replit, Inc. ("**Company**") and the entity identified as Customer in the Agreement ("**Customer**") and reflects the Parties' agreement with respect to the Processing of Personal Data by Company on behalf of Customer.

points.text: The docs site data-privacy §3 and the product page state alike that Scaleway does not collect, read, reuse, or analyze the content of your inputs, prompts, or outputs generated by the API. The Free Tier discloses no different data-use terms.

zdr.quote: Scaleway does not retain any requests or generated Content after processing.

points.text: See top-level zdr: "By default we apply a Zero Data Retention Policy", with no application required
points.text_zh: 见顶层 zdr：默认适用，无需申请

points.text: The exceptions are temporary retention for abuse investigation (up to 2 weeks), storage for the duration of Batch processing (up to 24 hours), and the token cache, whose retention period is not disclosed.
points.text_zh: 例外为滥用临时留存（≤2 周）、Batch 处理期间存储（≤24 小时）、未披露保留期的 token 缓存。

retention.quote: Scaleway does not retain any requests or generated Content after processing.

points.text: See top-level retention: for standard synchronous processing, "Scaleway does not retain any requests or generated Content after processing"

points.text: Under the abuse exception Scaleway may temporarily store and access the full content of HTTP requests (the docs site gives a cap of two weeks)
points.text_zh: 滥用例外可临时留存完整 HTTP 请求内容（文档站给上限两周）

points.text: Batch inputs are stored only for the duration of processing, i.e. twenty-four (24) hours
points.text_zh: Batch 输入仅存处理期间（≤24 小时）

points.text: For usage metrics see data-privacy §4, "Aggregated and anonymized data is stored for up to 6 months", and Cockpit, where Scaleway metrics have a minimum and default retention of 31 days and a cap of 1825 days
points.text_zh: 用量指标见 data-privacy §4「up to 6 months」与 Cockpit「Scaleway metrics 最小/默认 31 天、上限 1825 天」

points.text: Account data is handled under the general privacy policy
points.text_zh: 账户数据按通用隐私政策

points.text: After service termination, GTC §13.3 provides for deletion within ten days, with Scaleway undertaking not to retain any copy. The token cache retention period is not disclosed.
points.text_zh: 服务终止后 GTC §13.3 十天内删除且不留副本。token 缓存保留期未披露。

points.text: The controller layer in GTC §17 covers only contracting and account data.
points.text_zh: GTC §17 的 controller 层只覆盖缔约与账户数据。

training.quote: is not used to train, retrain, or improve the base Models

zdr.quote: Scaleway does not retain any requests or generated Content after processing.

points.text: Same Contract §4.4
points.text_zh: 同合同 §4.4

points.text: Processing on this tier takes place on the customer's dedicated, isolated resources (§2.1.2, "The processing of Inputs and the generation of Outputs take place on private resources"), but there is no separately disclosed cache retention statement for this tier.
points.text_zh: 本档处理发生在客户专属隔离资源上（§2.1.2「The processing of Inputs and the generation of Outputs take place on private resources」），但没有单独披露的、针对本档的缓存保留期说明。

retention.quote: Scaleway does not retain any requests or generated Content after processing.

points.text: The general clause of Contract §4.4 (no retention of requests or generated Content, no logging, exception for incidents) applies to this tier
points.text_zh: 合同 §4.4 的通用条（不保留请求与生成内容、不留日志、异常例外）适用于本档

points.text: §5.2「The deletion of a deployment is an irreversible action that erases all associated data and resources」

The last paragraph of §4.4 makes the Client solely responsible for the lifecycle of its own data (backup, retention, deletion, archiving). Note: the Batch 24-hour clause is qualified by "In the context of the Generative API Service" and does not apply to Dedicated Deployment.
points.text_zh: §4.4 末段明确客户对自身数据生命周期（备份、保留、删除、归档）负全责。注意：Batch 24 小时那条限定语是「In the context of the Generative API Service」，不适用于 Dedicated Deployment。

zdr.quote: 完整的对话数组会进入到缓存系统当中，其中包含 System Prompt、User Message 以及 Assistant Message

points.text:
结论：不支持零保留（本档无 ZDR 选项/开关/申请入口，且客户请求正文会被平台跨请求留存）。本轮按「读，不要匹」重审，逐条写成「这条说的是 X，所以 Y」：
①【决定性】《Prompt 缓存最佳实践》（guides/developer 下的通用开发者文档，页内无档位限定）——「这条说的是：平台提供上下文缓存技术，把『每次请求过程中的输入』缓存起来，可缓存内容逐字包含『完整的对话数组会进入到缓存系统当中，其中包含 System Prompt、User Message 以及 Assistant Message』（图片、视频、工具调用信息及其结果同列），所以：客户提交的请求正文会进入平台缓存系统并被跨请求复用，零保留在平台侧不成立」。对象＝请求正文（System Prompt / User Message / Assistant Message、图片、视频、工具调用结果）。
②同页「如果未命中系统的缓存，系统将会进行正常的推理并在处理完成后，将 Prompt 前缀进行缓存，以供下次请求使用」——「这条说的是：响应返回之后 Prompt 前缀仍被写入缓存，所以：留存不是『为完成单次请求的短暂缓存』，而是处理完成之后的留存」。
③同页「当请求超过 256 个 Token 时，缓存会自动启用」——「这条说的是：缓存按请求长度自动开启、无客户侧 opt-in，所以：客户无法通过公开配置关掉这条留存路径」。
④同页「缓存淘汰采用最近最少使用（LRU）策略…高峰期更容易被逐出；低峰期拥有更长的生命周期」——「这条说的是：生命周期由系统负载决定，全页没有任何 TTL 天数，所以：既推不出保留上限，也不能据此写 retention 期限」。
⑤同页 FAQ「目前不提供手动清除缓存的能力。您可以通过修改 Prompt 来使请求不命中缓存」——「这条说的是：客户侧没有清除缓存的操作（唯一规避手段是改 Prompt），所以：客户无法删除已写入缓存的内容」。注意这句是**客户侧**能力（无清除接口/开关），不是『平台永不删除』——服务端仍有 LRU 淘汰，故不据此写成「永久保留」。
⑥档位适用范围（上一轮只凭一句端点说明，本轮读完整页＋另两页交叉）：Chat Completions API 参考页 Note 逐字「Step Plan 场景请使用 POST https://api.stepfun.com/step_plan/v1/chat/completions」，同页另设「Step Plan 通道：DeepSeek 引擎字段差异」并写明 step-router-v1「字段约束与本文『请求参数』一致」

points.text: Messages API 页逐字「普通 API 与 Step Plan 使用不同地址。把 SDK 的 Base URL 从 https://api.stepfun.com 换成 https://api.stepfun.com/step_plan…即可切换到 Step Plan」——「这条说的是：Step Plan 与普通 API 是同一个 Chat Completions / Messages 接口、只换路径前缀（不是另一个端点），所以：该接口面的缓存机制同样适用于本档」。两条加证：缓存文档按模型声明支持范围，所列 step-5-preview、step-3.7-flash、step-3.5-flash、step-3.5-flash-2603 全部出现在 Step Plan 概述页的本档支持模型清单里
points.text_zh: Messages API 页逐字「普通 API 与 Step Plan 使用不同地址。把 SDK 的 Base URL 从 https://api.stepfun.com 换成 https://api.stepfun.com/step_plan…即可切换到 Step Plan」——「这条说的是：Step Plan 与普通 API 是同一个 Chat Completions / Messages 接口、只换路径前缀（不是另一个端点），所以：该接口面的缓存机制同样适用于本档」。两条加证：缓存文档按模型声明支持范围，所列 step-5-preview、step-3.7-flash、step-3.5-flash、step-3.5-flash-2603 全部出现在 Step Plan 概述页的本档支持模型清单里

points.text:
Step Plan 推理模型接入页逐字「计费逻辑与开放平台一致，最终按开放平台实际计费金额折算为 Step Plan 总额度消耗」，而开放平台计费逻辑（定价与限速页）含『输入价格（缓存命中）/（缓存未命中）』两档——所以缓存随计费逻辑一并适用于本档。该页响应字段 prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens（『提示信息中命中缓存的 token 数量』）在同页两处出现、上下文相同，无法唯一定位，故不单列锚点，仅作接口面同一性的旁证。档位覆盖仍是跨页推导，官方没有一句『本档启用缓存』，故 confidence=medium。
⑦合同层佐证：用户协议 §5.3（锚点 zdr-content-license-includes-storage）——「这条说的是：对『您发布上传或传输的内容』，客户授予平台一项含『存储、使用、复制、修订、编辑』的许可使用（目的含『提升大模型服务体验』），所以：合同层不但没有『不留存』承诺，反而给了含存储的许可」。标的范围靠同协议回指确定：§2.1.3 定义「您或您的最终用户基于本服务输入的文字、图片、音频、视频等内容（输入内容）」，§4.3 用同一组动词描述最终用户提交内容（『上传、发布或者传输的内容』），§6.4「您使用本服务时，向我们传输的任何信息」——即 §5.3 的对象含客户经服务提交的内容（请求正文）。**但这是知识产权章的许可授予（平台『可以』做什么），不是平台实际留存行为的披露，也没有期限或删除义务**，故只作佐证、不作决定性依据（本轮已把该锚点 exact 换成自带对象的整句）。
⑧删除侧（锚点 retention-termination-deletion-right）：用户协议 §3.6「这条说的是：平台『有权』在服务终止后或『我们与您另行约定的保留期限（如有）』届满后删除『您存储在我们服务中的数据等任何信息』，所以：这是删除权而非删除义务、期限写作『如有』，公开条款里没有请求级即时删除或 ZDR 承诺」。

points.text: The tier-specific Tencent Cloud LLM Coding Plan Privacy Policy §1.1.2: "To keep improving your user experience, we will use encryption and de-identification techniques and, on the premise of avoiding identification of any specific individual, use input and output content to optimize models" — input and output are used to optimize models by default (that is, a model-improvement purpose), this can be turned off by submitting a ticket, and after it is turned off they are no longer used. Valuation rule = record the conservative case, "will be used for model optimization/training (on by default, opt-out by ticket)". Pointing the other way: TokenHub Terms of Service §2.17 (effective 2026-09-14), "Tencent Cloud will not use the content you input while using this service to develop, train, fine-tune or improve Tencent Cloud's own algorithms, models or services", with the TokenHub FAQ (130104) and TokenHub Privacy Policy §1.1.3 pointing the same way. Grounds for taking the tier-specific document: (1) the preamble of 129852 itself says "for specific models, plug-ins, tools, third-party services or specific features, the more specific provisions in the corresponding specific rules, third-party agreements or model list shall prevail" (anchor priority-specific-rule)
points.text_zh: 档位专属《腾讯云大模型 Coding Plan 隐私政策》§1.1.2:『为持续提升您的用户体验，我们会采取加密和脱敏处理技术，在避免识别到特定个人的前提下，使用输入、输出内容来优化模型』——默认使用输入/输出优化模型(即属于模型改进用途),可提交工单关闭,关闭后不再使用。取值口径=按保守情形记『会被用于模型优化/训练(默认开启,可工单退出)』。与之相反:TokenHub 服务条款 §2.17(2026-09-14 生效)『腾讯云不会将您在使用本服务过程中的输入内容用于开发、训练、微调或改进腾讯云自身的算法、模型或服务』,TokenHub 常见问题(130104)与 TokenHub 隐私政策 §1.1.3 同向。取档位专属文件的依据:①129852 前言自认『就特定模型、插件、工具、第三方服务、或特定功能事项，以相应特定规则、第三方协议或模型清单中更具体的约定为准』(anchor priority-specific-rule)

points.text: This round of re-review (2026-09-21) keeps the direction "zero retention not supported", but lowers confidence from medium to low — the evidence can only be written in weak form, not as a direct vendor statement about retaining or deleting request content. (1) Primary basis, 129852 §2.14 (anchor retention-necessary-period): "Except where laws and regulations, regulatory requirements, third-party agreements, product rules, a separate agreement between you and Tencent Cloud, or the provision of this service so require, Tencent Cloud will retain your data only for the period necessary for the purpose of providing this service." This line says that Tencent Cloud retains your data under this service with the period limited to what is necessary to provide the service; it states an upper bound on duration, not a quantified retention commitment
points.text_zh: 本轮重审(2026-09-21)维持方向『不支持零保留』,但 confidence 由 medium 降为 low——依据只能写成弱形式,不能写成厂商对请求内容的直陈保留/删除表态。①主依据 129852 §2.14(anchor retention-necessary-period):『除法律法规、监管要求、第三方协议、产品规则、您与腾讯云另行约定或为提供本服务所必需的情形外，腾讯云将仅在为提供本服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的数据。』这条说的是『腾讯云会保留本服务项下的您的数据,期限限定在为提供本服务之目的所必需』,是期限上限声明,不是量化保留承诺

points.text: The second sentence, "after the data processing period ends Tencent Cloud will stop unnecessary use of the data, or return or delete the relevant data on your lawful and valid instructions", shows that deletion is not automatic
points.text_zh: 第二句『数据处理期限结束后停止不必要的数据使用行为,或者根据您的合法有效指示将相关数据返还给您或删除』表明删除并非自动

points.text: The third sentence, "if laws and regulations do not permit Tencent Cloud to delete such data, or deleting such data is technically difficult to achieve, Tencent Cloud will cease all processing other than storage, keeping records, performing statutory obligations and taking necessary security protection measures", expressly lists "storage" as one form of "processing". (2) Object chain (readable only from the surrounding clauses, not from a keyword hit): "your data" is nowhere defined in 129852 (§1.1 defines only "input content" and "output content"). Reading backwards — §2.11, "Tencent Cloud processes your input content on your mandate, instructions and requirements and for the purpose of providing this service to you"
points.text_zh: 第三句『如果法律法规不允许腾讯云删除此类数据,或删除此类数据从技术上难以实现,腾讯云将停止除存储、留存记录、履行法定义务和采取必要安全保护措施之外的处理』把『存储』明确列为『处理』的一种。②对象链(只能靠读同节上下文,非关键词命中):『您的数据』在 129852 全文无定义(§1.1 只定义『输入内容』『输出内容』)。往前读——§2.11『腾讯云基于您的委托、指令和需求并以向您提供本服务为目的处理您的输入内容』

points.text: The opening of §2.12, "Tencent Cloud will process your input content accordingly depending on the model, feature, deployment or manner of use", whose item (1) lists the objects of processing as "your input content, output content, call parameters, call time, model name, model version, account information, resource usage, error information, log information, network information and other necessary data"
points.text_zh: §2.12 开头『腾讯云将根据不同模型、功能、部署或使用方式对您的输入内容进行相应处理』,其(1)项把处理对象列为『您的输入内容、输出内容、调用参数、调用时间、模型名称、模型版本、账号信息、资源用量、错误信息、日志信息、网络信息及其他必要数据』

points.text: The last sentence of §2.14, "in the third-party-deployed model scenario, the rules for retention, deletion, return, anonymization or other processing of data", echoes the list of objects for the third-party scenario in §2.12(2). So "your data" in §2.14 = the objects of processing under this service listed in §2.12 (including input and output bodies), not boilerplate about account personal information. (3) Scenario check: the models available on this tier (1823/130092: GLM-5, and Auto "tc-code-latest") are not "third-party-deployed models" as defined in 129852 §1.5 ("currently includes the DeepSeek series of models"), so they fall under §2.12(1), the "Tencent Cloud first-party model and Tencent Cloud self-deployed model scenarios"
points.text_zh: §2.14 末句『第三方部署模型场景下对数据的留存、删除、返还、匿名化或其他处理规则』与 §2.12(2) 第三方场景的对象列举呼应。故 §2.14 的『您的数据』= §2.12 列举的本服务处理对象(含输入/输出正文),不是账户个人信息套话。③场景确认:本档可用模型(1823/130092:GLM-5、Auto『tc-code-latest』)不属 129852 §1.5 定义的『第三方部署模型』(『目前包括 DeepSeek 系列模型』),故落入 §2.12(1)『腾讯云自有模型和腾讯云自部署模型场景』

points.text: §1.11 and §6.4 further commit that intelligent routing and fallback switching will not send your data to third-party-deployed models. Contract-layer documents applicable to this tier: item 2 of the China-site "related agreements" list 1823/130105, the "LLM Service Platform TokenHub Terms of Service", points through documentation-center entry page 1823/130106 to 301/129852 (that entry page carries only a title plus "for details, see ..."). (4) §2.16 repositioned (misjudged last round, removed from anchors[] this round): §2.16 is about security obligations — "bears the corresponding security obligations for your business data within Tencent Cloud's control", "takes necessary protective measures for your data across use, storage, transmission, access, disclosure, security and other aspects", "without your consent, Tencent Cloud will not make any unauthorized access to, use of or disclosure of your business data". Within it, "data you upload, submit, transmit or store in Tencent Cloud data centers through this service" is a qualifier on the protected data, and "storage" appears in the list of stages covered by the protective measures; neither is a statement that "we will store your request content" — taking it as zdr evidence last round was a word hit with a different meaning. (5) Reverse search (by reading, not by matching): the full text of 129852, the full tier privacy policy f49e, 130092, 130103, 130104 and 131410 contain no statement of the kind "does not store", "not retained after processing completes" or "will not keep input and output". The three closest passages all fail to apply to this tier: (a) CodeBuddy statement 284d §2.7, custom-model scenario, "except where necessary to complete the user's request, effect necessary transmission, conduct security audit, troubleshoot faults or retain data as required by law and where separately notified, we will not read or store your input or the output content of your custom model during this process" — the context is client-side direct forwarding with the user's own third-party model key, not platform-side inference on this tier
points.text_zh: §1.11、§6.4 另承诺智能路由与备用切换不会把数据送往第三方部署模型。合同层为本档适用文档:中国站『相关协议』清单 1823/130105 第 2 条『大模型服务平台 TokenHub 服务条款』经文档中心条目页 1823/130106 指向 301/129852(该条目页正文只有标题+『详细信息,请参见…』)。④§2.16 重新定位(上一轮判错,本轮已从 anchors[] 删除):§2.16 讲的是安全保障义务——『对腾讯云控制范围内的您的业务数据承担相应的安全保障义务』『从使用、存储、传输、访问、披露、安全等多方面对您的数据采取必要保护措施』『未经您同意,腾讯云不会对您的业务数据进行任何未获授权的访问、使用和披露』。其中『您通过本服务上传、提交、传输或存储在腾讯云数据中心的数据』是受保护数据的定语,『存储』出现在保护措施覆盖的环节列表里,二者都不是『我们会存储您的请求内容』的声明——上一轮拿它当 zdr 依据属于词命中、义不同。⑤反向检索(读,非匹):129852 全文、档位隐私政策 f49e 全文、130092、130103、130104、131410 均无『不存储』『处理完成后不保留』『不会留存输入输出』类表述。最接近的三处均不适用本档:(a) CodeBuddy 声明 284d §2.7 自定义模型场景『除为完成用户请求、实现必要传输、安全审计、故障排查或依法留存所必需且已另行告知的情形外,此过程中我们不会读取、存储您的输入、自定义模型输出内容』——语境是用户自带第三方模型 key 的客户端直连转发,不是本档平台侧推理

points.text: (b) the same file's §2.7.3, "other than the use scenarios and purposes listed in this agreement, we will not store your code" — the object is code information inside the CodeBuddy software, a different tier
points.text_zh: (b) 同文件 §2.7.3『除本协议列举的使用场景及目的外,我们不会存储您的代码』——对象是 CodeBuddy 软件中的代码信息,档位不同

points.text: (c) the codebuddy.ai security and privacy page, "sensitive data will not be stored permanently" — "not stored permanently" is not "not stored", and "sensitive data" is left undefined. Separately, §2.9, "Tencent Cloud will retain logs such as information about the party served for no less than six months as required by law", governs logs in the generated-synthetic-content labelling scenario (a statutory floor) and cannot be read in reverse as a retention period for input and output bodies. (6) No ZDR option: the tier-specific policy f49e, the full text of 129852, the 7 items in the China-site "related agreements" list 130105 (no DPA/DPSA entry), the tier FAQ 130103, the Coding Plan overview 130092, the model list 130051, the platform FAQ 130104 and the TokenHub API docs 130078/132280 contain no occurrence of ZDR or zero data retention

The international-site DPSA module 1300/78953 does carry ZDR, but says it applies only to the international-site TokenHub and the enterprise Token Plan, is bound to the Singapore / Frankfurt / Silicon Valley resource regions, does not apply to this tier and must not be mixed in. points.text_zh: 中国站 DPSA 路径 301/17347 实测 HTTP 404。国际站 DPSA 模块 1300/78953 确有 ZDR,但自述只适用于国际站 TokenHub 与 Token Plan 企业版,且绑定新加坡/法兰克福/硅谷资源地域,不适用本档,不得混入。⑦为什么只给 low:『您的数据』在本档合同内无定义,对象链必须靠 §2.11→§2.12→§2.14 同节推导

points.text: The sentence form of §2.14 is an upper bound on duration, not a direct statement that "we will store input and output". So this point can only be written in weak form: "the contract acknowledges that data under this service is retained for the necessary period, with no quantified cap, deletion is not automatic, and no zero-retention option appears anywhere on this tier". If what the ledger requires is a direct vendor statement on retaining or deleting request content, this tier should be treated as not_found. Residual uncertainty: the tier-specific privacy policy f49e does not cite the TokenHub Terms of Service, and no written document states how the Coding Plan and the platform terms connect (it can only be inferred from the 130105 list and the document attribution of 130092).
points.text_zh: §2.14 句式为期限上限、非『我们会存储输入输出』的直陈。故本条只能写成弱形式:『合同承认本服务项下数据会被保留至必要期间、无量化上限、删除非自动,且全档未见零保留选项』。若台账要求的是厂商对请求内容的直陈保留/删除表态,本档应视同 not_found。残余不确定性:档位专属隐私政策 f49e 未引用 TokenHub 服务条款,Coding Plan 与平台条款的适用衔接未见书面文件明示(仅 130105 清单与 130092 的文档归属可推)。

points.text: This tier gives no fixed number of days. (1) Object = "your data", including input and output content: 129852 §2.14, "Except where laws and regulations, regulatory requirements, third-party agreements, product rules, a separate agreement between you and Tencent Cloud, or the provision of this service so require, Tencent Cloud will retain your data only for the period necessary for the purpose of providing this service", after which it stops unnecessary use of the data, or returns or deletes it on your instructions
points.text_zh: 本档无固定天数。①对象=输入/输出内容等『您的数据』:129852 §2.14『除法律法规、监管要求、第三方协议、产品规则、您与腾讯云另行约定或为提供本服务所必需的情形外，腾讯云将仅在为提供本服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的数据』,期满停止不必要的数据使用行为,或按指示返还/删除

points.text: Where the law does not permit deletion or deletion is technically difficult to achieve, this degrades to "ceasing all processing other than storage, keeping records, performing statutory obligations and taking necessary security protection measures". (2) Object = personal information: the tier privacy policy §2.1, "we generally retain your personal information only for the shortest time necessary to achieve the purpose" (the same wording as platform tier 91d5fd §2.1 and enterprise tier 5429d0 §2.1). (3) Exception (a floor, not a cap): §2.9, "Tencent Cloud will retain logs such as information about the party served for no less than six months as required by law", applies only to the explicit/implicit labelling scenario for generated synthetic content (the statutory retention of logs such as information about the party served), and cannot be read in reverse as "all content is deleted after six months"
points.text_zh: 法律不允许删除或技术难以实现时,降级为『停止除存储、留存记录、履行法定义务和必要安全保护措施之外的处理』。②对象=个人信息:档位隐私政策 §2.1『仅在为实现目的所必需的最短时间内保留您的个人信息』(与平台档 91d5fd §2.1、企业档 5429d0 §2.1 同口径)。③例外(下限而非上限):§2.9『腾讯云将依法留存提供对象信息等相关日志不少于六个月』仅适用生成合成内容显式/隐式标识场景(提供对象信息等日志的法定留存),不能反推『六个月后删除全部内容』

points.text: §2.12(1) permits processing of input, output and logs within a reasonably necessary scope in the first-party and self-deployed model scenarios, for purposes such as inference, content safety review, service operations, troubleshooting, compliance auditing and billing settlement. (4) In the third-party-deployed model scenario, retention may be governed by the third party's own agreement (last sentence of §2.14, and §3.5)
points.text_zh: §2.12(1) 允许在自有/自部署模型场景为推理、内容安全审核、服务运维、故障排查、合规审计、计费结算等目的在合理必要范围内处理输入输出与日志。④第三方部署模型场景的留存可能适用第三方协议(§2.14 末句、§3.5)
