zdr.quote: Zero data retention (ZDR) is available for Pro and Enterprise users on AI Gateway.

points.text: 结论：部署平台档没有零保留——ZDR 在 Vercel 是 AI Gateway 的档内功能。(a) 范围界定：官方唯一的 ZDR 文档 /docs/ai-gateway/security-and-compliance/zdr 开篇即写「Zero data retention (ZDR) is available for Pro and Enterprise users on AI Gateway.」，限定语是 on AI Gateway
points.text_zh: 结论：部署平台档没有零保留——ZDR 在 Vercel 是 AI Gateway 的档内功能。(a) 范围界定：官方唯一的 ZDR 文档 /docs/ai-gateway/security-and-compliance/zdr 开篇即写「Zero data retention (ZDR) is available for Pro and Enterprise users on AI Gateway.」，限定语是 on AI Gateway

points.text: 整页讲的都是网关把请求转给上游模型时的保留策略（上游例外、缓存发生在上游一侧、被判滥用或安全审查的请求按上游政策保留），没有一句把这套机制延伸到部署平台上的构建产物、函数执行或可观测数据。(b) 平台档的实际口径与零保留相反：DPA §12.1「Termination or expiration of the Agreement serves as instruction for Vercel to delete all Customer Data within a commercially reasonable timeframe.」——删除的触发点是协议终止，即客户数据在合同存续期间持续保留
points.text_zh: 整页讲的都是网关把请求转给上游模型时的保留策略（上游例外、缓存发生在上游一侧、被判滥用或安全审查的请求按上游政策保留），没有一句把这套机制延伸到部署平台上的构建产物、函数执行或可观测数据。(b) 平台档的实际口径与零保留相反：DPA §12.1「Termination or expiration of the Agreement serves as instruction for Vercel to delete all Customer Data within a commercially reasonable timeframe.」——删除的触发点是协议终止，即客户数据在合同存续期间持续保留

points.text: §12.2 另允许法律要求时继续保留。可观测数据另有固定窗口（界面保留期 Hobby 12 小时 / Pro 1 天 / Enterprise 3 天，Observability Plus 30 天），Enterprise Terms §12.2 的 System Data（traffic data、logs、usage statistics）归 Vercel 所有且未设期限。(c) 为什么记 mark=no 而不是 not_found：这不是查不到，而是官方把 ZDR 的可用范围写死在网关档，同时平台档存在明示的持续保留条款，两件事都是正面事实。(d) 边界：这只说明平台档没有公开的零保留方案与申请入口，不等于 Enterprise 合同谈不出单独安排——Enterprise Terms 与 DPA 的可协商条款不公开。(e) 本轮查过 /docs/ai-gateway/security-and-compliance/zdr、/legal/dpa、/legal/terms、/legal/enterprise-terms、/legal/ai-product-terms 与 security.vercel.com，除网关页外没有第二处出现 zero data retention。

points.text_zh: 协议未使用 controller/processor 术语,但 §2.1/2.2 的授权目的为火山引擎自身的机器学习与模型优化开发(非按客户指示处理),§2.4/2.5 由客户保证数据权利与个人信息授权,§5.3 数据授权事宜优先适用本协议——即火山引擎就授权数据为自主决定处理目的的一方,与按量 API 档 §3.7.7 的委托处理框架相反

volcengine.entity: 北京火山引擎科技有限公司

training.quote: 未经您的单独同意，火山引擎不会存储和使用您的数据来训练或优化模型

points.text: §3.7.7 by default: "without your separate consent, Volcengine will not store or use your data to train or optimize models"
points.text_zh: §3.7.7 默认『未经单独同意不存储不使用』训练/优化

points.text: The separate-consent cases are the collaboration reward program (opt-in, through an authorized access point) and Doubao Model Service Agreement §4.1.1/4.1.2 (effective 2026-09-23)
points.text_zh: 单独同意情形=协作奖励计划(opt-in,经授权接入点)与(2026-09-23 起生效的)豆包模型服务协议 §4.1.1/4.1.2

zdr.quote: 未经您的单独同意，火山引擎不会存储和使用您的数据来训练或优化模型

points.text: Not stored and not used by default, with storage confined to four listed scenarios (compliance review, troubleshooting, anomaly alerting, aggregate statistics); under §3.7.11 storage for features requires authorization, and "without your authorization, Volcengine will not access or use your data"
points.text_zh: 默认不存储不使用,存储仅限四类列明场景(合规审查/排障/异常告警/聚合统计),§3.7.11 功能存储须经授权、未授权不访问

points.text: Functional zero retention is achievable (store=false, and the cache can be deleted). The "zero data retention" commitment in the white paper sits inside an image and cannot be machine-verified, so confidence=medium
points.text_zh: 功能性零保留可行(store=false、缓存可删)。白皮书『数据零留存』承诺正文在图片里不可机器复核,故 confidence=medium

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: 存储时长：默认存储 3 天，可通过 expire_at 字段自定义设置，最长支持 7 天。

points.text: Responses API store defaults to true → stored for 3 days by default, customizable via expire_at up to 7 days; input and output are stored, the chain of thought is not; store=false turns it off
points.text_zh: Responses API store 默认 true→默认存 3 天、expire_at 最长 7 天,存 input/output 不存思维链,store=false 可关

points.text: Context cache idle TTL 1 hour to 7 days (reset on each use)
points.text_zh: Context 缓存闲置 TTL 1 小时-7 天(每次使用重置)

points.text: 15 days after service termination (Products and Services Agreement §12.8)
points.text_zh: 服务终止后 15 天(产品协议 §12.8)

points.text: General terms §6.6: "delete your customer data or anonymize it within a reasonable period after providing the service"
points.text_zh: 通用条款 §6.6『提供服务后的合理期限内删除或匿名化』

points.text: For the troubleshooting scenario it is "within a reasonable time", with no fixed period
points.text_zh: 排障场景为『合理时间内』无固定期限

points.text: Page 36 of the official security white paper (its existence is confirmable on the developer resources page; downloading the PDF requires being signed in), "data related to the Ark platform is stored only in mainland China", is a known disclosure, but the online doc page body is an image and r.jina.ai captures only the navigation shell, so it cannot be machine-verified
points.text_zh: 官方安全白皮书(developer 资源页可确认存在,PDF 下载需登录态)第 36 页『方舟平台相关数据仅存储于中国大陆』是已知披露,但线上文档页正文为图片、r.jina.ai 只抓到导航壳,不可机器复核

points.text: The object of the privacy policy's in-China storage clause is only "users' personal information"
points.text_zh: 隐私政策境内存储条款对象仅为『用户个人信息』

points.text: The "authorization to use this service only within mainland China" in Special Terms §3.1 and Subscription Terms §2.2 is a use licence, not a storage location, and nothing is inferred from it
points.text_zh: 专用条款 §3.1/订阅条款 §2.2 的『仅在中国大陆地区使用本服务的授权』是使用许可不是存储地,不据此推定

role.quote: 依据您的委托处理您的数据

points.text: Entrusted-processing wording: §3.7.7(2), in the troubleshooting scenario, "processes your data on your mandate", and aggregate statistics store and use no raw data
points.text_zh: 受托(委托)处理语义:§3.7.7(2) 排障场景『依据您的委托处理您的数据』、聚合统计不存储不使用任何原始数据

points.text: At the contract layer there is also Products and Services Agreement §1.3, "Volcengine is a neutral technology service provider", and §6.6, "will not use customer data at will except as necessary to provide the service or as authorized"
points.text_zh: 合同层另有产品和服务协议 §1.3『中立的技术服务提供者』与 §6.6『除提供服务所必须或经授权外不会对客户数据任意使用』

points.text: There is no standard DPA; the role is carried by the terms of service
points.text_zh: 无标准 DPA,角色载体为服务条款

training.quote: Customer grants W&B the right to use Customer Data to (i) provide and support the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), (ii) develop new product offerings, and (iii) improve the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), subject to any Customer configured settings, if applicable.

points.text: API tier (Serverless Inference): the contract grants a product-improvement license and never excludes model training, so under the house rule (a "service improvement / quality" grant counts as training) this is mark=no. Item by item: AI Terms §4 "Customer grants W&B the right to use Customer Data to (i) provide and support the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), (ii) develop new product offerings, and (iii) improve the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), subject to any Customer configured settings, if applicable."
points.text_zh: API 档（Serverless Inference）：合同层给的是「产品改进授权」，且全文没有把模型训练排除在外，按本仓口径（「改进服务/提高质量」类授权算训练）记 mark=no（会训练）。逐条依据：AI Terms §4「Customer grants W&B the right to use Customer Data to (i) provide and support the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), (ii) develop new product offerings, and (iii) improve the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), subject to any Customer configured settings, if applicable.」

points.text: The AI Terms expressly prevail over the MSA ("In the event of a conflict between the AI Terms and the Agreement, the AI Terms will control"). MSA §4(a) is a parallel platform-level grant ("provide and improve the W&B Assets / develop new product offerings / providing and improving AI Features"). Point of uncertainty about applicability: whether Serverless Inference falls within the "AI Features" as defined in the AI Terms (a definition covering "third-party or open source artificial intelligence technologies") is not stated by name in the public documentation
points.text_zh: AI Terms 明文优先于 MSA（「In the event of a conflict between the AI Terms and the Agreement, the AI Terms will control」）。MSA §4(a) 是并行的平台层授权（「provide and improve the W&B Assets / develop new product offerings / providing and improving AI Features」）。适用性不确定处：Serverless Inference 是否属于 AI Terms 定义的「AI Features」（该定义覆盖「third-party or open source artificial intelligence technologies」），公开文档未明确点名

points.text: If it does not, only MSA §4(a) applies and the conclusion points the same way. One further hard fact: MSA §2(e) "W&B may use Customer Data from free and academic customers for testing and development purposes" — data from Free and Academic customers may additionally be used for testing and development, a clause the paid tiers do not have. Upstream hop: AI Terms §1 states that Third-Party AI is not a W&B Asset and that its conduct is not governed by W&B
points.text_zh: 若不属，则只有 MSA §4(a) 适用，结论方向相同。另一条硬事实：MSA §2(e)「W&B may use Customer Data from free and academic customers for testing and development purposes」——Free 与 Academic 档客户的数据可另用于 testing and development，付费档无此条。上游跳：AI Terms §1 声明 Third-Party AI 不是 W&B Assets、其行为不受 W&B 约束

points.text: The subprocessor table on the Security page lists Anthropic/OpenAI as "Generative AI services" subprocessors, but whether those subprocessors sit on the open-source model inference path of Serverless Inference is not explained in the public documentation (the product page says inference "runs directly on CoreWeave infrastructure").
points.text_zh: Security 页子处理者表把 Anthropic/OpenAI 列为「Generative AI services」子处理者，但这些子处理者是否在 Serverless Inference 的开源模型推理链上，公开文档未说明（产品页称推理「runs directly on CoreWeave infrastructure」）。

points.text: None of this vendor's documents (MSA, AI Terms, DPA including Schedules 1-4 and the security annex, BAA, the Security page and Subprocessors table, the current privacy policy, the pricing page, the legal-home index, Support Policy, SLA, the inference / hosting / weave pages on docs.wandb.ai, and the site-wide llms.txt index), nor the TOS / DPA / Privacy / Trust Center of CoreWeave in the same group, contains a zero data retention (ZDR) commitment, switch or application method. The closest wording is deletion on request: DPA Annex II "deletes customer data within 30 days of a customer requesting deletion", the return or deletion in DPA §9, and deletion after termination under MSA §6(d) — all deletion-triggered, not zero retention by default, and not a ZDR tier that can be enabled. The single hit from the automated scan, "not retain, use or disclose any personal information..." (DPA Schedule 4, CCPA), is the boilerplate service-provider purpose limitation, which syntactically even allows retention in order to perform the contract, and cannot serve as ZDR evidence (the old record identified this and this round's re-check keeps it). Observations pointing the other way (not equivalent to the vendor not offering ZDR): (1) the inference prefix cache reuses the KV cache across requests on shared infrastructure by default, with only cache_salt available to isolate it
points.text_zh: 全部本家文档（MSA、AI Terms、DPA 含 Schedule 1-4 与安全附录、BAA、Security 页与 Subprocessors 表、现行隐私政策、定价页、legal-home 索引、Support Policy、SLA、docs.wandb.ai 的 inference / hosting / weave 页、llms.txt 全站索引）以及同集团 CoreWeave 的 TOS / DPA / Privacy / Trust Center，均无零保留（ZDR）承诺、开关或申请方式。最接近的表述是「应请求删除」：DPA Annex II「deletes customer data within 30 days of a customer requesting deletion」、DPA §9 的返还或删除、MSA §6(d) 终止后删除——都是删除触发型，不是默认零保留，也不是可开通的 ZDR 档。自动扫描唯一命中的「not retain, use or disclose any personal information...」（DPA Schedule 4 CCPA）是服务提供者用途限制模板句，句法上甚至允许为履约而保留，不能当 ZDR 证据（旧记录已识别此点，本轮复核维持）。反向观察（不等于厂商不提供 ZDR）：(1) 推理前缀缓存默认在共享基础设施上跨请求复用 KV cache，仅 cache_salt 可隔离

points.text: (2) LLM inputs and outputs logged in Weave are expressly counted towards "long term storage"
points.text_zh: (2) Weave 中记录的 LLM inputs/outputs 被明确计入「long term storage」

points.text: (3) The MSA / AI Terms grant W&B broad rights to use Customer Data to improve the products and the AI Features. Recorded as not_found under the rules: not disclosed in the public documents does not mean the vendor does not offer it. Unchecked: the gated portal trust.coreweave.com (a customer account is required) was not checked.
points.text_zh: (3) MSA/AI Terms 授予 W&B 使用 Customer Data 改进产品与 AI Features 的宽泛权利。按规则记 not_found：公开文档未披露 ≠ 厂商不提供。未核项：trust.coreweave.com 门禁门户（需客户账号）未核。

points.text: Object and context have to be written separately; MSA §9(c) "Input and Output are deemed to be Customer Data" must not be read straight off as "inference inputs and outputs are kept long term". (1) Inference inputs and outputs (prompt/response): the vendor discloses no retention period and makes no "deleted once processed" commitment
points.text_zh: 对象与语境必须分开写，别把 MSA §9(c)「Input and Output are deemed to be Customer Data」直接读成「推理输入输出被长期保存」。(1) 推理输入输出（prompt/response）：官方未披露任何保留期，也没有「处理完即删」承诺

points.text: All that can be cited is the classification — MSA §9(c) / AI Terms §2 treat Input and Output as Customer Data. (2) Personal Data (the part of Customer Data that is personal data): DPA Schedule 2 Annex I "The period for which the personal data will be retained... For the term of the Agreement", i.e. the life of the contract
points.text_zh: 能被引用的只有定性——MSA §9(c)/AI Terms §2 把 Input/Output 视为 Customer Data。(2) Personal Data（Customer Data 中构成个人数据的部分）：DPA Schedule 2 Annex I「The period for which the personal data will be retained... ‍For the term of the Agreement」，即合同存续期

points.text: Deleted or returned on termination or on the customer's written request (DPA §9)
points.text_zh: 终止或应客户书面请求时删除或返还（DPA §9）

points.text: DPA Annex II「Weights and Biases, LLC deletes customer data within 30 days of a customer requesting deletion」

MSA §6(d) deletion after termination, "W&B will initiate deletion within 30 days of receipt". (3) Backups: DPA Annex II "performs backups daily and retains them in accordance with a predefined schedule in the Backup Policy" — the Backup Policy itself is not public, so backup retention cannot be quantified. (4) Platform objects (run data / artifacts / logs): kept for 7 days after deletion and recoverable within that window (the Multi-tenant Cloud and Dedicated Cloud documentation and the Artifacts documentation all say the same), adjustable on Dedicated Cloud through GORILLA_DATA_RETENTION_PERIOD
points.text_zh: MSA §6(d) 终止后删除、「W&B will initiate deletion within 30 days of receipt」。(3) 备份：DPA Annex II「performs backups daily and retains them in accordance with a predefined schedule in the Backup Policy」——Backup Policy 本身不公开，故备份保留期无法量化。(4) 平台对象（run 数据 / artifacts / 日志）：删除后保留 7 天可恢复（Multi-tenant Cloud 与 Dedicated Cloud 文档、Artifacts 文档同口径），Dedicated Cloud 可用 GORILLA_DATA_RETENTION_PERIOD 调整

points.text: That is a post-deletion recovery window, not a retention period for request content. (5) Weave side: the pricing FAQ defines ingested bytes as including LLM inputs and outputs and counts them towards long term storage, but gives no number of days. Conclusion type: no quantified uniform period (unspecified), deletion-triggered plus retention for the term of the contract.
points.text_zh: 这是「删除后恢复窗口」，不是「请求内容保留期」。(5) Weave 侧：定价 FAQ 明确定义 ingested bytes 含 LLM inputs/outputs 且计入 long term storage，但未给天数。结论类型：无量化统一期限（unspecified），删除触发型 + 合同期保留。

processing_region.quote: W\&B Multi-tenant Cloud is a fully managed platform deployed in W\&B's Google Cloud account in [Google Cloud's North America regions

points.text: Terms level: Multi-tenant Cloud (the platform Serverless Inference sits on) is deployed in W&B's own Google Cloud account, in Google Cloud North America regions
points.text_zh: 条款层：Multi-tenant Cloud（含 Serverless Inference 所在平台）部署在 W&B 自己的 Google Cloud 账户、Google Cloud 北美区域

points.text: Artifact files are uploaded to a Google Cloud bucket
points.text_zh: artifact 文件上传到 Google Cloud bucket

points.text: Weave multi-tenant data sits in a shared ClickHouse Cloud cluster. The inference request itself has no separate regional disclosure: the docs say only that Inference is accessible from supported geographic locations (usage-limits §Geographic restrictions) and point to the geographic restrictions in the CoreWeave Terms of Use for detail — that section is in fact a statement about the availability of site content outside the United States, not a data residency rule or an eligibility list, so the pointer is broken (a documentation error on the same page). Subprocessor locations (Security page table): AWS/Azure/GCP/ClickHouse "United States or as chosen by Customer", Datadog/Hex United States, Anthropic/OpenAI "United States and other countries where X operates", Modal Labs the same. "As chosen by Customer" corresponds to the region choice on the dedicated cloud tier and is not an option on multi-tenant SaaS. By contrast: Dedicated Cloud supports multiple AWS/GCP/Azure regions (Europe and Asia-Pacific included)
points.text_zh: Weave 多租户档数据存在共享 ClickHouse Cloud 集群。推理请求本身没有独立的区域披露：docs 只写 Inference 仅可从受支持地理位置访问（usage-limits §Geographic restrictions），并把细节指向 CoreWeave Terms of Use 的 geographic restrictions——该节实际是「网站内容在美国境外可访问性」声明，不是数据驻留或资格清单，这条指路是坏的（同页文档错误）。子处理者所在地（Security 页表）：AWS/Azure/GCP/ClickHouse「United States or as chosen by Customer」、Datadog/Hex 美国、Anthropic/OpenAI「United States and other countries where X operates」、Modal Labs 同。「as chosen by Customer」对应专属云档的区域可选，不是多租户 SaaS 的可选项。对照：Dedicated Cloud 支持 AWS/GCP/Azure 多区域（含欧洲与亚太）

points.text: Self-Managed runs entirely in the customer's infrastructure. Unchecked: the siting of CoreWeave's own data centers (coreweave.com/trust claims the United States and Europe) is not a processing-location commitment for W&B SaaS and is recorded alongside only.
points.text_zh: Self-Managed 完全在客户基础设施。未核项：CoreWeave 自有数据中心选址（coreweave.com/trust 称美国与欧洲）不是 W&B SaaS 的处理地承诺，仅并列记录。

role.quote: Customer is the controller (or is acting on behalf of the controller) and Company is the processor.

points.text: Verbatim contract clause (the one the old record lacked): DPA §6 "Customer is the controller (or is acting on behalf of the controller) and Company is the processor"
points.text_zh: 合同层逐字条款（这是旧记录缺的）：DPA §6「Customer is the controller (or is acting on behalf of the controller) and Company is the processor」

points.text: DPA Schedule 2 Annex I「Role: Processor (or Subprocessor as the case may be)」

DPA §8(a): the customer authorizes W&B to appoint subprocessors, with the subprocessor list on the Subprocessor Site (= the subprocessor table at wandb.ai/site/security/). Supplementary side: (a) the current privacy policy (CoreWeave) designates itself controller for personal data outside the platform — "CoreWeave is the controller of personal data collected directly through the Sites or outside of Customer Data"
points.text_zh: DPA §8(a) 客户授权 W&B 指定子处理者，子处理者清单在 Subprocessor Site（= wandb.ai/site/security/ 的子处理者表）。补充面：(a) 现行隐私政策（CoreWeave）在平台外的个人数据上自认 controller——「CoreWeave is the controller of personal data collected directly through the Sites or outside of Customer Data」

points.text: For data the customer uploads, "you are the controller ... and CoreWeave is the processor". (b) In the BAA, W&B says of itself that "Business Associate generally cannot view Customer Data" (Dedicated Cloud BYOB tier only). (c) A support article acknowledges that W&B staff can access logged values with permission, and that isolation requires Self-Managed. Multi-hop: the Third-Party AI behind AI Features are subprocessors rather than W&B itself (Anthropic/OpenAI are listed as Generative AI services), their processing is governed by their own terms, and W&B's processor commitment does not automatically cover them.
points.text_zh: 对客户上传的数据则「you are the controller ... and CoreWeave is the processor」。(b) BAA 里 W&B 自述「Business Associate generally cannot view Customer Data」（仅 Dedicated Cloud BYOB 档）。(c) 支持文章承认 W&B 员工经许可可访问 logged values，隔离需 Self-Managed。多跳：AI Features 的 Third-Party AI 是子处理者而非 W&B 自身（Anthropic/OpenAI 列为 Generative AI services），其处理受各自条款约束，W&B 的 processor 承诺不自动覆盖它们。

training.quote: Customer grants W&B the right to use Customer Data to (i) provide and support the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), (ii) develop new product offerings, and (iii) improve the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), subject to any Customer configured settings, if applicable.

points.text: The same set of contract clauses as the SaaS tiers (AI Terms §4 + MSA §4(a)), which grant use of Customer Data to develop and improve the offerings without excluding model training, so mark=no. Dedicated Cloud is an isolated deployment, but the text granting use of Customer Data does not distinguish deployment tiers
points.text_zh: 与 SaaS 档同一组合同条款（AI Terms §4 + MSA §4(a)）：授权使用 Customer Data 做产品开发与改进、未排除模型训练，按口径记 mark=no（会训练）。Dedicated Cloud 是隔离部署，但 Customer Data 的使用授权文本未按部署档位区分

points.text: With BYOB (bring your own bucket) the file content sits in the customer's own bucket and W&B stores only metadata (Artifacts documentation: a reference-type artifact "only keeps track of the metadata associated with the files, not the files themselves").

points.text: Split by object: (a) Runs and history, non-artifact run files (media/config/log), artifacts and artifact references — kept for 7 days after deletion, recoverable within that window and purged afterwards (Multi-tenant Cloud documentation; the Artifacts documentation says the same). training.quote:
Unless separately authorized by Client through a voluntary feedback submission, IBM will not use 
the Client Content or model Outputs to train the foundation models or embedding models

points.text: API 档（SaaS）合同层结论：默认不用于训练，唯一开口是客户主动提交反馈。①服务描述 §5.1(a)：「Unless separately authorized by Client through a voluntary feedback submission, IBM will not use the Client Content or model Outputs to train the foundation models or embedding models.」（Multicloud 档 i127-9067 §5.1(a) 同文）。同节把「所有模型输入（含推理/提示、微调/提示调优内容）」界定为 Client Content，输出所有权归客户。②基础合同层：CRA §4a「such parties will access, use, provide, store, and otherwise process Content solely for the purpose of providing the Products」，CSA §2b 同旨。③文档层：SaaS 文档「IBM does not use the content that you upload to watsonx or the output that is generated by a foundation model to further train or improve any IBM-developed models.」需并列的例外与边界：(a) 自愿反馈提交（voluntary feedback submission）可授权使用，CSA 另写「IBM may use for any purpose」
points.text_zh: API 档（SaaS）合同层结论：默认不用于训练，唯一开口是客户主动提交反馈。①服务描述 §5.1(a)：「Unless separately authorized by Client through a voluntary feedback submission, IBM will not use the Client Content or model Outputs to train the foundation models or embedding models.」（Multicloud 档 i127-9067 §5.1(a) 同文）。同节把「所有模型输入（含推理/提示、微调/提示调优内容）」界定为 Client Content，输出所有权归客户。②基础合同层：CRA §4a「such parties will access, use, provide, store, and otherwise process Content solely for the purpose of providing the Products」，CSA §2b 同旨。③文档层：SaaS 文档「IBM does not use the content that you upload to watsonx or the output that is generated by a foundation model to further train or improve any IBM-developed models.」需并列的例外与边界：(a) 自愿反馈提交（voluntary feedback submission）可授权使用，CSA 另写「IBM may use for any purpose」

points.text: 但全套 IBM 材料里没有 ZDR 这个术语，也没有可申请的 ZDR 计划、开关或合同条款——它不是一项可签约的承诺。证据：SaaS 文档「Nothing that you add to the prompt editor or submit to a model from the Prompt Lab or by using the API is logged by IBM」「Text that you add to or submit in the Prompt Lab or API is not stored unless you save it.」

retention.quote: The duration of Processing Content within this Cloud Service is 30 days after termination or expiration of the Cloud Service.

points.text: API 档结论：在线推理的请求内容默认不落盘（文档层声明），服务侧数据以「服务终止后 30 天」为删除窗口，备份无量化期限。分对象记：①输入输出正文（在线推理）：文档声明「Nothing that you add to the prompt editor or submit to a model from the Prompt Lab or by using the API is logged by IBM」「Text that you add to or submit in the Prompt Lab or API is not stored unless you save it.」——属默认不记录/不存储，非合同量化期限。②用户主动保存的资产：SaaS 文档给 prompt session asset「retained for 30 days」（上限式、文档层），prompt template/notebook asset「retained until they are deleted or changed by you」（客户控制，无期限）。③服务终止后 Content：Data Sheet（DPA Exhibit）§3「The duration of Processing Content within this Cloud Service is 30 days after termination or expiration of the Cloud Service.」+ §5「IBM hereby certifies that all Client Personal Data are deleted at the end of the retention period specified in section 3」——这是合同层、可执行的删除窗口（Runtime/Studio/Multicloud 三份 Data Sheet 同值 30 天）。④服务侧 PII（账户/凭据/资产元数据）：文档层「personally identifiable information and data is removed completely from all data sources, including backups, after 30 days」。⑤备份：CRA §4e / CSA §2f「IBM does not archive Content; however, some Content may remain in backup files until expiration of such files as governed by IBM's backup retention practices」——备份保留期未量化，是唯一的开口。⑥计量数据：文档另声明按账户度量模型用量（billing/infrastructure planning/model lifecycle management），与内容保留是两件事。未发现任何请求级（0 天）的合同保留期承诺。

points.text: 境外档结论：**欧洲（荷兰）与新加坡**。合同层原句：境外版服务协议 §4.4「When providing services outside the Chinese Mainland, Xiaomi will store the relevant data on servers located in Europe and Singapore.」（中文版：「在中国大陆以外提供服务时，小米会将相关数据存储在位于欧洲和新加坡的服务器上」）。隐私层同向：境外版隐私条款 §10「目前，小米在荷兰和新加坡设有数据中心」，§9 把 EEA/UK/CH 归荷兰 B.V.、其他地区归新加坡公司。不确定性（重要）：§10 紧接着写「我们还可能将您的个人信息传输给第三方服务提供商和业务合作伙伴，因此您的数据也可能被传输到其他国家或地区」，即「欧洲+新加坡」是**数据中心位置**的披露，不是「数据只留在这些国家」的承诺
points.text_zh: 境外档结论：**欧洲（荷兰）与新加坡**。合同层原句：境外版服务协议 §4.4「When providing services outside the Chinese Mainland, Xiaomi will store the relevant data on servers located in Europe and Singapore.」（中文版：「在中国大陆以外提供服务时，小米会将相关数据存储在位于欧洲和新加坡的服务器上」）。隐私层同向：境外版隐私条款 §10「目前，小米在荷兰和新加坡设有数据中心」，§9 把 EEA/UK/CH 归荷兰 B.V.、其他地区归新加坡公司。不确定性（重要）：§10 紧接着写「我们还可能将您的个人信息传输给第三方服务提供商和业务合作伙伴，因此您的数据也可能被传输到其他国家或地区」，即「欧洲+新加坡」是**数据中心位置**的披露，不是「数据只留在这些国家」的承诺

points.text: §10 另有「小米通过全球运营和控制基础设施处理并备份个人信息」，备份范围未限定。另：§1.1 允许用户联系平台选择数据存储区域（可能产生额外费用），但未披露可选区域清单。

points.text: 境外档结论：**处理者（Processor）**，有合同层原文。原句：境外版服务协议 §4.1「Xiaomi acts as a Processor in data processing activities, and you are the Data Controller. The data you upload, store, process, download, distribute, or otherwise handle through our services constitutes your business data, over which you retain full control.」中文版：「小米在数据处理活动中作为处理者，您是数据控制者。」§4 开篇同时限定「These Data Protection Terms apply to regions outside the Chinese Mainland.」隐私层佐证：境外版隐私条款 §3.1「您授权 Xiaomi MiMo 受托处理您上传的信息以提供该服务，且 Xiaomi MiMo 无需从任何其他方获得任何额外的授权。」并列的反向面：(a) 境外版协议 §3.1「Xiaomi MiMo is only a neutral technical service provider」（中立技术服务提供者）——责任限制口径，与 §4.1 并存

The data you upload, store, process, download, distribute, or otherwise handle through our services constitutes your business data, over which you retain full control.」中文版：「小米在数据处理活动中作为处理者，您是数据控制者。」§4 开篇同时限定「These Data Protection Terms apply to regions outside the Chinese Mainland.」隐私层佐证：境外版隐私条款 §3.1「您授权 Xiaomi MiMo 受托处理您上传的信息以提供该服务，且 Xiaomi MiMo 无需从任何其他方获得任何额外的授权。」并列的反向面：(a) 境外版协议 §3.1「Xiaomi MiMo is only a neutral technical service provider」（中立技术服务提供者）——责任限制口径，与 §4.1 并存

points.text: (b) 隐私条款 §9 写明 EEA/UK/CH 场景下 Xiaomi Technology Netherlands B.V. **担任数据控制者**——即小米在部分法域对部分个人信息是控制者，§4.1 的 Processor 自认覆盖的是「你通过服务上传处理的业务数据」这一范围
points.text_zh: (b) 隐私条款 §9 写明 EEA/UK/CH 场景下 Xiaomi Technology Netherlands B.V. **担任数据控制者**——即小米在部分法域对部分个人信息是控制者，§4.1 的 Processor 自认覆盖的是「你通过服务上传处理的业务数据」这一范围

points.text: (c) 隐私条款 §4 披露向 Waffo Hong Kong Limited（充值与退款）、谷歌（在线搜索，会收到「查询内容和 IP 地址」）提供信息——启用联网搜索时输入内容会流出到第三方，属多跳，本轮只记事实、不推断该跳的保留与训练政策。不确定性：§4.1 的「you are the Data Controller」把 PDPA/GDPR 下的控制者义务整体推给客户，对终端用户而言小米的对外定性仍是控制者一侧，本维度按**协议内部的数据处理关系**记 processor。
points.text_zh: (c) 隐私条款 §4 披露向 Waffo Hong Kong Limited（充值与退款）、谷歌（在线搜索，会收到「查询内容和 IP 地址」）提供信息——启用联网搜索时输入内容会流出到第三方，属多跳，本轮只记事实、不推断该跳的保留与训练政策。不确定性：§4.1 的「you are the Data Controller」把 PDPA/GDPR 下的控制者义务整体推给客户，对终端用户而言小米的对外定性仍是控制者一侧，本维度按**协议内部的数据处理关系**记 processor。

xiaomi-token-plan-ams.entity: Xiaomi Technology Netherlands B.V., Xiaomi Technologies Singapore Pte. Ltd. and its affiliates

training.quote: Xiaomi will not use the content you provide for model training or any other purposes.

points.text: Same as top-level training: on the overseas tier, "Xiaomi will not use the content you provide for model training or any other purposes", unconditionally (§3.1)
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training：海外档无条件不用于训练（§3.1）

points.text: The only purpose-widening opening is the non-personally identifiable information in §3.3 (once aggregated, it may be used to improve the service).
points.text_zh: 唯一用途扩张口子是 §3.3 的非个人身份识别信息（聚合后可用于改进服务）。

zdr.quote: we may not be able to immediately remove the information from the backup system

points.text: Same as top-level zdr: the official documentation carries no zero-retention commitment and no way to apply for one, and the overseas site publishes no DPA
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr：官方文档无零保留承诺或申请方式，海外站无公开 DPA

points.text: "Not found" must not be written up as "the vendor does not offer it".
points.text_zh: 不得把「查不到」写成「厂商不提供」。

retention.quote: we retain personal information for the period necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, or as required by applicable law

points.text: Same as top-level retention: retained "for the period necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy" (not quantified), plus cessation of processing or permanent deletion "within a reasonable period" after service termination or a user request (Service Agreement §4.4), plus delayed deletion from the backup system
points.text_zh: 同顶层 retention：目的所需期限（未量化）+ 服务终止/用户请求后「合理期限」内删除（服务协议 §4.4）+ 备份延迟删除

points.text: KV cache and access logs are not disclosed
points.text_zh: KV 缓存、访问日志未披露

points.text: No request-level retention period is committed.
points.text_zh: 无请求级期限承诺。

processing_region.quote: The personal information we collect and generate in operations will be stored in data centres located in the Netherlands.

points.text: Same as top-level processing_region: data of EEA/UK/Switzerland residents is stored in data centres located in the Netherlands, and data of non-EEA residents in Singapore
points.text_zh: 同顶层 processing_region：EEA/UK/CH 居民数据存储于荷兰数据中心、非 EEA 居民存储于新加坡

points.text: At the contract layer: "When providing services outside the Chinese Mainland, Xiaomi will store the relevant data on servers located in Europe and Singapore."
points.text_zh: 合同层承诺「中国大陆以外 → 欧洲和新加坡服务器」

points.text: No official statement binds the cluster endpoint (ams) to a storage location.
points.text_zh: 集群 endpoint（ams）与存储地之间没有官方明示的绑定关系。

role.quote: Xiaomi acts as a Processor in data processing activities, and you are the Data Controller.

points.text: Same as top-level role: at the contract layer the structure is an entrusted one, "Xiaomi acts as a Processor in data processing activities, and you are the Data Controller" (Service Agreement §4.1), while the privacy policy identifies Xiaomi as controller in the EEA consumer context; both layers are recorded side by side.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role：合同层为 processor/controller 委托结构（服务协议 §4.1），隐私政策在 EEA 消费者语境下自认 controller，两层并列。

xiaomi-token-plan-cn.entity: 北京小米移动软件有限公司

training.quote: 未经您的事先同意，小米不会将您提供的文本内容用于模型训练或者其他用途。

points.text: This tier has no dedicated data clauses (see the directory enumeration in scope_note), so the platform's general policies apply and it shares the source and conclusion of the top-level training entry. Authoritative sentence: the Xiaomi MiMo Privacy Policy (Chinese page on privacy.mi.com, entity Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.), Section 1(1)2 "API services" — "Without your prior consent, Xiaomi will not use the text content you provide for model training or for any other purpose." No training by default, but the commitment is conditioned on "prior consent", and its object is written as "text content", not every input type. The contrary side that must be recorded alongside: (a) the overseas privacy policy on the documentation site is unconditional — "Xiaomi will not use the content you provide for model training or any other purpose" — stronger than the domestic version, but the overseas tier limits itself to outside mainland China and does not apply here, so the cn tier is governed by the weaker one
points.text_zh: 本档无专用数据条款（依据见 scope_note 的目录枚举），适用平台通用政策，故与顶层 training 同源同结论。权威句：《Xiaomi MiMo 隐私政策》（privacy.mi.com 中文页，主体北京小米移动软件有限公司）一（一）2「API服务」一节——「未经您的事先同意，小米不会将您提供的文本内容用于模型训练或者其他用途。」默认不训练，但承诺带「事先同意」前提，且对象写的是「文本内容」，不是全部输入类型。必须并列的相反面向：(a) 文档站境外版隐私政策是无条件句「小米不会将您提供的内容用于模型训练或任何其他目的」，比境内版更强，但境外档自限适用于中国大陆以外，本档不适用，即 cn 档适用的是较弱的那一份

points.text: (b) The desktop privacy policy (mimo.xiaomi.com/legal/privacy-policy-zh.html) separately says "after strict de-identification ... we will use the content you input (text, image, video and audio information) and the model output content data for analysis and model optimization", together with a Settings - General - Privacy - Experience Improvement Program switch; it states that it covers the desktop client and is not a basis for this tier, but it shows that "Xiaomi never uses inputs for training in China" cannot be treated as a conclusion across product lines
points.text_zh: (b) 桌面版隐私政策（mimo.xiaomi.com/legal/privacy-policy-zh.html）另有「经严格去标识化…我们将使用您输入的内容（文本、图片、视频、音频信息）及模型输出内容数据进行分析和模型优化」与【设置-常规-隐私-体验优化计划】开关，自称覆盖桌面版，不作为本档依据，但证明不能把「小米境内一律不拿输入去训练」当作跨产品线结论

points.text: (c) The word "training" does not appear anywhere in the domestic service agreement, which neither authorizes nor prohibits it. Uncertainty: "Token Plan is governed by the Open Platform privacy policy" is inferred from product attribution (the platform.xiaomimimo.com console plus the tp- prefixed API key), not stated directly in the terms
points.text_zh: (c) 境内服务协议全文未出现「训练」二字，既未授权也未禁止。不确定性：「Token Plan 适用开放平台隐私政策」是按产品归属（platform.xiaomimimo.com 控制台 + tp- 前缀 API Key）作的推断，不是条款原文的直接规定

points.text: How "prior consent" is obtained, whether it can be withdrawn, and whether a switch exists are all undisclosed. The searched[] list on the top-level training entry records every URL checked in this round.
points.text_zh: 「事先同意」以什么形式取得、能否撤回、有无开关，均无公开说明。顶层 training 的 searched[] 列出了本轮查过的全部 URL。

zdr.quote: 因为适用的法律和安全技术，我们可能无法立即从备份系统中删除相应的信息

points.text: This tier has no dedicated data clauses; the platform's general policies apply, sharing the source and conclusion of the top-level zdr entry: zero retention is not supported. The whole chain of evidence sits in the same domestic privacy policy, which identifies the object itself: (1) Object — Section 1(1)2 lists "the text, image, video and audio information you provide", collected "in order to provide the Xiaomi MiMo API and Xiaomi MiMo Code services", as personal information
points.text_zh: 本档无专用数据条款，适用平台通用政策，与顶层 zdr 同源同结论：不支持零保留。依据链全部落在同一份境内隐私政策，对象由该政策自证：(1) 对象——一（一）2 把「为了提供 Xiaomi MiMo API 及 Xiaomi MiMo Code 服务」收集的「您提供的文本、图片、视频、音频信息」列为个人信息

points.text: (2) Storage — Section 3(1): "All of your personal information is stored on secure servers and protected in controlled facilities." That states expressly that request input content is stored on their servers
points.text_zh: (2) 存储——三（一）「您的个人信息全都被储存在安全的服务器上，并在受控设施中受到保护。」即明示请求输入内容会被存储在其服务器上

points.text: (3) Period — Section 3(3) retains information for the period necessary for the purpose, an unquantified retention rule rather than "discarded once processing completes"
points.text_zh: (3) 期限——三（三）按目的必需期间保留，是未量化的保留规则，不是「处理完成即弃」

points.text: (4) Retention after deletion — Section 4(2): "Because of applicable law and security technology, we may not be able to delete the corresponding information from backup systems immediately; we will store your personal information securely and isolate it from any further processing until the backup can be cleared or anonymized." That is directly incompatible with "nothing retained once processing completes", and is the anchor for this dimension. So this tier is not "undisclosed" but has express storage and retention provisions. Five kinds of entry point were checked (content license clauses, API data-processing sections, logging and caching documentation, DPA, FAQ) and none contains a ZDR / zero-retention / no-persistence / discard-after-processing commitment, switch or application path
points.text_zh: (4) 删除后仍留存——四（二）「因为适用的法律和安全技术，我们可能无法立即从备份系统中删除相应的信息，我们将安全地存储您的个人信息并将其与任何进一步处理隔离，直到备份可以清除或实现匿名。」与「处理完即不保留」直接相斥，本条为本维度锚点。因此本档不是「未披露」，而是有明示的存储与保留依据。已核五类入口（内容授权条款、API 数据处理章节、日志与缓存说明、DPA、FAQ）均无 ZDR / 零保留 / 不落盘 / 处理完即弃的承诺、开关或申请入口

points.text: There is no data processing agreement for API customers on the official domains. Boundary: this finding says the default tier has express storage and retention provisions, not that Xiaomi refuses to sign a zero-retention arrangement — whether ZDR can be negotiated in an enterprise contract is not answered by the public texts. The searched[] list on the top-level zdr entry records the 28 URLs checked in this round.
points.text_zh: 官方域名上没有面向 API 客户的数据处理协议。边界：本判定说的是默认档有明示的存储与保留依据，不等于小米拒绝签署零保留安排——企业合同能否谈 ZDR，公开文本无答案。顶层 zdr 的 searched[] 列出了本轮查过的 28 个 URL。

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: 我们基于本隐私政策中所述的信息收集的目的所必需的期间，或者遵守适用的相关法律要求保留个人信息。

points.text: This tier has no dedicated data clauses; the platform's general policies apply, sharing the source and conclusion of the top-level retention entry: no quantified retention period at all, only a principle-level "necessary for the purpose + required by law" statement, which does not separate input/output content, cache and access logs. (1) Object — Xiaomi MiMo Privacy Policy Section 1(1)2 lists "the text, image, video and audio information you provide", collected "in order to provide the Xiaomi MiMo API and Xiaomi MiMo Code services", as personal information, so API request inputs fall within the scope of the retention rules, not just account data. (2) Period — the retention policy in Section 3(3): "We retain personal information for the period necessary for the purposes of collection described in this privacy policy, or to comply with applicable legal requirements. Once the purpose of collection has been achieved, or after we confirm your deletion or account cancellation request, or after we discontinue the relevant product or service, we will stop retaining it and will delete or anonymize it." — a ceiling-style statement (retention stops once the purpose is fulfilled), with no number of days. (3) Exceptions — the same paragraph allows continued retention for public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes
points.text_zh: 本档无专用数据条款，适用平台通用政策，与顶层 retention 同源同结论：没有任何量化保留期限，只有「目的必需 + 法律要求」的原则性表述，且区分不出输入输出正文、缓存与访问日志。(1) 对象——《Xiaomi MiMo 隐私政策》一（一）2 把「为了提供 Xiaomi MiMo API 及 Xiaomi MiMo Code 服务」而收集的「您提供的文本、图片、视频、音频信息」列为个人信息，故 API 请求的输入内容落在保留规则的对象范围内，不是只有账号资料。(2) 期限——三（三）保留政策「我们基于本隐私政策中所述的信息收集的目的所必需的期间，或者遵守适用的相关法律要求保留个人信息。个人信息在完成收集目的，或在我们确认您的删除或注销申请后，或我们终止运营相应产品或服务后，我们将停止保留，并做删除或匿名化处理。」——上限式表述（目的完成即停），没有天数。(3) 例外——同段的公众利益/科学/历史研究/统计目的可继续保留

points.text: Section 4(2) acknowledges the backup delay on deletion: "we may not be able to delete the corresponding information from backup systems immediately ... until the backup can be cleared or anonymized". (4) Higher-level supplement — the Xiaomi Privacy Policy §4.4 says "for specific retention periods, see the particular service or the relevant product page", yet a page-by-page grep of the four kinds of Token Plan product page (subscription description, integration guide, pricing page, FAQ) for "retain / retention / data" returned zero hits this round, i.e. the product pages do not pick up that pointer. (5) What is absent — none of the official documents captured for the cn tier contains a Cybersecurity Law style floor such as "network logs kept for no less than six months", so no minimum can be inferred
points.text_zh: 四（二）承认删除的备份延迟「我们可能无法立即从备份系统中删除相应的信息……直到备份可以清除或实现匿名」。(4) 上位补充——《小米隐私政策》4.4 自认「具体保留时长可参见特定服务或相关产品页面」，而 Token Plan 的订阅说明、接入指引、定价页与 FAQ 四类产品页本轮逐页 grep「保留/留存/数据」零命中，即产品页并没有承接这句指引。(5) 未出现的东西——cn 档所有已抓官方文件里都没有「网络日志不少于六个月」这类《网络安全法》式下限条款，不能反推下限

points.text: The cache hit/miss on the pricing page is a billing concept; no TTL or eviction rule for Prompt Cache entries is disclosed. (6) Not interchangeable — the overseas service agreement §4.4 ("processing stops or data is permanently deleted when the service expires, the purpose is achieved, or you so request") limits itself to outside mainland China and cannot serve as a basis for this tier.
points.text_zh: 定价页出现的 cache hit/miss 是计费口径，官方未披露 Prompt Cache 条目的 TTL 或清除规则。(6) 不可混用——境外版服务协议 §4.4 的「服务到期、目的达成或您要求时停止处理或永久删除」自限适用于中国大陆以外，不能当本档依据。

processing_region.quote: 本协议适用于您在中华人民共和国境内使用Xiaomi MiMo服务，为此您的信息将会保存至中华人民共和国境内。

points.text: This tier has no dedicated data clauses; the platform's general policies apply, sharing the source and conclusion of the top-level processing_region entry: within China. (a) Xiaomi MiMo Privacy Policy, final paragraph of Section 3(3): "This agreement applies to your use of Xiaomi MiMo services within the People's Republic of China, and your information will accordingly be stored within the People's Republic of China. If you use the services outside the People's Republic of China, you acknowledge and agree that the parties will apply the privacy policy terms published on the Xiaomi MiMo open platform for services outside the People's Republic of China." — the vendor itself splits domestic and overseas policies, and this tier is the domestic one. (b) Xiaomi Privacy Policy: "Personal information collected and generated in the course of operations within mainland China is stored in data centers in mainland China, except where cross-border transfer is permitted under applicable law." (c) Integration side: the Token Plan subscription documentation gives three cluster endpoints, the China cluster being https://token-plan-cn.xiaomimimo.com/v1. (d) The contrary side that must be recorded alongside (all overseas-tier, not interchangeable): service agreement §4.4 on the documentation site states that data for overseas services is stored in Europe and Singapore, and §4 limits itself to outside mainland China
points.text_zh: 本档无专用数据条款，适用平台通用政策，与顶层 processing_region 同源同结论：境内。(a)《Xiaomi MiMo 隐私政策》三（三）末段「本协议适用于您在中华人民共和国境内使用Xiaomi MiMo服务，为此您的信息将会保存至中华人民共和国境内。如果您在中华人民共和国境外使用服务，则您知悉并同意双方将适用发布在Xiaomi MiMo开放平台上适用于中华人民共和国境外服务的相关隐私政策条款。」——官方用境内/境外两套政策划分，本档属境内档。(b)《小米隐私政策》「我们将在中华人民共和国大陆境内运营中收集和产生的个人信息，均在中国大陆地区的数据中心存储，但根据适用法律的规定允许跨境传输的除外。」(c) 接入侧：Token Plan 订阅说明给出三集群入口，中国集群为 https://token-plan-cn.xiaomimimo.com/v1。(d) 必须并列的相反面向（都是境外档，不能混用）：文档站服务协议 §4.4 写境外服务的数据存于欧洲和新加坡，且 §4 自限只覆盖中国大陆以外

points.text: The entities there are Xiaomi Technology (Netherlands) B.V. and Xiaomi Technology (Singapore) Pte. Ltd., under different governing law. (e) Uncertainty: the three-cluster description appears only in the integration configuration of the product documentation; no clause explains whether inference and storage for the "China cluster" both take place in mainland China
points.text_zh: 主体是小米科技（荷兰）B.V. 与小米技术（新加坡）私人有限公司，适用法也不同。(e) 不确定性：三集群说明只出现在产品文档的接入配置里，没有任何条款解释「中国集群」的推理与存储是否都在中国大陆

points.text: The cross-border exception in the Xiaomi Privacy Policy ("except where cross-border transfer is permitted under applicable law") leaves an opening for transfers abroad, with no scenarios disclosed. The domestic Xiaomi MiMo Open Platform Service Agreement §4.4 hosted by a third party (market.aliyun.com) is firmer ("such information will not be transferred outside the territory"), but under the rules it cannot be used as primary evidence.
points.text_zh: 《小米隐私政策》的跨境例外（「根据适用法律的规定允许跨境传输的除外」）为出境留了口子，未披露具体场景。第三方托管（market.aliyun.com）的境内版《Xiaomi MiMo开放平台服务协议》4.4 写得更硬（「不会将此类信息传输至境外」），按规则不能当主证据。

role.quote: Xiaomi MiMo 仅作为中立的技术服务提供者

points.text: This tier has no dedicated data clauses; the platform's general policies apply, sharing the source and conclusion of the top-level role entry: leaning to entrusted processor, but with far weaker support in the public terms than the overseas tier, confidence low. (a) The only service agreement written for the domestic setting on an official domain (mimo.xiaomi.com/legal/service-agreement-zh.html, entity Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.) says only, in §3.4, that "Xiaomi MiMo acts solely as a neutral technical service provider, providing you with technical products and services as agreed"
points.text_zh: 本档无专用数据条款，适用平台通用政策，与顶层 role 同源同结论：倾向受托处理方（processor），但公开条款的支撑比境外档弱得多，置信度 low。(a) 官方域名上唯一按境内口径写的服务协议（mimo.xiaomi.com/legal/service-agreement-zh.html，主体北京小米移动软件有限公司）§3.4 只写「Xiaomi MiMo 仅作为中立的技术服务提供者，依约向您提供各类技术产品和服务」

points.text: Section 5 "Data protection clauses" is a single sentence — "Xiaomi will collect, use and process your personal information in accordance with the Xiaomi MiMo Privacy Policy" — with no role-definition table and no statement that "Xiaomi is the entrusted party / processor". (b) The sentence in the domestic privacy policy closest to a processor self-designation comes from the voice-cloning section: "You authorize Xiaomi MiMo to carry out entrusted processing based on the information you upload in order to provide the service; Xiaomi MiMo needs no further authorization" — but it covers only that scenario and is not a general role provision for the API / Token Plan. (c) By comparison: both overseas service agreements state plainly "Xiaomi acts as a Processor ... you are the Data Controller" / "Xiaomi acts as processor in data processing activities and you are the data controller", but limit themselves to outside mainland China. (d) Key gap: the Xiaomi MiMo Open Platform Service Agreement hosted on Alibaba Cloud Marketplace states in §4.1 that "in data processing activities Xiaomi is the entrusted party for personal information processing and you are the personal information handler", and covers mainland China — exactly the sentence the cn tier lacks, but the hosting domain is third-party, so under the repository rules it counts only as a lead

points.text: 个人档（Lite/Pro/Max）没有『不训练』承诺。ToU §IV.3(a) 对 individual users 明文『we reserve the right to process any User Content to improve our existing Services and/or to develop new products and services』，并授权把非个人数据的 User Content 用于开发改进 ML/AI 技术

points.text: §IV.5 再授予 unconditional/irrevocable/perpetual/worldwide 许可。§IV.7 与 Additional Terms §3(b) 的『We will not use End User Content to develop or improve Services』只写给『enterprises and developers using API Services』，而本档被 subscription-terms §4.3 定义为仅授权自然人的个人订阅。隐私政策 §3 的『train and improve our models』一行只把 Account/Communication/Log/Usage/Device/Cookies 列为处理对象，未列 User Content，与 ToU §IV.3(a) 的授权不一致——两文并存时合同层（ToU）优先，故按 ToU 判。ZCode（官方支持工具第一名）的隐私政策反其道：训练 opt-in 且默认关闭，说明 Z.AI 生态内不同产品口径不同，不能互推。

points.text: 个人档既无 ZDR 产品能力也无 ZDR 承诺：隐私政策 §7 明示 input 随账户保留，ToU §IV.3(a)(i) 明文授权『utilization and storage of User Content that does not constitute personal data』，§IV.5 还授予永久存储许可。厂商公开文档（含 llms.txt 全量索引、WebSearch 中英文）里不存在面向 Coding Plan 的零保留页面或申请入口。DPA §4(b) 的『不存服务器』只对 business/enterprises API Customers 成立，scope 不覆盖个人订阅。

retention.quote: For instance, when we process your personal data to provide you with the Services, we retain it as long as you have an account. This includes your account information, input.

points.text: 对象=用户输入/User Content。隐私政策 §7：『when we process your personal data to provide you with the Services, we retain it as long as you have an account. This includes your account information, input.』——期限类型是『账户存续期』（非下限也非固定上限），账户删除或违约时另行处理（违约时仍按需保留）。§2.1 对 User Content 另有『processed in real-time』措辞，但那是处理方式，不回答留存，与 §7 不冲突。上下文/KV 缓存是另一对象：help/faq 明说缓存保留时长『has not yet been announced』，cache.md 只有『reasonable time limits』。企业/API 档口径完全不同（DPA §4(b) 内容不落盘、§4(c) 终止后删除），不可套到个人档。

points.text: 厂商唯一的 Team 档明文在 devpack/teamplan.md 的 Exclusive Capabilities：『Data is not used for model training by default: Code, prompts, conversations, and related content are excluded from model training by default』（该页是产品权益页，classify 判 not_policy，锚点 teamplan-no-training-by-default 已登记在该来源条目里，只作旁证）。合同层能挂的只有 Additional Terms §3(b)/ToU §IV.7（『For enterprises and developers using API Services, we will not use your User Content for developing or improving Services unless you explicitly agree to such use』）——Team 档购买方是企业且流量走 api.z.ai，但套餐是否构成 Additional Terms 意义上的 API Services，厂商无明文，故 confidence=low。反向证据：个人档 subscription-terms §4.3 是 Personal-Use Only，而 teamplan.md 把『不训练』列为 Team 档专属能力，说明个人档没有同等承诺。
